snye

dab gya gsum pa' dkar chagamangon pa/ 90 (163)3328 ched du brjod pa'i tshoms 3dang po/ mi rtag pa'i tshoms 3gnyis pa/ 'dod pa'i tshoms 7gsum pa/ sred pa'i tshoms 9bzhi pa/ bag yod pa'i tshoms 11lnga pa/ sdug pa'i tshoms 15drug pa/ tshul khrims kyi tshoms/ 18bdun pa/ legs par spyad pa'i tshoms 2༷brgyad pa/ tshig gi tshoms/ 21dgu pa/ las kyi tshoms/ 23bcu pa/ dad pa'i tshoms ༷ 24bcu gcig pa/ dge sbyong gi tshoms/ 261

bcu gnyis pa/ lam gyi tshoms/ 28bcu gsum pa/ bkur ste'i tshoms/ 30bcu bzhi pa/ 'khu ba'i tshoms ༷ ༷ 32bco lnga pa/ dran pa'i tshoms 34bcu drug pa/ sel bu'i tshoms/ ༷ 36bcu bdun pa/ chu'i 41mas 39bco brgyad pa/ me tog gi tshoms/ 40bcu dgu pa/ rta'i tshoms/ ༷ 43nyi shu nga// khro ba'i tshoms 44nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshoms gyenyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ thos pa'i tshoms 49nyi shu rtsa gsum pa/ bdag gi tshoms/ 50nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ bsgre ba'i tshoms 53nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ mdza' bshes kyi tshoms/ 56nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshoms 58nyi shu rtsa bdun pa/ mthong ba'i tshoms 63nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa/ sdig pa'i tshoms 67nyi shu rtsa dgu pa/ phrugs kyi tshoms/ 71sum cu pa/ bde ba'i tshoms 77sum cu rtsa gcig pa/ sems kyi tshoms/ 83sum cu rtsa gnyis pa// dge slong gi tshoms/ 89sum cu rtsa gsum pa/ bram ze'i tshoms 97dgra bcom pa 'chos skyob kyis bsdus/rgya gar gyi mkhan po baibyā ka ra pra bha dang /lo tsā ba bsde rin chen mchog gis bsgyur/2

zhu chen byi lo tsā ba ban+de dpal brtsegs kyis zhus nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(107) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(119)3329 ched du brjod pa'i tshoms kyi rnam par 'grel pa/ 120dang po/ mi rtag pa'i tshoms kyi rnam par 'grel pa/ 120gnyis pa/ 'dod pa'i tshoms kyi rnam par 'grel pa/ 230gsum pa/ sred pa'i tshoms kyi rnam pa/ra 'grel pa/ 271bzhi pa/ bag yod pa'i tshoms kyi rnam par 'grel pa/ 307lnga pa/ snyug pa'i tshoms kyi rnam par 'grel pa/ 361drug pa/ tshul khrims kyi tshoms kyi rnam par 'grel pa/ 392bdun pa/ legs par spyad pa'i tshoms kyi rnam par 'grel pa/ 413brgyad pa/ tshig gi tshoms kyi rnam par 'grel pa/ ༷ 419dgu pa/ las kyi tshoms kyi rnam par 'grel pa/ 437bcu pa/ dad pa'i tshoms kyi rnam par 'grel pa/ 453bcu gcig pa/ dge sbyong gi tshoms kyi rnam par 'grel pa/ 470bcu gnyis pa/ lam gyi tshoms kyi rnam par 'grel pa/ 487bcu gsum pa/ bkur ste'i tshoms kyi rnam par 'grel pa/ 511bcu bzhi pa/ 'khu ba'i tshoms kyi rnam par 'grel pa/ 529bco lnga pa/ dran pa'i tshoms kyi rnam nga/ra 'grel pa/ 546bsdur mchan/(565)

mngon pa/ tshomi (164)na329 ched du brjod pa'i tshoms kyi rnam par 'grel pa/ 599bcu drug pa/ sel bu'i tshoms kyi rnam par 'grel pa/ 599bcu bdun pa/ chu'i tshoms kyi rnam par 'grel pa/ 621bco brgyad pa/ me tog gi tshoms kyi rnam par 'grel pa/ 636bcu dgu pa/ rta'i tshoms kyi rnam par 'grel pa/ 657nyi shu pa/ khro ba'i 11mas kyi rnam par 'grel pa/ 669nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshoms kyi rnam par 'grel pa/ 689nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ thos pa'i tshoms kyi rnam par 'grel ba/ 709nyi shu rtsa gsum pa/ bdag gi tshoms kyi rnam par 'grel pa/ 725nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ bgre ba'i tshoms kyi rnam par 'grel pa/ 739nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ mdza' bshes kyi tshoms kyi rnam par 'grel pa/ 7gonyi shu rtsa drug pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshoms kyi rnam par 'grel pa/ 770nyi shu rtsa bdun pa/ mthong ba'i tshoms kyi rnam par 'grel pa/ 814nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa/ sdig pa'i tshoms kyi rnam par 'grel pa/ 846nyi shu rtsa dgu pa/ phrugs kyi tshoms kyi rnam par 'grel pa/ 878sum cu pa/ bde ba'i tshoms kyi rnam par 'grel pa/ 928sum cu rtsa gcig pa/ sems kyi tshoms kyi rnam par 'grel pa/ 972sum cu rtsa gnyis pa/ dge slong gi tshoms kyi rnam par 'grel pa/ 1011sum cu rtsa gsum pa/ bram ze'i tshoms kyi rnam par 'grel pa/ ༷ 1054

slob dpon pra1 warmas mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po sgra'i gtsug lag la 'byam par mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta dza na ra dha na dang /zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de shākya blo gros kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(1117) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1158)3330 'phags pa chos kyi dbyings kyi snying po'i rnam par 'grel pa/ 1159slob dpon klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas kyis mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po ye shes kyi snying po dang /zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/bsdur mchan/(1161) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1162)3331 bstan bcos tshigs su bcad pa bsnyus pa zhes bya ba/ 1163slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po rnyarmā ka ra dang lo tsā ba ban de ye shes snying pos bsgyur te/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de dpal brtsegs kyis zhus/bsdur mchan/(1166) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1167)33na2 tshigs su bcad pa'i don bsdus pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos ////(3ma dang po'i don bsdus pa/ 1168gnyis pa:re don bsdus pa/ 1171gsum pa'i don bsdus pa/ 1181ba:de nga :re 1den bsdosas pa/ 1182/snga tsho//sde 1decad /ba/sduthag 25/ 11875

drug pa'i don bsdus pa/ 1189bdun pa'i don bsdus pa/ 1194brgyad pa'i don bsdus pa/ 1196dgu pa'i don bsdus pa/ 1199bcu pa'i don bsdus pa/ 1201bcu gcig pa'i don bsdus pa/ 1215bcu gnyis pa'i don bsdus pa/ 1219bcu gsum pa'i don bsdus pa/ 1226bcu bzhi pa'i don bsdus pa/ ༷ 1229bco lnga pa'i don bsdus pa/ 1242bcu drug pa'i don bsdus pa/ 1244bcu bdun pa'i don bsdus pa/ 1245bco brgyad pa'i don bsdus pa/ 1248bcu dgu pa'i don bsdus pa/ ༷1249nyi shu pa'i don bsdus pa/ 1256nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'i don bsdus pa/ 1258slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po rnyarmā ka ra dang /lo tsā ba ban de ye shes snying pos bsgyur/zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de dpal brtsegs kyis zhus/bsdur mchan/(1260) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1267)

bye sngag /ched du brjod pa'i tshoms/①༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ u dān brga/ bod skad du/ ched du brjod pa'i tshoms/ bam po dang po/⑤ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo / /bkra shis par gyur cig /rgyal bas ched du brjod gsungs pa/ /bdag gis rab tu bshad par bya1 / /gnyid dang rmugs pa rnams ④sol la /yid la dga' ba bskyed de nyon/ /thams cad mkhyen pa skyob pa po/ /thub pa chen po thugs brtse ba/ /sku yi tha ma 'dzin pa'i tshe/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di skad gsungs/ /kye ma 'dus byas rnams mi rtag /skye zhing 'jig pa'i chos can yin/ /skyes nas 'jig par 'gyur ba ⑤ste/ /de dag nye bar duzhi ba bde/ /de ltar rab tu 'bar ba la/ /ci zhig dgar yod mgur ci yod/ /mun pa'i nang zhugs gnas pa dag /ci phyir sgon ma tshol mi byed/ /rus pa thi ba'i mdog 'dra ba/ /bor ba gang yin 'di dag ni/ /phyogs dang phyogs 83—3

su rnam 'thor ba/ /de mthong 'di la ci zhig dga'/ /gang gi nub mo kho na nas / /mngal du dang por ⑨zhugs pa'i mi/ /de ni sdod med 'gror ②'gyur zhing / /song ba las kyang ldog pa med/ /snga dro skye bo mang mthong ba/ /phyi dro kha cig mthong mi 'gyur/ /phyi dro skye bo mang ldumathong ba/ /snga dro kha cig mthong mi 'gyur/ /skyes pa bud med mang bo dang / /dar la bab pa'ang 'chi 'gyur na / /de la mi 'di gzhon zhes te/ /gson pa'i gdeng ④drod ci zhig yod/ /kha cig mngal du 'chi bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin kha cig btsas pa'i sar de bzhin kha cig gog tsam la④/ /de bzhin kha cig yongs rgyug na/ /la la rgan dang la la gzhon/ /la la dar la bab pa'i mi/ /rim gyis rab tu 'gro 'gyur te / /'bras bu smin pa rtsang 'gyur bzhin/ /dper na 'bras bu smin pa rnams / /lhung blubs rtag tu 'jigs ⑦pa ltar/ /de bzhin skyes par gyur pa'i mi / /rtag tu 'chi bas 'jigs 3par 'gyur/ /dper na rdza ma'i mkhan po yis / /'jim pa las ni snod byas pa/ /thams cad tha mar 'jig pa ltar/ /mi rnams srog kyang de bzhin no/ /dper na thags ni brkyang ⑪ ba la/ /spun ni gang dang gang bcug pa'i/ /spun gyis rting ⑪la gtugs pa ltar/ /mi rnams srog kyang de bzhin no/ /dper na nges par gsad ⑪pa dag /gom pa gang dang gang bor bas⑫/ /bsad sa'i drung du bsnyen pa ltar/ /mi rnams srog kyang de bzhin no/ /chu klung brag ⑫tu 'bab pa'i rgyun/ /ldog pa med pa ji lta bar / /de bzhin mi yi tshe 'gro ba/ /be+er ni ldog par 'gyur ba med/ /dka' ba nyid dang thung ba dang / /de yang sdug bsngal ldan pa dag /myur ba kho nar 'jig 'gyur te/ /chu la dbyu gus bris pa bzhin/ /dper na phyugs 83—4

rdzi dbyug thogs kyis/ /phyugs rnams gnas su phyin byed ltar/ /de bzhin nad dang rga ba yis/ /mi rnams 'chi bdag drung du skyel/ /chu bran gyi ni chu lta bur①—/ /nyin dang mtshan mo 'das pa yis/ /mi rnams tshe yang zad 'gyur zhing / /srog kyang nye bar 'jig par 'gyur/ /mel tshe byed la mtshan mo ring ②//lam gyis dub la rgyang grags ring / /dam chos rnam par mi shes pa'i/ /byes pa rnams la 'khor ba ring / /bdag la bu yod de bzhin du/ /nor yod ces pas byis pa brlag /phyi rol nang na bdag med na/ /su yi bu yin ci zhig nor / /skyes pa bud med rnams kyi rigs/ /brgya dang stong phrag mang po dang / /longs spyod legs par bsgrubs 1pa yang / /'chi bdag dbang du 'gro bar 'gyur / /bsags pa kun kyi mtha' zad cing / /bslang ba'i mtha' ni 'gyel bar 'gyur/ /phrad pa'i mtha' ni 'bral ba ste/ /gson pa'i mtha' ni 'chi ba yin/ /gson mtha' 'chi ba yin pas na/ /sems can thams cad 'chi 'gyur zhing / /dge sdig 'bras bur ④nyer 'gro ba'i/ /ji bzhin las kyi rjes su 'brang / /sdig pa'i las kyis dmyal ba dang / /bsod nams byas pas bde 'gro ste/ /gzhan dag gis ni lam bsgoms pas/ /zag med mya ngan 'das par 'gyur/ /gang yang sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi nyan thos kyang / /sku lus 'di ni spong mdzad na/ /skye bo phal pa smos byu dgos/ /gang du gnas kyang ⑤'chi bas mi tshugs pa'i/ /sa phyogs de ni yod pa ma yin te/ /bar snang la med rgya mtsho'i nang na med/ /ri bo rnams kyi gseb tu zhugs na'ang min/ /byung dang 'byung bar 'gyur ba ji snyed pa/ /kun gyis ⑥lus 'di btang nas 'gro ba dang / /de kun 'jig par mkhas pas 83—5

rtogs gyis k+ṣete/ /chos la gnas kyis tshangs ②par spyad pa spyod/ /rga ba mthong zhing nad kyi sdug bsngal dang / /sems dang bral ba'i ①shi ba mthong nas ni / /ston pas btson ra 'dra ba'i khyem spangs kyi/ /'jig rten phal pas 'dod spong nus re skan/ /rgyal po'i shing rta shin tu bkra ba'ang 'jig /de bzhin lus kyang nye bar rga bar 'gyur/ /dam pa rnams kyi chos 'di dam pa ste/ /mi mchog gzhan rtogs byed cing rga ④mi 'gyur/ /rga ba khyod ni blun zhing ngan/ /khyod ni mi rigs byed pa ste/ /yid du 'ong ba'i gzugs 'di yang / /khyod kyis mngon par bcom par 'gyur/ /gang zhig lo ni brgyar 'tsho ba/ /de yang 'chi bdag nyid kyis khrid/ /'di dag dga' rjobar 'gyur ba'am/ /yang na na ba'am 'chi bas 'joms/ /rtag tu ldog pa med par 'gro 'gyur zhing / /nyin dang mtshan du rab tu 'jig pa dang / /skye dang 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa dudang ldan pa/ /chu tshan nang du gdungs ④pa'i nya dang 'dra/ /tshe 'di nyin dang mtshan mo dang / /'gro ba dang ni 'dug pa na/ /chu klung chen po'i rgyun bzhin du / /phyir mi ldog par 'gro bar 'gyur/ /chu chung nang gi nya lta bur⑦/ /gang zhig nyin mtshan 'da' ba ⑨yis/ /tshe 'di shin tu thung 'gyur na/ /de la dga' bar byar mi ⑫ yod/ /gson mtha' 'chi ba yin pa'i phyir/ /lus 'di yongs su rga ba dang / /nad kyi tshang 'di myur 'jig cing / /rnag gi tshogs kyang 'jig par 'gyur/ /kye ma lus 'di mi thogs par/ /stong ⑪zhing rnam shes dang bral na⑫/ /dur khrod bor ba'i mgal dum ltar/ /sa yi steng du 'gyel bar 'gyur/ /rgyun du nad kyis mngon gdungs shing / /rtag tu mi gtsang 'dzag pa dang / /rga dang 'chi bas tsher ⑫'grib pa'i/ /lus 'di dor 83—6

ba ①cir mi rung / /myur du 'jig cing na ba dang / /rnag dang ldan pa'i lus 'di yis/ /grub dang bde ba bla med pa/ /zhi mchog don du gnyer bar gyis/ /dgun ka dang ni dpyid ka dang / /dbyar ka 'di dag bya'o zhes/ /byis pa rnam par sems byed pas/ /bar chad mthong bar ma gyur to/ /bu dang nor phyugs 'byor pa la/ /mi yi yid ni rnam chags pa/ /'chi bdag gis ni blangs nas 'gro/ /nyal grong chu bos bdas ⑤pa bzhin/ /'chi ba'i dus la bab pa na/ /bu rnams skyabs su mi 'gyur zhing / /pha yang ma yin gnyen 'dun min/ /khyod la skyabs su 'gyur ba med/ /'di ni bya ba byas zin don 'di bya/ /de dag byas nas bdag gis 'di bya ①zhes/ /de ltar mi 'di yongs su shom pa na/ /rga dang nad bcas 'chi bas mngon du bcom/ /de ltar rtag tu ting 'dzin la dga' mnyam par zhog /brtson pa bskyed la skye dang rga ba'i mtha' ma ltos/ /bdud rnams sde dang bcas pa mngon par zil gnon ④la/ /dge slong dag go skye shi'i spupha rol 'gro bar gyis/ /mi rtag pa'i tshoms te dang po'o // //spyokun rtog las ni 'dod skyes pas/ /'dod pa'i rtsa bar shes gyis laklu/ /khyod ni kun rtog ma sdebyed dang / /des na khyod la 'byung mi 'gyur/ /'dod pa rnams las mya ngan skye/ /'dod pa rnams las 'jigs pa 'byung / /'dod pa dag ni rnam spangs na/ /mya ngan med cing 'jigs pa med/ /dga' ba rnams las mya ngan skye/ /dga' ba rnams las 'jigs pa 'byung / /dga' ba dag ni rnam spangs na/ /mya ngan med cing 'jigs pa med/ /'dod dga'i rnam smin sdug bsngal de⑨/ /dang po mngar la 'bras bu tsha/ /me sgon lag nas 83—7

ma bor ba/ /mjug tu byis pa sreg byed bzhin/ /nor bu'i ①rna cha bu dang bu mo la/ /yongs su chags sems gang yin la ltos 1na/ /lcags shing gres ma las byas ching 3ma gang / /de dag dam po min zhes 'phags pas gsungs④ / /'dod pa'i ching phyem gang yin de lhod kyang / /rab tu dgrol bar dka' zhes 'phags pas gsungasah+phu/ /brtan rnams 'dod pa'i bde la mi lta bar/ /de dag gtubs nas myur du 'gro bar byed/ /'jig rten sna tshogs gang de 'dod min byi/ /skyes bu'i kun rtog gang yin ⑦'dod pa yin/ /'jig rten sna tshogs de bzhin gnas kyang ni/ /'on kyang brtan rnams 'di la 'dun pa 'dul//mi rnams la ni rtag pa'i 'dod pa med/ /'dod can gang la chags de mi rtag pas—/ /yang srid med phyir sems kyis rab spongs la/ /'chi ba'i gnas mi 'gyur bar byos zhes gsungs/ /'dun pa skyes shing zad par mi byed dam⑪/ /sems la skyon med pa dang dran pa dang / /'dod pa rnams la so sor ma chags gang / /de ni gong du 'pho ba yin zhes gsungs/ /mgar ba yis ni dngul spubazhin du/ /blo gros ldan pas rim pa bzhin/ /skad cig skad cig cung zad tsam—/ /rang gi dri ma bsal bar bya/ /lham mkhan gyis ni ko ba dang ⑫/ /yongs su sbyangs nas lham byed ltar/ /'dod pa gang dang gang spangs pa/ /de de bde ba phun sum ldan/ /gal te bde ba kun 'dod na/ /'dod pa thams cad yongs su spongs/ /'dod pa thams cad yongs spangs pas/ /mchog tu bde ba thob par 'gyur/ /ji srid 'dod pa'i rjes 'brang ba/ /de srid bar du ngoms mi 'gyur/ /de las ⑪gang dag shes rab kyis/ /ldog byed de dag tshim pa thob/ /'dod pas ngoms par mi 'gyur bas/ /shes rab kyis ni 83—8

ngoms pa bskyed/ /shes rab kyis ni ngoms pa'i mi/ /srid pa'i dbang du mi 'gyur ro/ /'dod la chags pa'i mi gang yin/ /de dag kye ma chos min dga'//cung zad gson por 'dug pa na/ /bar chad mthong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /blo ngan longs spyod kyis bcom pa pha rol tshol bar mi byed cing / /bsam brlag 'dod la sred pa yis/ /bdag dang gzhan yang phung bar byed/ / kār ṣā pa ṇa'i ①char bab kyang / /'dod pa rnams kyis ngoms mi 'gyur/ /'dod pa mnog chung nyes mang bar/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis khong du chud/ /lha yi 'dod pa rnams la yang / /lhag par dga' bar mi 'gyur gyi/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang nyan thos rnams/ /sred pa zad pas dgyes par 'gyur/ /gangs can dang ni mnyam pa yi/ /gser gyi ri bo yod gyur kyang / /nor des gcig kyang mi tshim par/ /rtogs par gyis la legs par spyod/ /gang dag sdug bsngal de yi rgyur shes pa/ /de dag nam yang 'dod la dga' mi 'gyur/ /'jig rten dag na zug rngu'i rgyur shes nas/ /de dag gdul phyir bstan ④pa slob par byed/ /'dod pa'i tshoms te gnyis pa'o// //lus can rnam par rtog pas rab bcom nas/ /'dod chags mi bzad gtsang bar ①rjes lta bas/ /'dod chags phyir zhing rab tu 'phel 'gyur te/ /rang gi 'ching ba de yis dam por byed/ /gang dag rnam rtog nye bar zhi dga' zhing / /mi sdug sgom dupa rtag tu dran byed de/ /de yi sred phyopa rab tu spangs pa yis/ /rang gi 'ching ba de dag 'drul ⑥bar byed/ /'dod pa mun nag dra bas g.yogs/ /sred pa'i dgab pas bkab pa dang / /bag med 'ching bas 83—9

bcings pa dag /tshed mar chud pa'i nya dang 'dra/ /skyes bu bag med rab tu spyod byed pa/ /'khri shing bzhin du sred pa 'phel 'gyur zhing / /rga dang 'chi ba'i rjes su 'gro 'gyur te/ /ma drung nu zho 'dod pa'i be'u dang 'dra/ /mi dag dran par byed dang chags byed dang / /yid bde ba la rtog par byed pa dag /de yis yang dang yang du 'khor bar 'khyam/ /tshal nang 'bras bu 'dod pa'i spre'u dang mtshungs/ /mi gang rtag tu bde bar 'dod byed pa/ /skye dang rga bar nye bar 'gro 'gyur zhing / /①skye dgu sred pa rnams kyis mdun du bdar/ /rgya nang ri bong yongs su rgyug pa bzhin/ /sred pa rnams kyis 'dud ②pa'i sems can dag /srid dang srid min dag la sems snechags shing / /kun sbyor ro la dga' ba'i byis pa rjornams/ /yang dang yang du sdug bsngal thob par 'gyur—/ /skye bo grub dang bde ba dang bral zhing / /bdud kyi sbyor ba dag dang ldan pa de/ /rga dang 'chi ba'i rjes su 'gro 'gyur te/ /ma drung nu zho 'dod pa'i be'u dang 'dra/ /'di na sred pa de 'dra spong byed pa/ /srid dang srid min dag la sred bral zhing / /dge slong srid pa zil gyis gnon byed pa/ /lhag ma med par yongs su mya ngan 'da'/ /gang zhig 'jig rten spang dka' ba'i—/ /sred ⑤pa'i bud med 'dis bkol dhib/ /de yi mya ngan 'phel 'gyur te—/ /rtswa la char pa bab pa bzhin/ /gang zhig 'jig rten spang dka' ba'i/ /sred pa'i bud med 'di spong ba/ /de yi mya ngan ldog 'gyur te/ /pad+ma las ni chu thigs bzhin/ /de phyir ji snyed 'dir lhags pa/ /khyed la smra yis khyed bde shog /u shir phyir ni rtswa bzhin du/ /sred pa rtsar ⑦bcas drungs nas phyung / /skyes bu sred pa dang 'grogs na/ /yun rings dus su 'khyam 'gyur 83—10

bas—/ /sred pa drungs nas phyung shig ①dang / /mya ngan med cing 'jigs pa med②—/ /yang dang yang du nyer len cing / /yang dang yang du mngal du 'jug /gnas skabs 'gyur dang gzhan 'gyur bas/ /sems can 'ong dang 'gro bar byed/ /'dir ni spang dka'i sred pa de/ /spongs la sa bon chod cig dang / /de la sred pa med 'gyur zhing / /de ni yang du 'khor mi 'gyur/ /dal 'byor chud ni ma gzan ④par/ /gang gis lha dang mi rnams su/ /don gnyer bcings nas 'jog byed pa/ /yul la sred pa de las rjorgol/ /sems can dmyal bar skyes na yang / /dal 'byor thal bas 'gyod par 'ong / /gang tshe srid mtsho'i rgyur 'gyur brjo/ /yul la sred pa 'bras kyi gzhi/ /'khri shing dra bas khebs byed pa/ /gdung bar byed pa ma btul na/ /sdug bsngal 'di ni yang dang yang / /rnam pa kun du ldog mi 'gyur/ /dper na ljon shing rtsad nas ma bton dun/ /bcad kyang phyir zhing skye ba kho nar zad/ /de bzhin sred pa'i phra rgyas ma bton dze+en/ /yang dang yang du sdug bsngal 'di mi ldog /dper na bdag nyid kyis ni byas pa'i mtshon/ /de yis rkun po'i mthu yis skebadag gsod ltar/ /de bzhin nang gi sems las byung ba yi/ /sred pas lus can nye bar gsod par byed/ /de ltar sred las sdug bsngal dag /'byung ba'i nyes dmigs shes gyis ⑨te/ /sred spongs nye bar len med dang / /dran ldan dge slong kun du rgyus/ /sred pa'i tshoms te gsum pa'o// //bag yod 'chi med gnas yin te/ /bag med pa ni 'chi ba'i gnas/ /bag yod 'chi bar mi 'gyur te/ /bag med pa ni rtag tu 'chi/ /de yi khyad 83—11

par de rig ①pas/ /mkhas pa rnams ni bag ④dang ldan/ /bag yod pa la rab dga' ba/ /'phags pa'i spyod yul dga' ba yin/ /de la rgyun du sgom pa dang / /rtag tu pha rol gnon brtan pa'i/ /brtan pas grub bde bla med pa'i①—/ /mya ngan 'das la reg pa yin/ /gang tshe mkhas pas bag yod pas/ /bag med bcom pa de yi tshe/ /shes rab khang bzangs steng 'dzegs nas/ /mya ngan med pas gdung rjobacas dang / /brtan rnams ri bo'i spo dag la⑤/ /sa stengs byis pa rnams la ltadu/ /brtson 'grus dang ni bag yod dang / /yang dag sdom dang dul ba yis/ /mkhas pas gling du byas nas ni/ /chu bo chen po mngon du bzlog⑦ /brtson 'grus ldan zhing dran dang ldan pa dang / /spyod pa gtsang zhing brtags nas byed pa dang / /yang dag sdom dang chos kyis 'tsho ba dang / /bag yod rnams kyi dze+egrags pa mngon par 'phel/ /lhag pa'i sems la bag bya ste/ /thub pa'i thub gzhi rnams la bslab/ /nyer zhi rtag tu dran ldan pa'i/ /skyob pa mya ngan med pa yin/ /dman pa'i chos la mi rten ⑨cing / /bag med pa la brten mi bya/ /log par lta la 'dod med dang / /'jig rten 'phel bar mi bya'o/ /'jig rten pa yi yang dag lta/ /chen po su la yod gyur pa—/ /de ni tshe rabs stong du yang / /ngan 'gror 'gro bar mi 'gyur ro/ /bag med pa la sbyor ⑩byed pa/ /skye bo byis pa bsam brlag yin/ /tshong dpon nor rnams srung ba ltar/ /mkhas pas bag dang ldan par bya/ /bag med pa la mi sbyor zhing / /'dod la dga' ba mi stsogs dang / /rtag tu bag yod sems byed pa/ /zag pa zad pa thob par 'gyur/ /zag pa zad pa ma thob kyang / /dus 'dir bag med mi bya ste/ /ri dwags ma yis seng ge ltar/ /83—12

bag med pa dag bsad ①par 'gyur/ /bag med pha rol bud med sten ④byed pa'i—/ /mi gang yin la gnas skabs 'di bzhi ①'byung / /bsod nams mi thob bde bar mi nyal dang / /gsum pa smad 'gyur bzhi pa dmyal bar 'gyur/ /bsod nams ma thob sdig pa'i 'gro ba dang / /'jigs dang bag tsha lhan cig bde ba chung / /rgyal po'i chad pa chen pos rjogacod 'gyur zhing / /lus zhig sems can dmyal ba rnams su 'tshedadu/ /gang zhig bdag bde lta 'dod pa/ /des ni gong ma bzhin du bya/ /byes pa'i shing rta bzhin 'gyur bas/ /brtan pas brtson 'grus zhan mi bya/ /dper na byis pa'i shing rta dag /lam chen bzang po bor nas su/ /lam ngan dag tu 'gro byed pas/ /mig chags sems khong duchud pa ltar/ /de bzhin chos ni spangs nas kyang / /chos min rjes su 'jug byed pa'i/ /byis pa 'chi bdag dbang 'gro zhing / /mig chags ⑦bzhin du bcom pa 'thob/ /gang zhig bya ba rnams ⑧spangs nas/ /mi bya ba dag byed pa dang / /bag med pa yis zlas byed pa/ /de dag rnams kyi ⑨zag pa 'phel/ /gang gis ⑩zag pa 'phel 'gyur ba/ /de yi zag med rgyang ma na/ /gang zhig lus gtogs dran pa dag⑩ /rtag tu legs par brtsams pa dang / /bya ba ma yin mi byed cing / /rgyun du bya ba byed pa dang / /dran dang shes bzhin ldan pa de'i/ /zag pa rnams ni zad par 'gyur/ /gang gi zag pa zad gyur pa/ /des ⑫ni zag med thob par 'gyur/ /ji tsam mang du smra byed pa/ /de dag dam chos 'dzin ma yin/ /gang dag 'di na thos nyung yang / /lus kyis chos dag mngon sum byas/ /gang dag chos la bag byed pa/ /de dag dam chos 'dzin pa yin/ /gal te rigs bcas mang du smras kyang ni/ /bag 83—13

med mi dag de ltar byed mi 'gyur/ /dper na phyugs rdzis ①gzhan gyi phyugs bgrangs ltar/ /de dag dge sbyong skal ba thob ma yin/ /gal te rigs bcas ②nyung du smra byed kyang / /chos kyi rjes su chos la spyod pa dang / /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug spong byed pa/ /de dag dge sbyong skal ba thob pa yin/ /bag yod bsngags pa rjod ④byed cing / /rtag tu bag med la smod rjopas/ /bag yod mchod sbyin brgya pa yang / /lha rnams nang na gtso bor gyur⑤/ /bya ba byas rung ma byas rung / /mkhas pa bag yod bsngags pa brjod/ /bag dang bcas pa'i mkhas pa yis/ /don gnyis rab tu len par byed/ /tshe 'di'i don ni gang yin dang / /phyi ma'i don ni gang yin pa/ /de dag brtan pas rtogs pas na/ /mkhas pa zhes ni brjod pa yin/ /dge slong bag yod la dga' zhing / /bag med pa la 'jigs lta bas/ /bdag nyid ngan 'gro las 'dren te/ /'dam rdzab las ni glang chen bzhin/ /dge slong bag yod la dga' zhing / /bag med pa la 'jigs lta bas/ /sdig pa'i chos rnams sprul par byed/ /rlung gis ljon shing lo ma bzhin/ /dge slong bag yod la dga' zhing / /bag med pa la 'jigs lta bas/ /kun du sbyor ba phra sbom dag /me yis bsregs pa bzhin du 'gro/ /dge slong bag yod la dga' zhing / /bag med pa la 'jigs dulta bas/ /kun du sbyor ba kun zad pa/ / rim kyis ④nyams su stsong bar 'gyur/ /dge slong bag yod la dga' zhing / /bag med pa la 'jigs lta bas/ /'du byed nyer zhi zhi ba yi/ /zhi ba'i go 'phang so sor rtogs—/ /dge slong bag yod la dga' zhing / /bag med pa la 'jigs lta bag/mya ngan 'das dang nye ba'i phyir/ /yongs su nyams 'gyur mi srid do/ /brtson 83—14

'grus ldan zhing bag yod dang / /chos spyod legs par spyod byed pa①/ /'jig rten 'di dang pha rol du/ /chos spyad pa yis bde ba thob④/ /zhi phyir bslab pa la brten ①dang / /rtsol ba dang ni brtson 'grus skyed④/ /mi dran pa dang bag med dang / /brtson 'grus chung dang kun sdom med/ /gnyid dang snyom budang g.yeng ba ste—/ /'di dag bslab pa'i bar chad pas/ /khyed kyis yan lag de rjortogs la/ /dran pa chud ni ma gzan ④cig /dge slong tshul khrims bzang ba dang / /bag yod pa la dga' ba yis④/ /kun rtog ⑨legs par mnyam zhog ste/ /rang gi sems ni rjes su srungs⑩/ /brtsam par bya zhing dbyung ⑪bar bya/ /sangs rgyas bstan la 'jug par bya/ / 'dam bu'i ⑫khyim la glang chen bzhin/ /'chi bdag sde ni gzhom par bya/ /gang zhig chos 'dul 'di nyid la⑫/ /bag dang ldan par spyod byed pa/ /skye ba'i 'khor ba rab spangs nas/ /sdug bsngal tha mar byed par 'gyur/ /bag yod pa'i tshoms te bzhi pa'o// //sdug pa rnams las mya ngan skye/ /sdug pa rnams las 'jigs pa skye/ /sdug pa dag ni rnam spangs na/ /mya ngan med cing 'jigs pa med/ /sdug gu ma las mya ngan skye/ /sdug las sdug bsngal sdug las 'jigs/ /sdug gu ma dag gzhan gyur na/ /yi mug 'gyur ⑫ba thob par byed/ /'jig rten sdug bsngal rnam pa du ma dang / /mya ngan smre sngags 'don pa ji snyed pa/ /de dag sdug pa dag las rten ⑫te 'byung / /sdug pa spangs na de dag yod mi 'gyur/ /gang phyir 'jig rten 'ga' na'ang sdug med pa/ /gang yin de dag bde zhing mya ngan med/ /de bas gdung med rdul bral don gnyer bas/ /nam yang sdug 83—15

pa ra byed pa mi bya'o①/ /sdug pa ma mthong sdug bsngal la/ /mi sdug mthong na'ang de bzhin pas/ /nam yang sdug dang phrad mi bya/ /mi sdug dang yang phrad mi bya/ /sdug pa dang ni bye bral dang / /mi sdug pa dang phrad pa yis/ /gang gis mi dag rgas byed pa'i①/ /mya ngan mi bzad skye bar 'gyur/ /sdug pa shi bar gyur pa na/ /gnyen 'dun mdza' bshes mang po dag /yun rings ①dus su mya ngan dang / /sdug dang bral bas sdug bsngal 'gyur/ /gang la sdug dang sdug min med/ /de la mdud pa yod min pas/ /de ltas sdug nyid sdig can la/ /sdug par byed pa ④mi bya'o/ /sdug la bltas te don btang nas/ /bde sbyor rnams la mi 'jug cing / /bdag nyid mi bde'i sbyor ldan dag⑤ /bde sbyor don ldan rnams la smon/ /gzugs sdug bde bas bsdams pa dag /lha mi so so'i ris dag tu/ /sdig pa byed cing yongs nyams nas/ /rga dang 'chi ba'i dbang du 'gro/ /gang zhig nyin dang mtshan rnams su/ /bag yod gzugs sdug spong byed pa/ /des ni spang dka' bdud zas dang / /ldig pa'i rtsa ba'ang drungs nas phyung / /legs min legs pa'i tshul dang ni/ /sdug min sdug pa'i tshul kyis dang / /sdug bsngal bde ba'i tshul kyis su/ /bag med rnams ni mngon du 'joms/ /gal te bdag la dga' byed na/ /nyes par byed pas bde ba dag /bde blag kho nar mi 'thob pas/ /'di ni sdig la gzhug mi bya/ /gal te bdag la dga' byed na/ /legs par byed pas bde ba dag /bde blag kho nar thob 'gyur bsadu/ /'di ni sdog la gzhug mi bya/ /dper na dgon pa'i grong khyer dag /brtan pa'i 'obs kyis bskor ba dag⑦ /gal te bdag la dga' byed na/ /'di ni bsrung bas legs par bsrung / /83—16

gal te bdag la dga' byed na/ /thun gsum gang yang rung ba la/ /mkhas pas mel tshe bya ba yis/ /'di ni sba bas legs par sba/ /dper na dgon pa'i grong khyer dag /phyi nang srung bar byed pa ltar/ /dal 'byor chud ni mi zos pa/ /de ltar bdag ni bsrung bar bya/ /sems can dmyal bar skyes dhin yang / /dal 'byor thal bas 'gyod par 'ong / /phyogs rnams kun du sems kyis yongs brtags kyang / /bdag las ches ②sdug 'ga' yang ma mthong ba①/ /de ltar so sor gzhan la'ang rang sdug pas/ /de phyir bdag dgas dhigazhan la gnod mi bya/ /thams cad la yang srog ni sdug /thams cad chad pas 'jigs pa rjon/ /rang gi nyams las dudapag gyis te/ /brdeg par mi bya gsad mi bya/ / rgyang thag bcad ⑦par sgyugs pa'i mi/ /ring nas nye skezho med 'ongs nas⑨/ /gnyen bshes mdza' bo lhags nas su/ /a la la zhes mngon par dga'/ /de bzhin bsod nams byas pa'i mi/ /'jig rten 'di nas pha rol du/ /phyin tshe gnyen bzhin bsod nams dag /'ongs nas mngon par dga' bar byed/ /de bas 'jig rten pha rol kyi/ /ched du bsod nams bsags par kyis/ /bsod nams 'jig rten pha rol du/ /lus can rnams kyi gnas su ⑩'gyur/ /gang zhig legs ⑪spyad spyod byed ⑫pa'i/ /dge la ⑫lha rnams stod ④par byed/ /'di na'ang smad par mi 'gyur la/ /mtho ris su yang dga' ba 'thob/ /chos gnas tshul khrims phun sum tshogs/ /ngo tsha shes shing bden par smra/ /rang gi bya ba byed pa la/ /skye bo gzhan rnams dga' bar byed/ /rang gi don ni byed ⑫pa la/ /'di ltar gzhan rnams dga' 'gyur zhing / /mthong ba'i chos la bsngags pa dang / /pha rol du yang bde 83—17

'gror 'gyur/ / gtam na gnang ①ba'i tshig smra dang / /mi rigs spyod las bzlog pa la②/ /dam pa rnams ni dga' bar byed/ /dam pa ma yin dga' mi 'gyur—/ /de bas mchog dang mchog min pa/ /shi 'phos bral bar gyur pa na//dam pa ma yin dmyal bar 'gro/ /dam pa mtho ris 'gro bar 'gyur/ /sdug pa'i tshoms te lnga pa'o// //bsngags par 'gyur dang nor 'thob dang / /pha rol bde 'gror ①dga' 'gyur ba'i/ /bde ba gsum po don gnyer ba'i/ /mkhas pas tshul khrims bsrung bar bya/ /'phags dang mthong ba phun tshogs dang / /'jig rten zhi ba rten 'gyur ba'i/ /gnas gzhan 'di dag mthong ba yi/ /mkhas pas tshul khrims bsrung bar bya/ /lus la yongs su gdung med par/ /tshul khrims kyis ni bde ba 'thob/ /mtshan mo bde bar nyal ba dang / /sad pa na yang dga' bar 'gyur/ /sbyin pa rjotshul khrims ldan pa dag /mkhas pas byas dupa'i bsod nams kyis/ /'di dang dupha rol dag tu yang / /rtag tu bde ba 'thob ④par 'gyur/ /rgan pa'i bar la tshul khrims dge/ /dad la ⑧rab tu gnas na legs—/ /mi yi rin chen shes rab ste/ /bsod nams chom ⑨pos dbrog par ⑩dka'—/ /dge slong tshul khrims la gnas shing / /dbang po rnams kyang ⑪bsdams pa dang / /zas kyi tshod ni rig pa dang / /mi nyal ba la 'bad pa ste/ /de ltar gnas par brtson pa dang / /nyin mtshan snyom las mi byed pa/ /mya ngan 'das dang nye ba'i phyir/ /yongs su nyams 'gyur mi srid do/ /mi ni tshul khrims la gnas nas/ /sems dang shes rab sgom ⑫pa la/ /brtson zhing 83—18

nges gnas dge slong gis/ /sdug bsngal zad pa thob par 'gyur/ /de phyir rtag tu tshul khrims dang / /ting 'dzin rjes su ①bsrung ba dang / /lhag mthong la ni bslab pa dang / /shes bzhin so sor dran par bya/ /des ni kun sbyor zad byas nas/ /yid bral dulhag ma med 'gyur te/ /lus zhig shes rab ldan pa yis/ /bgrang du med pa'i mya ngan 'das/ /gang zhig tshul khrims ting 'dzin dang / /shes rab 'di gsum legs bsgoms te/ /shin tu dri med mthar phyin cing / /gdung med yang srid zad 'gyur dang / /chags pa'i 'ching las rnam grol zhing / /lus spangs shes rab ldan pa dang / /bdud kyi yul las 'das pa dag /nyi ma bzhin du lam mer 'bar①/ /dge slong phyi dang nang nyid la/ /bag med rlom par byed pa yi/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab rnams/ /yongs su rdzogs par mi 'gyur ro/ /sprin gyis khebs las char 'bab cing / /nam thang ba las char mi 'bab/ /de bas khebs pa sol cig dang / /'di ltar char pa 'bab mi 'gyur/ /de ltar rtag tu mthong ba dang / /dge slong tshul khrims sdom pa yisadu/ /mya ngan 'das par 'gro ba'i lam—/ /myur ba kho nar rnam par 'dagadu /me tog dri ni rdzi phyogs min dumi 'gro| /rtsa ba rgya ⑦spos tsan+dan rnams kyang min/ /dam pa'i dri ni rdzi phyogs mi ④'gro ste/ /phyogs rnams kun du mi mchog dri yis khyab/ /rgya spos dang ni tsan+dan dang / /ut+pa la dang ma li ka /spos kyi rigs ni 'di dag pas/ /tshul khrims dri bsung phul du phyin/ /rgya spos tsan+dan gang yin pa'i/ /dri bsung 'di ni chung ngu na/ /tshul khrims ldan pa'i dri bsung gang / /des ni 'di ⑨dang mtho ris khyab/ /de ltar bag yod gnas bya zhing / /tshul khrims rnam 83—19

par dag par bya/ /yang dag shes pas rnam grol na/ /bdud kyi lam ni rnyed mi 'gyur/ /'di ni bde bar 'gro lam ste/ /rnam par dag byed lam 'di la/ /rab tu zhugs ①te bsgoms nas kyang / /bdud kyi 'ching ba spang bar gyes/ /tshul khrims kyi tshoms te ④drug pa'o// //lus kyis ①nyes par spyod spang zhing / /lus kyis dulegs spyad spyad rjopa'i phyir—/ /lus kyi nyes chen las bsrungs na/ /lus ni bsdam dupa byas par 'gyur—/ /ngag gis ④nyes par spyod spang zhing / /ngag gis ⑧legs spyad spyad ⑨pa'i phyir/ /ngag gi nyes chen las bsrungs na/ /ngag — bsdam ⑩pa byas par 'gyur—/ /yid kyis ⑪nyes par spyod spang zhing / /yid kyis ⑫legs spyad spyod ⑫pa'i phyir/ /yid kyi nyes chen las bsrungs na/ /yid ni bsdams pa byas par 'gyur—/ /lus kyis ⑫nyes par spyod spang zhing / /ngag gis ⑫nyes par spyod pa spang / /yid kyis ⑩nyes par spyod spang zhing / /skyon gzhan ldan pa gang yin spang / /lus kyis ⑩dge ba rnams bya zhing / /ngag gis ⑫dge ba phal chen ⑪bya/ /yid kyis rjodage ba rnams bya zhing / /tshad med bzhi dang ldan par ⑫bya/ /lus kyis ⑫dge ba rnams bya zhing / /ngag dang yid kyis byas na ni/ /'di dang pha rol dag tu yang / /rtag tu bde ba thob par 'gyur/ /rtag tu lus ni bsdams pa'i phyir/ /thub pa 'tshe ba med pa yin/ /de ni 'chi med gnas 'gro zhing / /gang du song na'ang mya ngan med/ /rtag tu ngag ni bsdams pa'i phyir/ /thub pa 'tshe ba med pa yin/ /de ni 'chi med gnas 'gro zhing / /gang du song na'ang mya ngan med/ /rtag tu yid ni bsdams pa'i phyir/ /thub pa 'tshe ba med pa 83—20

yin—/ /de ni 'chi med gnas 'gro zhing / /gang du song na'ang mya ngan med/ /brtan pa rnams kyis lus bsdam zhing ①/ /brtan pa rnams kyis ngag kyang bsdam①//brtan pa rnams kyis yid bsdam zhing ①/ /brtan pas kun du bsdams byas na/ /de dag 'chi med gnas 'gro zhing / /gang du song na'ang mya ngan med/ /lus kyi sdom pa legs pa ste/ /ngag gi sdom pa legs pa yin/ /yid kyi sdom pa'ang legs pa ste/ /thams cad du ni sdom pa legs/ /kun du bsdams pa'i dge slong ni/ /sdug bsngal kun las rnam par 'groladu/ /ngag rnams bsrung zhing yid rnams legs bsdams te/ /lus kyis ⑤mi dge ba dag spyad mi bya/ /las lam gsum po 'di dag rnam sbyangs na/ /drang srong gsungs pa'i lam ni thob par 'gyur/ /legs par spyad pa'i tshoms te bdun pa'o// //gang dag byas bzhin ma byas zer ba dang / /brdzun du smra ba dmyal bar 'gro bar 'gyur/ /mi de gnyis ka 'dra ba pha rol du/ /song nas dman pa'i chos dang ldan par 'gyur/ /skyes bu skyes pa'i kha nas ni/ /tshig ngan smra bar byed pa yi/ /tshig gi sta re skyes gyur nas/ /bdag nyid gcod par byed par 'gyur—/ /gang zhig smad 'os skye bo stod rjobyed dang / /bstod 'os skye bo rnam par smod byed pa/ /de ni kha yis dze+e'athab krol kun stsogs shing / /'thab krol can gang des ni bde mi 'thob⑧/ /gang 'dir cho los rang nor 'pham ⑨byed pa/ /'thab krol de ni chung zad tsam du zad/ /gang zhig bde bar gshegs la yid 'khrug ⑩pa/ /de 'dir 'thab krol shin tu chen po yin/ /ngag yid 'phags pas smad pa'i sdig bsten ⑪na/ /bye bar chu bur can dang stong phrag ni/ /83—21

bzhi bcu gcig tu chu bur rdol ba yi/ /sems can dmyal ba rnams su 'gro bar 'gyur—/ /sdig pa'i sems kyis ma nyes skyon brjod pa/ /bdag nyid gsad phyir dmyal ba spel bar zad/ /stobs ldan nyes pa dag ni ①bzod byed cing / /de la sems kyang 'khrug ①par mi byed do/ /bsam brlag gang zhig sdig can gyi//lta la brten nas 'phags pa ni④/ /dgra bcom chos kyis 'tsho ba dang / /bstan pa spong bar byed pa dag /sbyig rjom 'bru chags lta bur ⑤ni/ /de ni rang gi 'bras bus rjogasod/ /tshig bzang kho na smra bya yi/ /sdig pa can dag smra mi bya/ /sdig can gdung byed smra ba bas/ /tshig bzang smra bar byed pa rung //byis pa sdig can smra byed pa/ /smra ba'i tshe na 'ching 'gyur la/ /gal te smra ⑦na gzhan spong ba⑧/ /de dag 'phags pa mi gsung ngo / /dge slong dag ni bsdams pa dang / /dal bus smra zhing zlos pa med/ /gang zhig chos ldan don ston pa/ /de ni snyan par smra ba yin/ /legs par smra ba mchog ces 'phags pa gsungs⑨/ /snyan smra mi snyan ma yin de gnyis pa/ /bden smra brdzun pa ma yin de gsum pa/ /chos smra phal pa ma yin bzhi pa de'o/ /tshig de rnams ni smra bya zhing / /gang gis ⑩bdag kyang mi gdung la/ /pha rol la yang gnod med pa'i—/ /tshig de legs par smra bar bya/ /gang gis mngon par dga' 'gyur zhing / /gang gis sdig pa mi skyed ⑪dang / /smras pas pha rol dga' 'gyur ba'i/ /snyan tshig kho na ⑫smra bar bya/ /bden pa'i tshig ni bdud rtsi ste/ /bden pa'i tshig ni bla med yin/ /don dang chos la rab gnas pa/ /bden pa yin zhes dam pa gsungs⑫/ /sdug bsngal thams cad spang ba'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas kyis ⑫ni gsungs tshig gang / /bden pa mya ngan 'das 'gro ba'i/ /tshig de bla na 83—22

med pa yin/ /tshig gi tshoms te brgyad pa'o// //chos gcig las ni rab 'das shing / /'jig rten pha rol bcom pa ①yi/ /lus can brdzun du smra ba yis①/ /sdig pa mi bya ci yang med/ /lcags sgong me lce 'bar 'dra ba/ / zos par gyur pa ches bla ①yi/ /tshul 'chal legs par mi sdom pas/ /yul 'khor bsod snyoms bzar mi rung / /khyod ni sdug bsngal gyis 'jigs shing / /khyod la sdug bsngal mi sdug na/ /mngon sum dag gam sgog tu'ang rung / /sdig pa can gyi las mi bya/ /gal te sdig pa'i las byas sam—/ /byed kyang rung ste khyod kyis ni/ /kog ces langs te bros byas kyang / /sdug bsngal las ni thar mi 'gyur/ /gang du gnas na las kyis mi tshugs pa'i/ /sa phyogs de ni yod pa ma yin te/ /bar snang la med rgya mtsho'i nang na med/ /ri bo rnams kyi gseb tu zhugs kyang min/ /pha rol po la brtags nas gang / /sdig pa can gyi las mthong ba/ /de dag bdag gis mi bya ste/ /sdig byas las ni rjes su 'brang / /las gang shin tu mi bzad dang / /zol byed gzhal lugs 'chos pa dang / /mi la 'tshe bar byed pa dang / /gzhan la rjobyed du 'jug pa yi/ /las de mi yi rjes 'brang bas/ /de yis g.yang sar thong bar byed—/ /mi yis dge ba'am sdig pa yi/ /las ni gang dang gang byas pa'i/ /las rnams chud zar mi 'gyur te/ /de lta de ltar 'bras bur 'gyur/ /de yi tshogs pa ji srid par/ /de srid 'di ni ⑤gdung bar byed/ /de la gzhan dag gdung byed de/ /gdung byed de ni rtag dupar 'gyur/ /'di ni bdag rjes mi 'brang ⑦zhes/ /byis pas ⑧ma brtags byas pa yi/ /sdig pa'i las kyis 'gro 83—23

ba dag /pha rol du ni shes par 'gyur/ /gal te byis pas ①mi shes par/ /sdig pa'i las ni byas pa dag /nam zhig na ni de nyid kyis/ /rnam smin tsha ba so sor bsten/ /rang gi las kyis de 'og tu/ /me yis bsregs pa bzhin du gdungs—/ /byis pa shes rab chung ngu dag /bdag la dgra bzhin byed pa yis//gang zhig 'bras bu cher ②'gyur ba'i/ /sdig can las ni spyod par byed/ /gang zhig byas pas gdung 'gyur zhing / /mchi mas gdong g.yogs ngu bzhin du/ /rnam min so sor bsten pa yis①/ /las de dag ni ma byas legs/ /gang zhig byas na mi gdung zhing / /dga' zhing yid ni bde ba yis/ /rnam smin so sor bsten pa yinadhi/ /las de dag ni byas na legs/ /bdag nyid bde ba 'dod pa'i phyir/ /rgod bzhin sdig pa'i las byas pa'i/ /sdig pa'i ⑤las de'i rnam smin dag /ngu bzhin nyams su myong bar 'gyur/ /nges par sdig las 'phral du ni/ /'o ma lta bur 'gyur mi byed/ /thal bas g.yogs pa'i me lta burjo/ /des ni byis pa sreg par byed/ /sdig las 'phral du nges par ni/ /mtshon bzhin gcod par mi byed kyang / /sdig pa'i las kyis 'gro ba dag /pha rol du ni mngon par 'gyur/ /gang du de dag rnam smin ni/ /tsha ba so sor bsten ⑦pa yi/ /sdig pa'i las kyis 'gro ba dag /pha rol du ni shes par 'gyur/ /lcags las g.ya' ni langs gyur pa/ /langs pa des ni de nyid za/ /de bzhin ma brtags byas pa yi/ /rang gi las kyis ngan 'gror 'gro/ /las kyi tshoms te dgu pa'o// //dad dang ngo tsha sgetshul khrims sbyin pa ste/ /chos 'di rnams ni skyes bu 83—24

dam pas bsngags/ /'di yis lha yi 'jig rten 'gro 'gyur zhing / /lam 'di nyid kyis lha yul 'gro zhes gsungs/ /'jungs rnams lha yi 'jig rten mi 'gro zhing / /de yis byes pa sbyin pa'i bsngags mi brjod/ /brtan rnams sbyin ①la rjes su yi rang ba/ /des ni de dag gzhan du bde ba myong / /'di na skyes bu'i snenor mchog dad pa ste/ /'di na chos la legs spyod bde ba 'thob/ / bden pa ④kho na ro bro rnams kyi phul/ /shes rab kyis 'tsho 'tsho ba'i mchog ces gsungs/ /mya ngan 'das par 'gro ba yi/ /dgra bcom chos la dad bskyed de/ /mkhas pas gus par mnyan na ni/ /de dang de yi shes rab 'thob//bag can gyis ni rgya mtsho dang / /dad pas chu bo rnams las sgroladhi/ /brtson 'grus kyis ni sdug bsngal spong / /shes rab kyis ni yang ⑤dag 'gyur/ /dge slong dad pa'i grogs ldan zhing / /shes rab kyis ni gtams pa dang / /mya ngan 'das la dumangon dga' bas/ /'ching ba thams cad gcod par 'gyur/ /gang gis dad dang tshul khrims dang / /shes rab nyid ni legs bsgoms shing / /mkhas pas skyon rnams spong ba de'i⑦/ /legs pa'i ngang tshul can zhes brjod/ /dad dang tshul khrims phun sum tshogs/ /gtong ldan 'jungs pa rnam spangs pa/ /de ni gang dang gar song ⑧ba/ /de dang de ⑨ni mchod par 'gyur/ /mkhas gang 'tsho ba'i 'jig rten na/ /dad dang shes rab sten byed pa/ /de dag de yi nor mchog ste/ /de yi nor gzhan phal par zad/ /'phags pa lta bar 'dod pa dang / /dam chos nyan par dga' ba dang / /ser sna'i dri ma rnam spangs pa/ /de ni dad pa can zhes bya/ /dad pa'i lam brgyags bskur ⑩bar bya—/ /bsod nams chom pos dbrog mi nus/ /chom rkun 'phrog par byed pa 83—25

bzlog① /dge sbyong ②rnams kyis blangs na dga'/ /mkhas pas dge sbyong 'ongs pa la/ /mngon par dga' bar byed 'gyur zhing / /skye bo rnams ni ci rigs par/ /dad pa ji bzhin sbyin byed cing / /gzhan gyi zas dang skom de la—/ /gang zhig yid ni mi bde ba/ /des ni nyin dang mtshan rnams su/ /ting 'dzin thob par mi 'gyur ro/ /gang gis ta la'i ①mgo bcad ltar/ /de 'dra kun du gcod byed pa/ /des ni nyin dang mtshan rnams su/ /ting nge 'dzin dag thob par 'gyur/ /khron pa skam po ji lta b.rarjo/ /dad pa med pa bsten mi bya//ji ste de la yongs brkos ⑤kyang / /'dam chu dri nga 'byung bar zad/ /chu mang rnam par dang ba dang / /bsel bar gyur cing rnyog 0med pa'i/ /mtsho la chu 'dong ji lta bar/ /shes rab can gyis dad ldan bsten/ /chags sam ma chags kyang rung ste//de yis thub sku mi ngas pasadze+e/ /ma dad pa dag spang bar bya/ /dad pa rnams ni nye bar bsten/ /dad pa'i tshoms te bcu pa'o / /sdesdom la/ mi rtag 'dod dang sred pa dang / /bag yod de bzhin dga' ba dang / /tshul khrims legs spyod tshig dag dang / /las dang dad pa de dag bas: —/ / //stibram zes 'dod pa rab spang zhing / /brtson 'grus kyis ni rgyun chod cig /'dod pa rab tu ma spangs par/ /thub pa gcig gis ma ⑩thob bo/ /kun du rgyu ba zhan pa dag /nyon mongs phyir yang kun stsogs pas/ /brtson 'grus brtan po ⑩kho na yis/ /bya ba de nyid byed la rag / zhan pa'i las ⑫ni ji snyed dang ⑫/ /kun nas nyon mongs dka' thub dang / /tshangs spyod yongs su 83—26

ma dag de/ /don chen 'gyur snyam mi byed do/ /ji ltar mda' ni bzung ①nyes pas / /lag pa chod par gyur pa ltar/ /dge sbyong bsrung ba bya nyes pas/ /dmyal bar nye bar khrid par byed/ /ji ltar mda' ni bzung ①legs pas/ /lag pa chod par mi 'gyur ltar/ /dge sbyong bsrung ba bya legs na/ /mya ngan 'das par nye bar 'dren/ /dge sbyong rnam par ma shes dang / /rgal ④bar dka' dang bzod dka' dhidang / /gang dag zhan ⑤pa 'gyod 'gyur ba'idu/ /sdug bsngal mang po de dag 'byung / /yang dang yang du 'gyod pa yi/ /kun rtog dbang du 'gro ba yi/ /sems ni bzlog par ma byas par/ /dge sbyong spyod pa ji ltar byame/ /nyes par rab byung nyes dga' ba/ /khyim 'dug nyes rtsom byed pa dag /sdug bsngal mnyam med bsten pa dang ⑧/ /yang srid sdug bsngal stsogs par zad/ /tshem bu ngur smrig gyon pa dang ⑨/ /phal cher yang dag mi sdom zhing / /sdig pa'i chos can sdig la dga'/ /sdig can de dag ngan 'gror 'gro/ /sā ⑩la'i shing la 'khri ⑪shing ltar/ /gang zhig shin tu khrims 'chal te/ /ji ltar rang la dgra bzhin du/ /de ni de ltar byed par 'dod/ /mgo bo skya bor gyur bar du/ /da dung rgan rabs ma chud pa/ /de ni lang tsho gtugs pa ste—/ /de ni rgan blun zhes bya'o/ /gang zhig dge dang sdog pa dag /spangs shing tshangs par spyod pa dang / /sde tshogs spangs nas spyod byed pa/ /de ni rgan rabs zhes bya'o/ /brtul zhugs med cing brdzun smra na/ /mgo bo byegs tsam dge sbyong min—/ /rmongs pa 'dod la zhugs pa dag /ji ga dge sbyong yin nam kye/ /brtul zhugs med cing brdzun smra na/ /mgo bo byegs tsam dge sbyong min/ /gang zhig sdig pa zhi gyur te⑫/ /mkhas pas dge spyong yin par shes/ /brtul zhugs med cing 83—27

brdzun smra na/ /mgo bo byegs tsam dge sbyong min/ /gang dag sdig pa che phra dag /kun la brtags nas byed pa dang / /sdig pa zhi ba de dag ni/ /dge sbyong nyid ces brjod par bya/ /sdig pa spangs pa bram ze ste/ /zhi bar spyod pa dge sbyong yin—/ /bdag gi dri ma rab spangs pa/ /des na rab tu byung zhes brjod/ /dge sbyong gi tshoms te bcu gcig pa'o// //gang tshe 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi/ /shes rab kyis ni mthong ba dang / /lam 'dir rab tu shes pa yis/ /srid pa'i sred pa rab tu 'dral/ /dper na rlung gis rdul babe+eng ba/ /char pa 'bab ①pas zhi byed ltar/ /gang tshe shes rab kyis mthong ba/ /de tshe kun rtog zhi bar 'gyur/ /gang zhig legs par rtogs pa yis②/ /skye shi legs par zad 'gyur zhing / /'jig rten nges 'byed 'gyur ba yi/ /shes rab de ni gtso bo yin/ /bden pa'i nang na bden bzhi dang / /lam nang yan lag ①brgyad pa mchog /rkang gnyis nang na mig can dang / /chos kyi nang na chags bral mchog /'du byed thams cad mi rtag par/ /gang tshe shes rab kyis mthong ba/ /de tshe sdug bsngal las yid 'byung / /lam 'di rnam par dag par 'gyur/ /'du byed thams cad sdug bsngal bar/ /gang tshe shes rab kyis mthong ba/ /de dutshe sdug bsngal las yid 'byung / /lam 'di rnam par dag par 'gyur/ /'du byed thams cad stong nyid du/ /gang tshe shes rab kyis mthong ba/ /de tshe sdug bsngal las yid 'byung / /lam 'di rnam par dag par 'gyur/ /'du byed thams cad bdag med par/ /gang tshe shes rab kyis mthong ba/ /de tshe sdug bsngal las yid 83—28

'byung / /lam 'di rnam par dag par 'gyur/ /sred pa'i zug rngu gcod byed lam—/ /ngas ni khyed cag rnams la bstan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ston pa ste//khyed cag rnams kyis bya dgos so/ /sred pa'i zug rngu sel ba'i lam ngas ni khyed cag rnams la bstan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ston pa ste/ /khyed cag rnams kyis bya dgos so/ /lta ba rnam par dag byed pa①/ /lam 'di ma gtogs gzhan med pas/ /ting nge 'dzin la rab gnas ②te/ /bdud kyi 'ching ba spang bar gyis/ /'di ni drang lam 'di ni skepha rol gnonarjo/ /mtsho la ngang pa'i srang ltar bgrod pa gcig⑤ /shākya thub pas mnyam bzhag gang rtogs nas/ /tshogs la yang dang yang du bshad pa 'di/ /skye shi'i mtha' rtogs phan mdzad thugs brtse bas/ /bgrod pa gcig lam rab tu bstan mdzad pa'i—/ /lam 'dis duchu bo rnams las sngon rgal ⑦zhing / /de bzhin rgal bar 'grur zhing rgal ⑧bar mdzad/ /shin tu mthar thug ⑨gdul bya dag bya dang / /'khor ba'i skye shi zad par bya ba dang / /khams rnams du ma so sor rtogs bya'i phyir—/ /spyan dang ldan pas lam 'di rab tu bstan/ /ji ltar chu klung gang bā'i ⑩chu rgyun zhugs⑫/ /rgya mtsho'i nang du 'bab par 'gyur ba ltar/ /de bzhin shes rab yangs pas bstan pa'i lam/ /'di ni 'chi med thob par bya ⑫phyir 'jug /gang zhig 'byung po kun la thugs brtse bas/ /sngon chad ma thos chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /skyob pa lha dang mi rnams 'dul mdzad pa/ /srid pa'i mthar phyin de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam rtog dge ba gsum ni brtag ⑫bya zhing / /dge ba ma yin gsum yang rnam par spangs⑫/ /kun nas rdul langs ⑫char gyis mnan pa ltar/ /de nas rtog dang dpyod pa zhi bar bya/ /de nas 83—29

sems la rnam rtog nyer zhi nas①/ /bla med byang chub bde la reg par 'gyur/ /ting 'dzin gsum po rnams la yid gtad cing / /bden ②pa las skyes tshad med bsgom par bya/ /dran ldan mkhas pas mdud pa zhi bya zhing / /gsum pa ④rnams kyis gnas rjogasum rab tu dral/ /shes rab mtshon dang brtson 'grus stobs dang ldan/ /dran ldan mnyam bzhag ⑤ting 'dzin la dga' bas/ /'jig rten skye dang 'jig par rtogs nas ni/ /kun las rjorab tu rnam grol de rig yin/ /'jig rten mtha' ⑦ma legs par rtogs gyur nas/ /'jig rten mthar son pha rol phyin zhes brjod/ /gang gis ⑧zhi ba 'phags lam yan lag brgyad—/ /lam drang bsgoms pa des ni bdud rtsi rnyed/ /de ltar spyod pas bde 'dod bde ba 'thob/ /snyan pa 'thob ⑨cing grags pa 'phel bar 'gyur/ /lam gyi tshoms te bcu gnyis pa'o// //ched du brjod pa'i tshoms/ bam po gnyis pa/ dre'u mo rang gi mngal gyis dang / /'dam bu sbyig ⑩ma 'bras bus dang / /chu shing 'bras bus bung ⑪ba ltar/ /pho bshal bkur stes ⑫phung bar 'gyur/ /ji srid blun po mchod byas pa/ /de srid rab tu brlag par 'gyur/ /byis pa'i ⑫dkar po'i cha 'grib cing / /de yi spyi bo'ang nges par nyams/ /ngan pa rnyed pa 'dod pa dang / /dge slong 'khor ni 'dod pa dang / /gnas la ser sna byed pa dang ④//rigs gzhan dag gis mchod pa dang / /rab tu byung dang khyim pa dag /gang yang rung bas ⑫bdag 'phrigs te/ /bya ba byas rung ma byas rung / /bdag dbang gyur ⑩na re stes zhes/ /de ltar byis pa kun rtog na/ /sems la 'dod 83—30

chen 'phel bar 'gyur/ /rnyed pa'i thabs ni gzhan yin la/ /mya ngan 'das 'gro'i ①gzhan yin zhes/ /de ltar ci rigs shes nas su/ /bkur ste dag la mi dga' zhing / /dben pa rim gyis 'phel byed pa'i/ /dge slong sangs rgyas nyan thos yin/ /thams cad la ni mi rtsol du zhing / /mi yis 'phrigs par ma gyur dang ①/ /'tsho ba gzhan la mi rten ④cing / /chos la tshong ba bzhin mi spyad/ /rang gi rnyed pa blang bya zhing / /gzhan gyi la ni 'dod mi skyed⑤/ /dge slong gzhan gyi du'adod byed pas④/ /ting 'dzin thob par mi 'gyur ro/ /gal te bde bar 'tsho 'dod cing / /dge sbyong 'di la lta 'dod na/ /dge 'dun gyis ⑧ni chos gos dang / /bza' btung byin par gyur na blang / /gal te bde bar 'tsho 'dod cing / /dge sbyong ⑨'di la lta 'dod na/ /byi ba'i khung nas sbrul lta bur⑩/ /gnas mal dag la bsten ⑪par gyis/ /gal te bde bar 'tsho 'dod cing / /dge sbyong 'di la lta 'dod na/ /ngan ngon tsam gyis chog shes shing / /chos gcig po yang bsgom par bya/ /gal te mang po ⑫mi shes shing / /tshul khrims legs par mnyam bzhag ⑫na/ /de shes pa dag 'tsho dag cing / /snyom las med ces stod ④par byed/ /gal te 'chi bdag nyams byed pa'i/ /zag med rig pa gsum ldan na/ /blun pos ⑫ci yang mi shes zhes//bsams nas de la 'phya yang sla⑩/ /gang zag sdig pa'i chos can la/ /gal te bza' dang btung ba yi/ /rnyed pa dag dang ldan gyur na/ /de la de dag mchod pa ⑩byed/ /mgo byegs ngur smrig byes pa yi⑫/ /bza' ba dang ni btung ba dang / /gos dang mal cha rnyed pa stespyo/ /dgra byed mang ba kho nar zad—/ /de ltar bkur ste 'jigs chen gyidu/ /skyon rnams khong du chud byas 83—31

nas—/ /'phrigs nyung sems khral bskyungs nas su/ /dran ldan dge slong kun du rgyus/ /kham gyi ①zas kyis sems zhir mi 'gyur yang / /'tsho ba 'di phyir mi bza' mi bya ste/ /kha zas kyis ni lus dag gnas 'gyur ba/ /de ltar rtogs la bsod snyoms dag la rgyus/ /rigs kyis phyag byas mchod pa gang yin 'di—/ /zug rngu phra ma ①dbyung bar dka' ①ba ste/ /mi yis bzod dka' bkur ste gang yin 'di/ /'dam dang 'dra bar rab tu rtogs par gyis/ /bkur ste'i tshoms te bcu gsum pa'o // //④sdig pa'i las ni mi byed pa/ /'khu bya min la gang 'khu ba/ /'jig rten 'di dang pha rol tu/ /de nyid sdig pa rnams kyis gos/ /dang por bdag ni phung byed cing / /phyi dunas gzhan yang phung byed pa/ /khra yi gzan ma'i bya lta bur/ /phung zhing gzhan yang phung bar byedadu/ /rdeg par byed pas rdeg ⑦pa 'thob/ /'khon du 'dzin pas 'khon ④can mthong / /de bzhin gshe bas gshe ba ste/ /khro bar byed la khro ba 'byung / /'di gzhan dge sbyong byis pa ste / /dam pa'i chos la mi mkhas pa/ /yongs su tshe thung 'di la yang gyi na'i phyir ni 'khon par ⑨byed/ /'di ni mchog ces bsams nas su/ /so sor smra zhing mthun ⑩'jug pas/ /'di na dge 'dun 'byed pa'i tshe/ /ci phyir stobs med sems mi byed/ /rus pa gcog cing srog gcod la/ /rta phyugs nor ni 'phrog ⑪pa dang / /yul 'khor 'joms par byed pa yang / /phyi nas 'jal ⑩dum byed pa ltar/ /mkhas pas brtags shing gsungs pa'i tshig /spyod yul ston par byed pa yi/ /chos 'di rnam par shes na go/ /khyed cag 83—32

ci phyir byed mi ①'gyur/ /khyod ni mi mkhas lugs can te/ /kha bya yis ni rtsol byed pa/ /pha rol po dag mi shes pas/ /bdag ni 'di la brtson par byed—/ /'di na ①mkhas pa gang yin pa/ /de dag bzhams pa'i tshig gis zhi/ /bdag la kha zer bdag la gshe/ /bdag pham bdag pham byed pa'o zhes/ /'di gang sems la 'dzin byed pa/ /de yi 'khon ni zhi mi 'gyur/ /bdag la kha zer bdag la gshe/ /bdag pham bdag pham byed pa'o zhes/ /'di gang sems la mi 'dzin pa/ /de yi 'khon ni zhi bar 'gyur/ /'di na 'khon gyis 'khon can dag /nam yang zhi bar 'gyur ba med/ /bzod pas 'khon ni zhi 'gyur ba/ /'di ni chos kyi rang bzhin yin/ /'khon kyis 'khon can nam yang zhi mi 'gyur/ /'khon med rnams kyis 'khon ni zhi bar byed①/ /sha khon zhugs pa lus can la gnod pas/ /de phyir mkhas pas 'khon par mi bya'o/ /brtan pa legs gnas lhan cig spyad pa yi/ /grogs po mkhas pa gal te rnyed na niske/ /nyon mongs thams cad mngon par zil mnan nas/ /dran ldan dga' ba'i yid kyis de dang spyad/ /brtan pa legs gnas lhan cig spyad pa yi/ /grogs po mkhas pa gal te ma rnyed na/ /yul 'khor yangs pa spangs pa'i rgyal po ltar—/ /gcig pus spyad bya sdig pa mi bya'o/ /bdag dang mthun par spyod pa yi—/ /grogs bzang rnyed par ma gyur na/ /byis pa grogs su mi 'gyur bas/ /gcig pus spyod pa brtan par bya/ /byes pa grogs su mi 'gyur bas/ /gcig pu spyod par byed sla dubs/ /ma tang ⑤dgon pa'i glang po ltar/ /sems khral bsgyungs te gcig pu duspyad/ /'khu ba'i tshoms te bcu bzhi pa'o// //83—33

sangs rgyas kyis ni bstan pa bzhin/ /gang gi dbugs dbyung ①rngub dran pa—/ /yongs su rdzogs par legs bsgoms pas/ /rim gyis yongs su byang gyur ④te/ /sprin bral nyi ma zla ba ltar/ /'jig rten 'di na kun nas gsal/ /'greng dang 'dug dang de bzhin nyal ba dang ①/ /lus dang de bzhin sems ni 'jog byed cing / /dge slong dran pa de legs 'jog pa na/ /snga phyi'i khyad par rnams ni 'thob ④par 'gyur/ /snga phyi'i khyad par rnams ni thob gyur na/ /'chi bdag rgyal pos bltar yang med par 'gro/ /lus rtogs dran pa nye bar bzhag dunas su/ /reg pa'i skye mched drug ni bsdams byas te/ /gang zhig rtag tu mnyam par 'jog byed pa/ /de bdag dhinyid kyis mya ngan 'das pa rtogs—/ /gang zhig rtag tu rnam pa thams cad du/ /lus rtogs dran pa nye bar 'jog byed pa/ /bdag nyid med cing bdag gir 'dzin pa med/ /bdag tu mi 'gyur bdag gir 'dzin mi 'gyur/ /de ltar dge slong mnyam 'jog myur du ni/ /yul la sred pa dag las rgal bar 'gyur/ /gang zhig dran dang shes bzhin mnyam 'jog dang / /dga' dang rab tu dang bas dus dus su/ /chos 'di la spyod mel tse ④byed pa de/ /skye rga rnams las rgal ⑧bar 'gyur zhes gsung / /de ltas rtag tu mel tse byed sten ⑨cing / /dge slong mkhas pa dran ldan brtson pa yis/ /skye ba ⑩kun du sbyor ba spangs nas su/ /des ni 'di la mya ngan 'das pa 'thob/ /gnyid log de dag sad par ⑪byed pa yi—/ /mel tse bdag las ⑫khyod nyon cig /nyal bas mel tse byed sla ⑫ste/ /mel tse byed la 'jigs pa med/ /mel tse byed par ⑫brtson pa dang / /nyin mtshan rjes su slob byed cing / /'chi ba med la lhag mos pa'i/ /zag pa 83—34

rnams ni zad par 'gyur/ /gang zhig nyin dang mtshan rnams su/ /sangs rgyas rjes su dran byed cing / /gang dag sangs rgyas skyabs song ba/ /de dag mi yi rnyed pa yin/ /gang zhig nyin dang mtshan rnams su/ /chos rnams rjes su dran byed cing / /gang dag chos la skyabs song ba/ /de dag mi yi rnyed pa yin—/ /gang zhig nyin dang mtshan rnams su/ /dge 'dun rjes su dran byed cing / /gang dag dge 'dun skyabs song ba/ /de dag mi yi rnyed pa yin/ /gang zhig nyin dang mtshan rnams su/ /sangs rgyas rjes su dran byed pa/ /go ta ma yi nyan thos de①/ /legs par sad pas sad par ①'gyur/ /gang zhig nyin dang mtshan rnams su/ /chos rnams rjes su dran byed pa/ /go ta ma yi nyan thos de/ /legs par sad pas sad par 'gyur/ /gang zhig nyin dang mtshan rnams su/ /dge 'dun rjes su dran byed pa/ /go ta ma yi nyan thos de//legs par sad pas sad par 'gyur/ /gang zhig nyin dang mtshan rnams su/ /tshul khrims rjes su dran byed pa/ /go ta ma yi nyan thos de/ /legs par sad pas sad par 'gyur/ /gang zhig nyin dang mtshan rnams su/ /gtong ba rjes su dran byed pa/ /go ta ma yi nyan thos de/ /legs par sad pas sad par 'gyur—/ /gang zhig nyin dang mtshan rnams su/ /lha ni rjes su dran byed pa④//go ta ma yi nyan thos de/ /legs par sad pas sad par 'gyur/ /gang zhig nyin dang mtshan rnams su/ /rtag tu lus rtogs dran byed pa/ /go ta ma yi nyan thos de/ /legs par sad pas sad par 'gyur/ /gang zhig nyin dang mtshan rnams su/ /rtag tu ting 'dzin bzhi dran pa/ /go ta ma yi nyan thos de//legs par sad pas sad par 'gyur/ /gang zhig nyin dang mtshan rnams su/ /83—35

'tshe ba med la yid dga' ba/ /gau ta ma yi nyan thos de/ /legs par sad pas sad par 'gyur/ /gang zhig nyin dang mtshan rnams su/ /gnod sems med ①la yid dga' ba/ /go ta ma yi nyan thos de/ /legs par sad pas sad par 'gyur/ /gang zhig nyin dang mtshan rnams su/ /bsgom pa la ni yid dga' ba/ /go ta ma yi nyan thos de/ /legs par sad pas sad par 'gyur/ /gang zhig nyin dang mtshan rnams su/ /stong pa nyid la yid dga' ba/ /go ta ma yi nyan thos de/ /legs par sad pas sad par 'gyur/ /gang zhig nyin dang mtshan rnams su/ /mtshan ma med la yid dga' ba/ /go ta ma yi nyan thos de/ /legs par sad pas sad par 'gyur/ /gang zhig nyin dang mtshan rnams su/ /dbe+en pa la ni yid dga' ba/ /go ta ma yi nyan thos de/ /legs par sad pas sad par 'gyur/ /gang zhig nyin dang mtshan rnams su/ /nges par 'byung la yid dga' ba/ /go ①ta ma yi nyan thos de/ /legs par sad pas sad par 'gyur/ /gang zhig nyin dang mtshan rnams su/ /ci yang med la yid dga' ba/ /go ta ma yi nyan thos de/ /legs par sad pas sad par 'gyur/ /gang zhig nyin dang mtshan rnams su/ /mya ngan 'das la yid dga' ba/ /go ta ma yi nyan thos de/ /legs par sad pas sad par 'gyur/ /dran pa'i tshoms te bcwa 1lnga pa'o// //bdag gi bya ba bya ba'i rjodus g.yo bas/ /dang po kho nar bya ba'i mel tse gyis—/ /bdag gis dang po de ltar byas na ⑤ni/ /bya ba bya ba'i dus ltar duzad 'dod cing / /ji ltar 'dod pa de bzhin 'byor 'gyur bar/ /de yi 83—36

rang bzhin nga yis mthong bas na/ /ji srid don ni phun sum tshogs 'gyur ba/ /de srid bar du mi yis bsgrim par gyis/ /bsgrim zhing brtson par bya ba yis/ /bdag nyid gling du 'gyur bar bya/ /mgar ba yis ni dngul bzhin du/ /rang gi dri ma sbyang bar gyis/ /dri ma sbyangs pa ①skyon mi 'byung 1 / /phyi nas skye dang rga mi 'thob/ /ngo tsha min la ngo tsha zhing / /ngo tsha ba la ngo mi tsha/ /mi 'jigs pa la 'jigs lta dang / /'jigs la mi 'jigs lta ba yi/ /log par lta ba blangs pa yis/ /sems can ngan 'gror 'gro bar 'gyur/ /'di na gang sngon bag med las/ /phyi nas bag dang ldan gyur ①te/ /sprin bral nyi ma zla ba ltar/ /'jig rten 'di na kun nas gsal/ /'di na gang sngon bag med las/ /phyi nas bag dang ldan gyur rjote/ /'jig rten 'di na sred pa las/ /dran pa rjolegs par 'da' bar 'gyur/ /gang zhig gzhon nur rab byung nas/ /sangs rgyas bstan la 'jug pa derjo/ /sprin bral nyi ma zla ba ltar/ /'jig rten 'di na kun nas gsal/ /gang zhig gzhon nur rab byung nas/ /sangs rgyas bstan la 'jug pa de/ /'jig rten 'di na sred pa las/ /dran pas legs par 'da' bar 'gyur/ /gang zhig sdig pa'i las byas pa/ /dge bas 'gebs par byed pa de/ /sprin bral nyi ma zla ba ltar/ /'jig rten 'di na kun nas gsal/ /gang zhig sdig pa'i las byas pa/ /dge bas 'gebs par byed pa de/ /'jig rten 'di na sred pa las/ /dran pas legs par 'da' bar 'gyur/ /gang zhig gson la mi dga' ba/ /de ni shi na'ang mya ngan med/ /brtan pa go 'phang mthong ba de/ /mya ngan dbus na'ang ⑦gdung mi 'gyur/ /gang zhig gson la mi dga' ba/ /de ni shi na'ang mya ngan med/ /brtan pa go 83—37

'phang mthong ba de/ /gnyen 'dun dbus na lam mer 'dug /dge slong dkar po bsgom gyis la/ /nag po'i chos ①ni rnam par spongs/ /khyim nas khyem med song nas su/ /spyod yul dbe+en pa gang yin pa/ /de la mngon par dga' babe+eb cing / /'dod pa ci yang med par spongs/ /rtag tu snying po dag pa dang / /rtag tu gso sbyong dag pa dang / /gtsang ma'i las ni dag pa de'i—/ /brtul zhugs phun sum tshogs par 'gyur/ /zhing gi skyon ni rtswa yin ltar—/ /skye dgu 'di la 'dod chags skyon/ /de bas 'dod chags bral rnams la/ /byin na 'bras bu chen por 'gyur/ /zhing gi skyon ni rtswa yin ltar/ /skye dgu 'di la zhe sdang skyon/ /de bas zhe sdang bral rnams la/ /byen na 'bras bu chen por 'gyur/ /zhing gi skyon ni rtswa yin ltar/ /skye dgu 'di la gti mug skyon—/ /de bas gti mug bral rnams la/ /byin na 'bras bu chen por 'gyur//zhing gi skyon ni rtswa yin ltar/ /skye dgu 'di la nga rgyal skyon/ /de bas nga rgyal bral rnams la/ /byin na 'bras bu chen por 'gyur/ /zhing gi ②skyon ni rtswa yin ltar—/ /skye dgu 'di la chags pa skyon/ /de bas chags dang bral rnams la/ /byin na 'bras bu chen por 'gyur/ /zhing gi skyon ni rtswa yin ltar/ /skye dgu 'di la sred pa skyon/ /de bas sred dang bral rnams la/ /byin na 'bras bu chen por 'gyur/ /drug pa bdag po rgyal po ste/ /chags par gyur na chags can yin/ /ma chags gyur na ma chags ①yin/ /chags pa byis pa zhes brjod do—/ /'dod chags zhe sdang nga rgyal dang / /'chab pa gang du gnas pa yirjo/ /grong khyen rus pa'i ra ba can/ /sha dang khrag gis zhal zhal byas/ /rgyu yis kun nas babe+eng ba las byung sdug bsngal can/ /de ma mthong na der ni de dag 83—38

'ching 'gyur zhing / /de dag rtogs na chu bo rnams ni rab tu spong / /phyi rol pa la chags pa de dag spong ba med/ /sel bu'i tshoms te bcu drug pa'o// //de dag khyim la mi dga' bar/ /dran dang ldan pa 'bad pa yis/ /ngang pas mtsho ngan spong ba ltar/ /de dag khyim spangs chu bo rgal/ /brtan pa 'jig rten nges byung ①nas/ /bdud kyi sde rnams rab bcom ste/ /nyi ma'i lam nas ngang pa ltar/ /rdzu 'phrul gyis ni mkha' la 'gro/ /tshangs par spyod pa ma spyad cing / /gzhon nur ②nor ni ma rnyed pa/ /mtsho ngan nya nyung ngogs dag na/ /chu skyar rgan sems bzhin du 'gyur/ /tshangs par spyod pa ma spyad cing / /gzhon nur snenor ni ma rnyed pa/ /sngon chad byas pa rjes dran zhing rjo/ /lus bskums nas ni nyal bar 'gyur/ /sdig pa chung byas bdag nyid kyi⑤/ /phyi bzhin mi 'ong ma sems shig /chu yi thigs pa lhung ba yis/ /bum chen gang ba ji bzhin du/ /chung zad chung zad bsags pa yi/ /sdig pas byis pa gang bar 'gyur/ /dge ba chung byas bdag nyid kyi⑦/ /phyi bzhin mi 'ang ⑦ma sems shig /chu yi thigs pa lhung ba yisasge/ /bum chen gang ba ji bzhin du/ /chung zad chung zad bsags pa yi/ /dge bas brtan pa gang bar 'gyur/ /gang zhig rags brtsigs mtsho ngan spangs/ /rgya mtsho'i chu bo rgal 'dod pa/ /skye bos gzings ni bcas nas kyang / /skye bo mkhas pa rgal ⑨bar byed/ /rgal ⑩nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /bram ze skam sar gnas par mdzad/ /de la dge slong khrus byed cing / /nyan thos rnams kyis gzings kyang bcas/ /ji ltar mtsho chen zab mo dag /rab tu mnam dang ⑪rnyog med ltar/ /de 83—39

bzhin mkhas pa rab dang pas/ /'di ni ①chos ni nyan par byed/ /'di ltar kun na dze+echu yod pas/ /su zhig tshol ①zhing rgyu byed de/ /khron pa'i rjochu lta ci zhig dgos/ /sred pa rtsa nas gcad par gyis⑤/ /btso blag mkhan dag chus 'khru zhing / /mda' mkhan mes ni srong ba dang / /shing mkhan shing la 'jog sbyong ltar/ /mkhas pas bdag nyid gdul rjobar bya/ /nam mkha' lta bur chags med cing / /sgo them ⑦lta bur g.yo ba med/ /rnyog pa ⑧can gyi mtsho lta bur/ /mkhas pa 'khor ba la mi dga'/ /chu'i tshoms te bcu bdun pa'o// //lhar bcas gshin rje'i 'jig rten 'di⑨/ /sa stengs las rgyal gang zhing ⑩lags—/ /me tog lta bur rab 'dod pa'i/ /chos bzhi ⑪legs par ston mkhas ⑫gang / /lhar bcas gshin rje'i 'jig rten 'di⑫/ /sa stengs las rgyal slob pa yi⑫/ /me tog lta bur rab 'dod pa'i/ /chos bzhi ⑫legs par ston mkhas de⑩/ /nags tshal las ni 'jigs skyes phyir/ /nags tshal gcad ⑩kyi shing ma yin/ /nags dang nags sbyor chod cig dang / /dge sbyong snyemya ngan 'da' bar 'gyur/ /gal te nags sbyor ma bcad na/ /phra rab kyis kyang mi rnams skye/ /ma drung nu zho 'dod be+e'u ltar/ /de yis yid ni rab tu 'ching / /lag pas ston ka'i pad+ma ltar/ /bdag la dga' ba bcad nas su/ /rgyal gsungs mya ngan 'das pa'i ⑪phyir/ /zhi ba'i lam nyid bskyed par gyis/ /ji ltar me tog yid 'ong ba/ /kha dog bzang yang dri med ltar/ /de bzhin legs par gsungs pa'i tshig /'bras bu med par ma byed cig /⑩ji ltar bung ba me tog gi/ /kha dog dri la mi gnod par/ /khu ba gzhibs ⑪nas 83—40

'phur ba ltar/ /de bzhin thub pa grong du rgyu/ /gzhan gyi skyon la mi brtag cing / /gzhan gyis ①byas dang ma byas min/ /bdag nyid kyis ni rigs pa dang / /mi rigs bya la brtag ②par bya/ /ji ltar phyag dar phung po dag /mi gtsang chu ni ④med 'di las/ /pad+ma kha bye gtsang ba dang / /dri zhim yid 'ong rab skyes ltar/ /de bzhin so so ④skye bo dag /ldongs ⑤gyur phyag dar phung 'di las/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi nyan thos dag /shes rab kyis ni gsal ba 'byung rjo/ /ji ltar me tog phung po las/ /me tog phreng rgyud dze+emang byed ltar/ /de bzhin mir ni skyes pa yis/ /dge ba phal chen rnams kyang bya/ /ji ltar dbyar ka ba ku la'i/ /me tog rab tu rnam 'brul ltar/ /de bzhin dge slong 'dod chags dang / /zhe sdang gti mug spang bar dze+ekyis/ /mi yi yid la rnam chags dang ⑨/ /me tog bzhin du rab bsags ⑩pa/ /'chi bdag gis ni blangs nas 'gro/ /nyal grong chu bos bdas pa bzhin/ /mi yi yid la rnam chags dag /me tog bzhin du rab bsags pa/ /'dod pa rnams kyis mi ngoms shing / /'chi bdag gis ni dbang du byed/ /mi yi yid la rnam chags dag /me tog bzhin du rab bsags pa/ /longs spyod skye bar mi 'gyur zhing / /'chi bdag gis ni dbang du byed/ /mi yi yid la rnam chags dag /me tog bzhin du rab bsags pa/ /bya ba mthar ni ma phyin par/ /'chi bdag gis ni dbang du byed/ /lus 'di bum pa 'dra bar rtogs byas shing //de bzhin chos rnams smig rgyu 'drar shes nas/ /bdud kyi me tog mchog ni 'dir gcod ⑪pa/ /'chi bdag rgyal pos bltar yang med par 'gro/ /'jig rten 'di dag bum pa 'drar rtogs shing / /de bzhin chos rnams smig rgyu 'drar 83—41

shes nas/ /bdud kyi me tog mchog ni 'dir gcod pa/ /'chi bdag rgyal pos bltar yang med par 'gro/ /lus 'di dbu ba 'dra bar rtogs byas shing / /de bzhin chos rnams smig rgyu 'drar shes nas/ /bdud kyi me tog mchog ni 'dir gcod pa/ /'chi bdag rgyal pos bltar yang med par 'gro/ /'jig rten 'di dag dbu ba 'drar rtogs shing / /de bzhin chos rnams smig rgyu 'drar shes nas/ /bdud kyi me tog mchog ni 'dir gcod pa/ /'chi bdag rgyal pos bltar yang rnged par 'gro/ /srid pa u dum bā ra'i me tog ltar/ /snying po med par sems pa'i dge slong gang / /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol po/ /spong ste sbrul rgas lpags rnying rje ba bzhin/ /chu skyes rtsa ba'i me tog chu gnas lta'i// 'dod chags ①ma lus gcod byed dge slong gang / /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol po/ /spong ste sbrul rgas lpags rnying rje ba bzhin/ /chu skyes rtsa ba'i me tog chu gnas lta'i/ /zhe sdang ma lus gcod byed dge slong gang / /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol po/ /spong ste sgrul rgas lpags rnying rje ba bzhin/ /chu skyes rtsa ba'i me tog chu gnas lta'i/ /gti mug ma lus gcod byed dge slong gang / /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol po/ /spong ste sbrul rgas lpags rnying rje ba bzhin/ /chu skyes rtsa ba'i me tog chu gnas lta'i/ /nga rgyal ma lus gcod byed dge slong gang / /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol po/ /spong ste sbrul rgas lpags rnying rje ba bzhin/ /chu skyes rtsa ba'i me tog chu gnas lta'i/ /chags pa ma lus gcod byed dge slong gang / /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol po/ /spong ste sbrul rgas lpags rnying rje ba bzhin/ /chu skyes rtsa ba'i me tog chu gnas lta'i/ /sred pa ma lus gcod byed dge slong gang / /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol po/ /spong ste 83—42

sbrul rgas lngags rnying rje ba bzhin/ /me tog gi tshoms te bco brgyad pa'o// //ji ltar rta bzangs lcag gis gzhus ①pa na/ /skrag cing shugs drag 'gro byed ji bzhin du/ /dad pa tshul khrims ting 'dzin ldan pa dang / /chos rnams rnam par gtan la 'be+ebs ldan zhing / /dbang po mnyam gzhag bzod ldan 'grogs bde ba/ /skyob pa de rnams srid pa ma lus spong / /ji ltar rta bzangs lcag gis gzhus ②pa na/ /skrag cing shugs drag 'gro byed ji bzhin du/ /dad pa tshul khrims ting 'dzin ldan pa dang / /chos rnams rnam par gtan ⑦la 'bebs ldan zhing / /rig dang rkang par ldan zhing dran duldan pa'i/ /skyob rnams sdug bsngal ma lus spong bar mdzad/ /'dul sbyong byed pas legs btul rta lta bur/ /gang zhig dbang po legs par sdom pa yis/ /khro ba spong zhing zag pa zad byed pa/ /thub de rnams kyis lha yi bar du myong / /bag yod pa yis bag med dang / /mi nyal mang pos gnyid log dang / /rta bzangs kyis ni rta rgod ltar/ /shin tu mkhas pas spangs nas 'gro/ /rta bzangs la ni lcag ⑤bzhin du/ /gang zhig ngo tsha shes sten bucing / /shes rab legs par mnyam gzhag pa/ /des ni sdig pa sel bar byed/ /dul ba 'dun dze+esar 'gro byed cing / /dul ba rgyal po lhag par zhon/ /gang zhig tshig ngan bzod byed pa⑧—/ /dul ba mi yi nang na mchog /glang po'i nang na glang chen dang / /sin du'i ⑨cang shes rta dang ni/ /dre'u 'dul byed pa ⑩gang yin pa/ /de bas bdag nyid 'dul ba mchog /bdag nyid legs 'dul gang yin pa'i/ /mkhas des ⑪zhi ba thob 'gyur gyi/ /bzhon pa de dag rnams kyis ni/ /sa de 83—43

mngon par 'thob mi srid/ /glang po'i nang na glang chen dang / /sin du'i cang shes rta dang ni/ /dre'u 'dul byed pa ①gang yin pa/ /de bas bdag nyid 'dul ba mchog /bdag nyid legs 'dul dran ldan gang / /des ni sdug bsngal mthar phyin gyi/ /bzhon pa de dag rnams kyis ni/ /sa de mngon par 'thob mi srid/ /glang po'i nang na glang chen dang / /sen du'i cang shes rta dang ni/ /dre'u 'dul byed pa ②gang yin pa/ /de bas bdag nyid 'dul ba mchog /bdag nyid legs 'dul dran ldan gang / /des ni 'gro rnams spong 'gyur gyi/ /bzhon ①pa de dag rnams kyis ni/ /sa de mngon par 'thob mi srid—/ /glang po'i nang na glang chen dang / /sen du'i rjocang shes rta dang ni/ /dre'u 'dul byed pa ⑤gang yin pa/ /de bas bdag nyid 'dul ba mchog /bdag nyid legs 'dul gang yin des/ /'ching ba bcad nas 'gro 'gyur gyi/ /bzhon pa de dag rnams kyis ni/ /sa de mngon par 'thob mi srid/ /rjo'adul sbyong byed pas dze+erta bzangs ltar/ /bdag nyid kho na gdul ⑧bar bya/ /bdag nyid legs par 'dul ba yis/ /sdug bsngal rnams kyi pha mthar phyin/ /bdag nyid kho na bdag gi mgon/ /bdag nyid bdag gi skyabs yin pas/ /'dul sbyong byed pas rta bzangs ltar/ /de bas bdag nyid gdul ⑨bar bya/ /rta'i tshoms te bcu dgu pa'o// //khro ba spangs shing nga rgyal rnam spangs na/ /kun sbyor kun las shin tu 'da' 'gyur zhing ⑩/ /ming dang gzugs la chags pa med de dag /ci yang med pas chags pa'i ⑪rjes mi 1nga / /skyes ma thag tu khro ba ⑫spongs/ /skyes 83—44

nas 'dod chags spang bar kyis/ /brtan ①pas ma rig rab tu spang / /bden pa mthong na ①bde bar 'gyur/ /khro ba spangs na ①bde bar nyal/ /khro ba spangs na gdung mi 'gyur/ /dge slong khro ba bde 'joms pa'i/ /dug gi rtsa ba chom shig dudang / /'phags pa rnams kyis bsngags 'gyur zhing / /de bcom pa yis mya ngan med/ /gang khros bdag gis legs byas kyi⑤/ /ma legs min zhes rab smra ba/ /de ni khro ba zhi 'og tu/ /me yis bsregs bzhin gdung bar 'gyur/ /ngo tsha med cing khrel med pa/ /khro ba can la brtul zhugs med/ /khro bas mngon par zil gnon dupa/ /de la su yang rten ⑦mi byed| /gang zhig byis pa'i mthu stobs can/ /de yi stobs ni stobs med yinadze+e—/ /byis pa chos dang bral ba la/ /bsgrub par bya ba yod re skan/ /gang zhig stobs dang ldan gyur yang / /stobs chung rnams kyi ⑨bzod byed pa/ /de ni bzod pa'i mchog ces gsungs/ /nyam chung ba lta rtag tu sgur/ /gang zhig gzhan gyi dpon gyur kyang / /stobs chung rnams kyi ⑩bzod byed pa/ /de ni bzod pa'i mchog ces gsungs⑪/ /nyam chung ba lta rtag tu sgur/ /gzhan gyis lhag par brgyad bkag kyang / /stobs ldan gang zhig bzod byed pa/ /de ni bzod pa'i mchog ces gsungs⑫/ /nyam chung ba lta rtag tu sgur/ /gzhan gyis lhag par smad byas kyang / /stobs ldan gang zhig bzod byed pa/ /de ni bzod pa'i mchog ces gsungs⑫/ /nyam chung ba lta rtag tu sgur/ /gang zhig pha rol khros rig nas/ /bdag nyid nye bar zhi byed pa/ /de ni bdag dang gzhan dag gi/ /'jigs chen dag las skyob pa yin/ /gang zhig pha rol khros rig nas/ /bdag nyid nye bar zhi byed pa/ /de ni bdag dang gzhan dag gi/ /83—45

gnyi ga'i don ni spyod pa yin/ /bdag nyid dang ni gzhan dag dang / /gnyi ga'i don ni ①spyod de la/ /skye bo chos la mi mkhas rnams/ /byis pa yin zhes sems kyang sla②/ /gtso bo'i tshig ni 'jigs phyir bzod byed dang / /thab ①zla'i tshig ni 'thab gcugs rgyu 0bzod pas/ /gang zhig dman pa'i tshig la bzod byed dedu/ /bzod pa'i mchog ces dam pas rab tu gsungs/ /byes pa khros nas tshig rtsub dag /smras na rgyal bar 'gyur snyam sems/ /gang zhig tshig dag bzod byed pa/ /de ni rtag tu rgyal ba yin/ /bden par smra bya khro mi bya—/ /slong la chung yang sbyin par bya/ /rnam pa 'di gsum gnas kyis ni/ /lha yi gnas su 'gro bar 'gyur/ /khro ba'i zil gyis non pa'i mis rang gi don kyang mi rtogs pas/ /'khor gyi nang du bag rkyong dul/ /khro ba med pa'i tshig smros shig /gang zhig khros la be+er khro ba/ /de ni sdog pa can 'gyur bas/ /khros ⑦la slar ni ma khro dang / /thub par dka' ba'i g.yul ⑧las rgyal/ /khro ba med pas khro ba thub/ /legs pas legs pa ma yin thub/ /sbyin pa yis ni 'jungs pa thub/ / bden pas bden pa ⑨ma yin thub/ /dul zhing rigs pas 'tsho ba dang / /khro ba med pa ⑩ga la khro/ /yang dag shes pas rnam grol ba'i—/ /mkhas pa rnams la khro ba med/ /khro ba med la ⑪'tshe med la/ /'phags pa'i skye bos rtag bsten ⑫kyang / /skye bo sdig can khro ba dag /ri bo bzhin du sgur bar byed/ /gang zhig khro ba byung ba dang / /shing rta ⑫'khyams las 'dzin byed de/ /'dul sbyong mkhan du ngas gsungs kyi/ /zhags 'dogs ④skye bo phal ba yin/ /khro ba'i tshoms te nyi shu pa'o / /⑫sdom la/ dge spyong lam dang bkur ste dang / /'khu dang lnga pa dran pa 83—46

ste—/ /sel bu chu dang me tog dang / /rta dang khro ba bcu pa'o // //①'jig rten 'di na kun rig kun zil gnon④/ /'di na chos rnams kun gyis ma gos shing / /kun spangs sred zad rab tu rnam grol ba/ /nyid kyis mngon mkhyen pa la su yis bstan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lha mi'i ston pa ste//stobs rnams kun ldan thams cad mkhyen pa nga / /byang chub brnyes ④nas nyid kyis rab ston pa/ /mtshungs med mnyam med nga la su yis bstan/ /nga ni 'jig rten dgra bcom ste/ /'jig rten dag na bla med nga / /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na/ /bdud rnams zil gnon rgyal ba nga / /nga dang 'dra ba med pas na/ /nga la slob dpon su yang med/ /'jig rten 'di na gcig pu yis—/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub bla med brnyes/ /gang zhig zag pa zad brnyes pa—/ /rgyal ba nga 'drar dushes par gyis/ /sdig pa'i chos las nga rgyal bas/ /de bas nyi rjo'agro nga rgyal ba/ /'jig rten yul sred rgal rjob yi/ /kun mkhyen sangs rgyas mya ngan 'das/ /'jig rten pa la ma bstan par/ /kun nas ⑦'byung ba mi shes pas/ / bā rā ṇa sīr ⑧song nas su/ /ngas ni chos kyi rnga brdung zhing / /'jig rten sus kyang ma bskor ba'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar byas⑨/ /dpa' bo de bzhin gshegs pa rnams/ /'di na chos kyis 'dul bar mdzad/ /de dag chos kyis ⑩btul ba la⑪/ /mkhas pa su yang smod mi byed/ /brtan gang ting 'dzin la zhugs shing / /nges 'byung zhi la dga' ba dang / /sku yi tha ma 'dzin pa yi/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas grags ldan pa/ /shes rab myur ba de dag la/ /lha dang mi rnams dga' bar byed/ /83—47

gang dag 'das pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /gang dag ma byon sangs rgyas dang / /gang dag da ltar rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /mang po'i mya ngan sel mdzad pa/ /bzhugs par gyur cing bzhugs ①pa dang / /de bzhin bzhugs par 'gyur kun gyis—/ /dam chos bla mar mdzad pa 'di/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi chos nyid yin—/ /de bas 'di na bdag dga' zhing / /bdag nyid chen bo mngon 'dod pas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa dran byas te/ /dam pa'i chos la bla mar bya//mi gang sangs rgyas bstan pa la/ /dad pa ma bskyed byis pa de/ /rgud pa'i gnas su 'gro 'gyur te/ /srin mo rnams kyis tshong pa bzhin/ /mi gang sangs rgyas bstan pa la/ /dad pa bskyed pa shes rab can/ /de ni bde bar pha rol 'gro—/ /sprin shugs ldan pas tshong pa bzhin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mnyam med mtshungs pa med/ /bde bar rnam rtog de bzhin rab dben pa'i/ /rnam rtog gnyis po spyod pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /mun bsal pha rol gshegs shing grags dang ldan/ /des ni brnyes sdebya brnyes shing yid dbang gyur①/ /kun grol rjozag zad rab tu rnam par grol/ /rnam grol thugs ldan tha ba zag med rnams—/ /lus can 'jig rten rnams la phan phyir gzigs/ /'ga' ⑤zhig ri bo'i spo la 'dug nas su④/ /'gro ba rnams la kun du lta ba ltar/ /de bzhin blo bzang mya ngan bral ba dag /chos las byung ba'i khang bzangs ⑦steng gshegs nas/ /skye bo skye rgas zil gnon skemya ngan gyes/ /gdungs pa rnams la kun du spyan gzigs nas/ /'chi ba med pa'i sgo mo 'byed mdzad kyis/ /gang dag nyan 'dod the tsom bsal bar byis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshoms te nyi shu gcig pa'o// //83—48

legs par thos dang legs spyod dang / /khyim nas legs par byung ba dang / /spong bar byed pas rab bskor cing / /dge sbyong gi ①ni rjes mthun legs—/ /byis pa mi mkhas pa dag ni/ /'chi ba med pa lta bur spyod/ /mkhas pa dam pa'i chos dag la/ /mtshan mo'i nad pa bzhin du byed/ /ji ltar khyim ni legs g.yogs pa/ /mun pas ②khebs pa'i nang zhugs na/ /gzugs rnams yod par gyur kyang ni/ /mig ldan bzhin du mi mthong ba de bzhin 'di na rigs skyes pa'i/ /mi ni blo gros ldan gyur kyang / /sdig pa dang ni dge ba'i chos/ /ma thos bar du shes mi 'gyur/ /mig ldan mar me yod pa yis—/ /gzugs rnams mthong ba ji lta bar/ /de bzhin dge dang sdig pa'i chos—/ /thos pas rnam par shes par 'gyur/ /thos pas chos rnams rnam par shes/ /thos pas sdig las ldog par 'gyur/ /thos pas don med spong bar byed/ /thos pas mya ngan 'das pa 'thob/ /gal te thos pa mang gyur kyang ①/ /tshul khrims legs par mi sdom na/ /de ni tshul khrims phyir smad bucing / /de yi thos pa phun sum min/ /gal te thos pa nyung gyur kyang / /tshul khrims legs par sdom byed na/ /de ni tshul khrims phyir bsngags shing / /de yi thos pa phun sum 'gyur/ /gang zhig thos pa nyung ba dang / /tshul khrims legs par mi sdom pa/ /de ni gnyi ga'i phyir smad cing / /de yis ⑤brtul zhugs phun sum min/ /gang zhig mang du thos pa dang / /tshul khrims legs par sdom byed pa/ /de ni gnyi ga'i phyir bsngags shing / /de yis brtul zhugs phun sum 'gyur/ /thos pa mang zhing chos 'dzin dang / /shes rab ldan 83—49

zhing mnyam gzhag pa/ /de dag sus kyang smad 'os min/ /'dzam bu'i gling gi gser rgyan bzhin/ /gang zhig gzugs kyis ①rjes dpog cing / /nga la sgra yis 'jal byed pa/ /'dun pa'i 'dod chags ldan pa yi/ /skye bo de yis nga mi shes/ /gal te nang ni rnam shes shing / /phyi ②rol mthong bar ma gyur na/ /nang gi 'bras bu mthong ba gang / /de ni sgra yis drang du rung / /gal te phyi rol mthong gyur cing / /nang ni shes par ma gyur na/ /phyi rol 'bras bu mthong ba gang / /de ni sgra yis drang du rung / /gal te nang yang mi shes shing //phyi rol mjong bar ma gyur na/ /byis pa kun nas bsgribs pa dag /de ni sgra yis drang du rung / /gal te nang ni rnam shes shing / /phyi rol dag kyang mthong gyur pa/ /bstan ④pa nges 'byung shes rab can/ /de ni sgra yis drang du durung //rna bas phal chen ⑤thos pa dang / /mig gis mang po mthong na yang / /bstan bupa mthong thos de kun gyis/ /yid ches bya ba'i ④mi rigs so/ /legs gsungs thos pa snying por shes ④pa dang / /ting nge 'dzin dag snying por shes gyur kyang / /gang zhig bag med rlang ⑨por byed pa de'i/ /thos dang shes pa don chen mi 'gyur ro/ /gang zhig 'phags pas bstan pa'i chos dga' zhing / /de bzhin lus dang ngag gis spyod byed pa/ /de dag bzod ldan 'grogs ⑪ dga' dbang po bsdams/ /thos dang shes pa'i pha rol phyin pa 'thob thos pa'i tshoms te nyi shu gnyis pa'o// //legs par gsungs la ⑪basbab bya zhing / /dge sbyong ⑫la ni bsnyen bkur dang / /dben pa dang ni stan gcig dang / /sems ni nye bar zhi bar bya/ /83—50

stan gcig mal stan gcig pa dang / /gcig pu snyom las med ①spyod cing / /gcig pu nags tshal gnas pa dang / /gcig pus bdag nyid gdul bar bya/ /gang zhig stong phrag stong dag gi/ /mi yi g.yul las rgyal ba bas/ /gang zhig bdag las rgyal byed pa/ /de ni mi yi g.yul las rgyal/ /rtag tu sdom pa spyod pa yi/ /mi yis bdag brtul ②gcig pu yis/ /bdag nyid las rgyal mchog yin gyi/ /skye dgu gzhan lta phal par zad/ /shes rab kyis gnas dge slong gis—/ /rgyal bar byas la bdud dang ni/ /tshangs par bcas pas pham mi nus—/ /lha yis ma yin dri zas min/ /bdag nyid dang por rigs par gnas byas nas/ /phyi nas gzhan dag ①bdag bzhin gdul rjobar bya/ /bdag nyid dang por rigs par gnas byas nas⑤/ /phyi dus 'dul rjotshe mkhas pa nyon mi mongs/ /bdag la ji ltar byas pa bzhin/ /gzhan dag la yang de ltar bya/ /bdag nyid dul zhing zhi ④ba yis/ /gzhan dag bde bar gdul bar ⑧bya/ /bdag la ji ltar byas pa ⑨bzhin/ /gzhan dag la yang de ltar bya//kye ma bdag rang legs dul ⑩ba/ /bdag nyid dul bas dga' bar 'gyur/ /bdag gi don phyir gzhan don ni/ /mang po dag kyang gtang bar bya/ /bdag don ched cher shes gyur na/ /rang gi don gyi mchog tu 'gyur ⑪/ /bdag nyid bdag gi mgon yin gyi/ /gzhan lta su zhig mgon du 'gyur/ /bdag nyid bdag gi mgon gyur pa'i/ /mkhas pas don rnams 'thob ⑫par 'gyur/ /bdag nyid bdag gi mgon yin gyi/ /gzhan lta su zhig mgon du 'gyur/ /bdag nyid bdag gi mgon gyur pa'i/ /mkhas pas chos rnams 'thob par 'gyur—/ /bdag nyid bdag gi mgon yin gyi⑫/ /gzhan lta su zhig mgon du 83—51

'gyuraske/ /bdag nyid bdag gi mgon gyur pa'i/ /mkhas pas grags pa 'thob ①par 'gyur/ /bdag nyid bdag gi mgon yin gyi/ /gzhan lta su zhig mgon du 'gyur/ /bdag nyid bdag gi mgon gyur pa'i/ /mkhas pas bde ba 'thob rjopar 'gyur/ /bdag nyid bdag gi mgon yin gyi/ /gzhan lta su zhig mgon du 'gyur/ /bdag nyid bdag gi mgon gyur pa'idze+e/ /mkhas pas bde 'gro 'thob rjopar 'gyur/ /bdag nyid bdag gi mgon yin gyi//gzhan lta su zhig mgon du 'gyur/ /bdag nyid bdag gi mgon gyur pas⑤/ /yun ring mtho ris dga' bar 'gyur/ /bdag nyid bdag gi mgon yin rmi/ /gzhan lta su zhig mgon du 'gyur/ /bdag nyid bdag gi mgon gyur padu/ /dze+eganyen gyi nang na lam mer 'bar/ /bdag nyid bdag gi mgon yin gyi/ /gzhan lta su zhig mgon du 'gyur/ /bdag nyid bdag gi mgon gyur pa/ /mya ngan nang na gdung mi 'gyur/ /bdag nyid bdag gi mgon yin gyi/ /gzhan lta su zhig mgon du 'gyur/ /bdag nyid bdag gi mgon gyur pas/ /'ching ba thams cad gcod par 'gyur/ /bdag nyid bdag gi mgon yin rmi/ /gzhan lta su zhig mgon du 'gyur/ /bdag nyid bdag gi mgon gyur pas/ /ngan 'gro thams cad spong bar 'gyur/ /bdag nyid bdag gi mgon yin gyi/ /gzhan lta su zhig mgon du 'gyur/ /bdag nyid bdag gi mgon gyur pas/ /sdug bsngal kun las rab tu thar/ /bdag nyid bdag gi mgon yin gyi/ /gzhan lta su zhig mgon du 'gyur/ /bdag nyid bdag gi mgon gyur pas/ /bdag nyid mgon du 'gyur ba ⑧'thob/ /bdag nyid bdag gi mgon yin gyi/ /gzhan lta su zhig mgon du 'gyur/ /bdag nyid bdag gi mgon yin gyi⑨/ /83—52
