mya ngan 'das nyid nye bar 'gyur/ /bdag gi tshoms te nyi shu gsum pa'o// //gang dag don dang mi ldan tshig /tshigs bcad brgya dag smra ba bas/ /gang dag nye bar zhi 'gyur ba'i/ /don ldan tshig gcig thos pa rung / /gang dag chos dang mi ldan tshig /tshigs bcad brgya dag smra ba bas/ /gang dag nye bar zhi 'gyur ba'i/ /chos ldan tshig gcig thos pa rung / /tshul 'chal mnyam par ma bzhag pa/ /lo brgyar gson pa gang yin pas/ /tshul khrims ldan zhing mnyam bzhag ①pa/ /nyin zhag 'ga' ②zhig gson pa rung / /brtson med snele lo ldan pa dag /lo brgyar gson pa gang yin pas/ /brtson 'grus brtan pa brtsams pa dag /nyin zhag 'ga' buzhig gson pa rung / /shes 'chal mnyam par ma bzhag pa/ /lo brgyar gson pa gang yin pas/ /shes rab chen po mnyam bzhag ⑤pa/ /nyin zhag 'ga' zhig gson pa rung / /skye dang 'jig pa ma mthong ba/ /lo brgyar gson pa gang yin dupas/ /skye dang 'jig pa ⑦mthong ba dag /nyin zhag 'ga' ⑧zhig gson pa rung / /tshor ba zad ⑨pa ma mthong ba/ /lo brgyar gson pa gang yin pas/ /tshor ba zad pa ⑩mthong ba dag /nyin zhag 'ga' zhig gson pa rung / /zag pa zad pa ma mthong ba /lo brgyar gson pa gang yin pas/ /zag pa zad pa mthong ba dag /nyin zhag 'ga' zhig gson pa rung / /go 'phang mi g.yo ma mthong ba/ /lo brgyar gson pa gang yin pas/ /go 'phang mi g.yo mthong ba dag /nyin zhag 'ga' zhig gson pa rung / /go 'phang blta ⑪dka' ma mthong ba/ /lo brgyar gson pa gang yin pas/ /go 'phang blta ⑫dka' mthong ba dag /nyin zhag 'ga' 83—53

zhig gson pa rung / /go 'phang mthon po ma mthong ba/ /lo brgyar gson pa gang yin pas/ /go 'phang mthon po mthong ba dag /nyin zhag 'ga' zhig gson pa rung / /go 'phang dam pa ma mthong ba/ /lo brgyar gson pa gang yin pas/ /go 'phang dam pa mthong ba dag /nyin zhag 'ga' zhig gson pa rung / /'chi med go 'phang ma mthong ba/ /lo brgyar gson pa gang yin pas/ /'chi med go 'phang mthong ba dag /nyin zhag 'ga' zhig gson pa rung / /bdud rtsi'i go 'phang ma mthong ba/ /lo brgyar gson pa gang yin pas/ /bdud rtsi'i go 'phang mthong ba dag /nyin zhag 'ga' zhig gson pa rung / /rdul med go 'phang ma mthong ba/ /lo brgyar gson pa gang yin pas/ /rdul med go 'phang mthong ba dag /nyin zhag 'ga' zhig gson pa ①rung / /rdul bral go 'phang ma mthong ba/ /lo brgyar gson pa gang yin pas/ /rdul bral go 'phang mthong ba dag /nyin zhag 'ga' zhig gson pa rung / /mi ni lo brgyar nags tshal na/ /me la yongs sten ②gang yin dang / /bdag nyid bsgom la yud tsam zhig④ /mchod pa byed pa gang yin pa/ /mchod byed de nyid duches rung gi /lo brgyar sbyin sreg byed mi rung / /zla ba re rer ku sha'i rtses / /kha zas za ba gang yin des/ /sangs rgyas la ni dad pa yi⑤/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /zla ba re rer ku sha'i rtses/ /kha zas za ba gang yin des/ /dam pa'i chos la dad pa yi0/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /zla ba re rer ku sha'i rtses/ /kha zas za ba gang yin des/ /dge 'dun la ni dad pa yi⑦/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /zla ba re rer ku sha'i rtses/ /kha zas za ba gang yin des/ /sems can rnams la snying brtse ba'isde bcu 83—54

drug char yang mi phod do/ /zla ba re rer ku sha'i rtses/ /kha zas za ba gang yin des/ /srog chags rnams la snying brtse ba'i/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /zla ba re rer ku sha'i rtses/ /kha zas za ba gang yin des/ /'byung po ①rnams la snying brtse ba'i/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /zla ba re rer ku sha'i rtses/ /kha zas za ba gang yin des/ /byams par ②sems par byed pa yi/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /zla ba re rer ku sha'i rtses/ /kha zas za ba gang yin des/ /legs par gsungs pa'i dam chos kyi/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /zla ba re rer mchod sbyin stong / /lo brgyar byed pa gang yin des/ /sangs rgyas la ni dad pa yi/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do//zla ba re rer mchod sbyin stong / /lo brgyar byed pa gang yin des/ /dam pa'i chos la dad pa yi/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /zla ba re rer mchod sbyin stong / /lo brgyar byed pa gang yin des/ /dge 'dun la ni dad pa yi/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /zla ba re rer mchod sbyin stong / /lo brgyar byed pa gang yin des/ /sems can rnams la snying brtse ba'i/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /zla ba re rer mchod sbyin stong / /lo brgyar byed pa gang yin des—/ /srog chags rnams la snying brtse ba'i/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do//zla ba re rer mchod sbyin stong / /lo brgyar byed pa gang yin des/ /'byung po rnams la snying brtse ba'i/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /zla ba re rer mchod sbyin stong / /lo brgyar byed pa gang yin des/ /byams par ①sems par byed pa yi/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /zla ba re rer mchod sbyin stong / /lo brgyar byed pa gang yin des/ /legs par gsungs pa'i dam chos 83—55

kyi—/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /bsod nams 'dod pa'i mi yis 'jig rten du/ /sbyin sreg mchod sbyin chung zad ci byas des/ /gang zhig drang po'i sems kyis phyag 'tshal ba/ /de yi bzhi ①char yang ni ⑤mi phod do/ /bgre sneba'i tshoms te nyi shu rtsa rjobazhi pa'o// //ched du brjod pa'i tshoms/⑤ bam po gsum pa/ dad pa med cing 'jungs pa dang / /dbyen byed duphra ma can dag dang / /mkhas pas bshes ⑦par mi bya zhing / /sdig can mi dang 'grogs mi bya/ /dad ldan snyan par smra ba dang / /thos mang tshul khrims ldan pa dang sge/ /mkhas pa yis ni mdza' bya zhing / /mi mchog dag dang 'grogs par bya/ /sdig pa'i grogs po mi bsten cing / /skyes bu ngan pa bsten mi bya/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten bya zhing //skyes bu dam pa bsten par bya/ /de lta bu dag bsten byas na/ /sdig par mi 'gyur legs par 'gyur/ /gang dag thos mang gnas mang sems pa dang / /dad dang shes rab ldan de mi yis bsten/ /'dir ni de yis legs smras mnyan byas na/ /ring po nas kyang khyad par thob par 'gyur/ /dman pa bsten pas mi dag nyams 'gyur zhing / /thad kar bab pa bsten pas so na gnas/ /gtso bo bsten pas dam pa 'thob 'gyur bas⑨/ /de phyir bdag pas gtsor gyur bsten par bya/ /tshul khrims nye bar zhi ba dang / /shes rab ches mchog ldan pa yi/ /gtso bo gang yin de bsten na/ /gtso bo bas kyang ches gtsor 'gyur—/ /mi yis 'di na nya rul la/ /ku sha'i gtsang byed bcings pa gang ⑩//ku sha nyid kyang rul 'gyur ba/ /sdig pa bsten pa'ang de bzhin 'gyur/ /mi 83—56

yis rgya spos pa la sha'i/ /lo mar phur ma ①byas pa gang / /lo ma nyid kyang dri zhim pa/ /dam pa bsten pa'ang de bzhin 'gyur/ /gal te sdig pa byed pa dag /sdig mi byed pas bsten na yang / /sdig pa byed par dogs skye zhing / /mi snyan pa yang 'phel bar 'gyur/ /bsten bya ma yin bsten pa'i mi/ /de yi skyon gyis skyon can 'gyur/ /dong par dug bskus mda' bcug pas/ /dug ma bskus pa'ang gos pa bzhin/ /brten ②pa skyon gos 'jigs pa dag /sdig pa can dang ④bshes mi bya/ /ji ltar grogs po bsten pa dang / /ji ltar nye bar bsten byas pa/ /bsten bya de ni ci 'dra bar/ /ring po 0mi thogs de 'drar 'gyur—/ /de bas 'bras bu'i snod bzhin du/ /bdag gis bsten pa shes pa yis—/ /dam pa ma yin mi bsten cing / /mkhas pas dam pa bsten byas la/ /dge slong de'i ⑤lam rjes 'brang rjon/ /sdug bsngal zad pa ⑦thob par 'gyur/ /byis pas ⑧ji srid gson bar du/ /gal te mkhas pa bsten byas kyang / /de yis chos shes mi 'gyur te/ /gzar bus tshod ma'i ro bzhin no/ /shes rab ldan pas yud tsam zhig /mkhas pa ⑨nye bar bsten pas kyang / /de yis chos rnams shes 'gyur te/ /lce yis tshod ma'i ro bzhin no/ /byes pas ⑩ji srid gson bar du/ /gal te mkhas pa bsten byas kyang / /de la mig ni med pa'i phyir—/ /chos rnams shes par mi 'gyur ro/ /shes rab ldan pas yud tsam zhig /mkhas pa nye bar bsten pas ⑩kyang / /de la mig ni yod pa'i phyir/ /chos rnams rab tu shes par 'gyur/ /byis pas ⑫ji srid gson bar du/ /gal te mkhas pa bsten byas kyang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis bstan pa yi/ /chos rnams de yis shes mi 'gyur/ /shes rab ldan pas yud tsam zhig /83—57

mkhas pa nye bar bsten pas ①kyang / /rdzogs ④sangs rgyas kyis bstan pa yi① /chos rnams de yis shes par 'gyur/ /don ldan tshig ni gcig gis kyang / /mkhas pa yi ni bya ba byed/ /sangs rgyas kun byi gsung rjogis kyang / /byis pa'i bya ba byed mi 'gyur/ /blo dang ldan pa ⑤tshig gcig gis/ /tshig brgya dag ni shes par 'gyur 0/ /byis pa la ni ⑦tshig stong gis/ /tshig gcig shes par mi 'gyur ro/ /nyis na mkhas dang mi mdza' be+e'i⑧/ /byes pa rnams dang mdza' mi rung / /byis pa rnams dang mdza' byed pa/ /sems can dmyal bar khrid par byed/ /byis pa gang zhig byis pa'o zhes/ /shes pa de 'dir mkhas pa yin/ /byis pa gang zhig mkhas sems pa/ /de ni byes pa zhes brjod do/ /byis pas ⑨bstod pa gang yin dang / /mkhas pas smad pa gang yin las/ /mkhas pas smad pa ches rung gis⑩/ /byis pas bstod pa mi rung ngo / /byes pa bsten pa ⑪sdug bsngal zhing / /rnam pa kun du dgra ⑫'dra bas/ /byis pa mi thos mi mthong zhing / /ma ⑫bsten gyur pa nyid rung ngo / /gnyen dang phrad pa ji lta bar④/ /brtan pa bsten na bde bar 'gyur/ /de bas rgyu skar lam du zla ba ltar/ /brtan zhing thos mang mchog 'dren byed pa dang / /tshul khrims ldan dang 'phags pa'i brtul zhugs can/ /mi mchog brtse ldan blo bzangs ⑩bsten par gyis/ /mdza' bshes kyi tshoms te nyi shu rtsa ⑩lnga pa'o// //rus ⑩sbal rang gi khog par yan lag ltar/ /dge slong yid kyi rnam rtog nang bsdus nas/ /rten ⑫pa med cing gzhan la 'tshe med par/ /mya ngan 'das la su yang smod mi byed/ /bzod pa dka' thub mchog ste bzod pa ni/ /83—58

mya ngan 'das pa mchog ces sangs rgyas gsung / /rab tu byung ba gzhan la 'tshe ba dang ①/ /gzhan la gnod pas dge sbyong ma yin no/ /tshig rtsub ci yang smra mi bya/ /smras na slar ④yang smra bar byed/ /'thab gcugs dze+etshig gis sdug bsngal zhing / /de la phyir yang chad pas gcod/ /gal te bdag gis phar byas na/ /'khar duba'i snod la brdungs pa bzhin/ /'khor bar skye dang rga ba dag /yun ring ⑤nyams su myong bar 'gyur/ /bdag gis phar ni ma byas dang / /'khar duba'i snod la ⑦ma brdungs ltar/ /'di ltar 'thab mo mi 'byung zhing / /mya ngan 'das pa thob par 'gyur/ /nad med rnyed pa'i dam pa ste/ /chog shes pa ⑧ni nor gyi dbyig /yid gcugs bshes pa'i mchog yin te/ /mya ngan 'das pa bde ba'i phul/ /'du byed sdug bsngal ma rungs pa⑨/ /nad kyi nang na bkres mi bzad/ /de ltar ji bzhin shes na ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa mchog tu 'gyur/ /bde 'gror 'gro ba nyung zad de/ /ngan 'gror 'gro ba bsam yas shig⑩ /de lta'i ⑪nyes dmigs rtogs gyur na/ /myur du mya ngan 'das pa 'thob/ /bde 'gror 'gro ba rgyu dang bcas/ /ngan 'gror 'gro ba rgyu dang ldan/ /mya ngan 'das 'gro rgyu can te⑫/ /de dag thams cad rgyu dang bcas/ /nags tshal mchog tu ri dwags 'gro/ /mkha' la bya rnams 'gro bar byed/ /chos la rnam par bsgoms 'gro ste/ /dgra bcom mya ngan 'das par 'gro/ /'di na brtson 'grus zhan pa dang / /blo chung shes pa med pa yis/ /mdud pa thams cad rab gtubs ⑫pa'i/ /mya ngan 'das pa thob mi 'gyur/ /khyod kyis gru 'di'i chu phyags ④dang / /'di ni yang bar 'gyur ba ltar/ /de bzhin zhe sdang 'dod chags spongs/ /de nas mya ngan 'das pa 83—59

'thob—/ /sngon chad byung ba mi 'byung zhing / /ma byung ba dag 'byung bar 'gyur—/ /ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur la/ /da ltar byung ba'ang yod ma yin//blta dka' mtha' med der mi ①mthong / /bden pa rab rtogs shes pa dang / /sred dang dga' ba med mthong ba/ /'di 'dra 'di ni sdug bsngal mtha'/ /sred pa rnams ni bcad pa dang / /'dod chags rab tu spangs pa dang / /mtsho bskams ②nas ni mi 'bab pa/ /'di 'dra 'di ni sdug bsngal mtha'/ /lus zhig tshor ba bsil bar gyur①/ /'du shes 'gags shing 'du byed zhi/ /rnam par shes pa nub gyur pa/ /'di 'dra 'di ni sdug bsngal mtha'/ /lta bas mthong bar gyur tsam dang / /nyan pas thos par gyur pa tsam/ /rtogs 0par byed pas rtogs tsam dang / /rnam par shes pas rnam shes tsam/ /'di 'dra 'di ni sdug bsngal mtha'/ /'di dang ma dang gdungs rab gdungs/ /'di 'dra 'di ni sdug bsngal mtha'/ /ma re ⑤ma dga' rab zhi dang / /kun du 'dod chags bral gyur pa/ /'di 'dra 'di ni sdug bsngal mtha'/ /rten dupa yod pas spyod par 'gyur ro⑦/ /spyod pa yod pas gzhol bar 'gyur ro⑧/ /gzhol ba yod pas shin tu ma sbyangs par 'gyur ro/ /shin tu ma sbyangs pa yod pas 'gro ba dang 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /'gro ba dang 'ong ba yod pas gzhan du shi 'pho len par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan du shi 'pho blangs pas 'di ltar gzhan du skye ba dang / rga ba dang / na ba dang / 'chi ba dang / mya ngan dang smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa 'byung zhing 'di ltar sdug bsngal gyi yung po chen po ⑨'ba' zhig po ⑩'di 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rten ⑩pa med pas spyod pa med par 'gyur ro/ /spyod pa med 83—60

pas gzhol bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gzhol bar ma gyur pas shin tu sbyangs par 'gyur ro/ /shin tu sbyangs pas 'gro ba dang 'ong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /'gro ba dang 'ong ba med ①pas gzhan du 'chi 'pho len pa med par ④'gyur ro/ /gzhan du 'chi 'pho len pa med pas 'di ltar gzhan du skye ba dang / rga ba dang /na ba dang / 'chi ba ①dang / mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang /sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa rnams 'gag rjopar 'gyur zhing / 'di ltar sdug bsngal gyi phung po chen po 'ba' zhig po ⑤'di 'gag par 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag ma skyes pa dang / ma byung ba dang /ma bcos pa dang / 'dus ma byas pa dang / mi 'byung ba yod do/ /skye ba dang / 'byung ba dang / bcos ma dang / sems pas byas pa dang /'dus byas rjodang / rten cing 'grel bar 'byung ba yod do/ /dge slong dag gal te ma skyes pa dang / ma byung ba dang / ma bcos pa dang / 'dus ma byas pa ⑦dang / mi 'byung ba med du zin na/ skye ba dang / 'byung ba dang /bcos ma dang / 'dus byas ⑧dang / sems pas byas pa dang / rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i nges par 'byung ba yod do zhes nga mi smra'o/ /dge slong dag gang gi phyir 'di na ma skyes pa dang / ma byung ba dang / ma bcos pa dang /'dus ma byas pa dang / mi 'byung ba yod pa de'i phyir/ skye ba dang /'byung ba dang / bcos ma dang / 'dus byas dang / sems pas byas pa dang / rten cing 'byel bar 'byung pa'i nges par 'byung ba yod do zhes nga smra'o//skyes ⑨dang byung dang 'byung ba dang / /bcos dang 'dus byas mi brtan zhing / /rga dang 'chi dang rmongs pa yi/ /chos can rab tu 'jig 'gyur ba/ /zas kyi 83—61

—rgyud ①las byung ba yi/ /'jig 'gyur 'di la dga' mi bya/ /de yi nges par 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /rtog dang dpyod dang zhi ba dang / /sdug bsngal chos rnams 'gags pa ste/ /'du byed nye bar zhi ba ②bde/ /dge slong dag de ni gang du yang gnas par mi 'gyur te/ sa la gnas par mi 'gyur/ chu la ma yin/me la ma yin/ rlung la ma yin/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la ma yin/rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la ma yin/ ci yang med pa'i skye mched la ma yin/'du shes yod min ①med min skye mched la ma yin/ 'jig rten 'di la ma yin/'jig rten pha rol la ma yin/ nyi ma dang zla ba gnyis la gnas pa ma yin te/'di la dmigs pa med par ngas mngon par shes so/ /dge slong dag de la 'gro ba dang 'ong ba yod par nga mi smra ste/ gnas par ma yin no/ /'chi 'pho yod par nga mi smra ste/du skye bar ma yin⑤/ 'di lta bu 'di duni sdug bsngal gyi mtha' yin no/ /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung / /gang la'ang gnas pa ma yin pa—/ /de la dkar pos gsal mi byed/ /de la mun pa'ang yod ma yin/ /de la zla bas snang mi byed/ /de la nyi mas mngon mi byed/ /thub pa bram ze gang yin pa/ /des ⑦ni rang gis rig pa yin/ /de ⑧ni gzugs dang gzugs med dang / /sdug bsngal kun las rab tu grol⑨/ /mthar phyin 'jigs pa med pa ste/ /rlom med 'gyod pa med pa yin/ /srid pa'i zug rngu gtubs ⑩pa ste/ /lus kyi tha mar gyur pa yin/ /'di ni mthar phyin rnams kyi mchog⑪ /zhi ba'i go 'phang bla med pa/ /mtshan ma thams cad zad pa ste/ /byang grol go 'phang 'chi med yin/ /mtshungs dang mi mtshungs 'byung ⑫ba yi/ /'du byed thub pas rab tu spangs/ /nang du mnyam bzhag ⑫dga' ba yis/ /sgo nga'i sbubs ni dral nas byung / /sbyin 83—62

kun chos kyi sbyin pas thub/ /dga' kun chos kyi dga' bas thub/ /stobs kun bzod pa'i stobs kyis thub/ /bde kun sred pa zad pas thub/ /mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshoms te nyi shu rtsa drug pa'o// //bdag las gzhan pa'i skyon dag ni/ /phub ma gtor ba ji bzhin du/ /gzhan kyi skyon mjong be+e ba ste/ /rang gi skyon ni mthong bar dka'/ /g.yo ①can cho lo sne'ajo ba ltar/ /rang gi de ni sbed pa dang / /gzhan gye skyon la lta byed cing / /rtag tu 'phyas lang ①'du shes can/ /de yis ring du chos mi mthong / /g.yon phyogs chos ni rab tu 'phel/ /spyi rdol bubyed cing 'phrog ⑤zlos can/ /mi gtsang las ldan khā lta buradu/ /shin tu nyon mongs 'tsho ba can//ngo tsha med pa'i 'tsho ba sla/ /rtag tu gtsang ma tshol ④ba dang / /thub chod skemi byed 'jem bag can/ /'tsho ba dag pa ⑨lta ba yi/ /ngo tsha shes pa'i 'tsho ba dka'—/ /'jig rten mun par gyur 'di ste/ /de las lhag mthong ldan pa nyung / /rgya las shor ba'i bya lta bur/ /mtho ris la dga' shas tsam zhig /byis pa lus ⑩kyis bcings gyur pa/ /mun pa'i 'khor gyis bskor ba yin/ /'jig rten nor la chags pa dag /gzhan rdzas lta bur lta bar byed/ /bdag gis ⑪skye dgu 'di phyung zhing / /gzhan kyis byas so snyam sems pa/ /bden pa min la bden lta bas/ /ci yang mthong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de ni 'gas kyang mi mthong zhing / /zug rngu mthong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /yul sred gang la skye bo chags pa yi/ /zug rngu de dag sngon ⑫chad mthong ba dang ⑫/ /de ni bdag gis byas snyam mi 'dzin cing / /de ni gzhan gyis byas snyam mi 'dzin to/ /skye dgu 83—63

'di dag nga rgyal ldan/ /nga rgyal la chags nga rgyal bcings/ /rtsod ①par gyur pa'i lta ba can/ /'khor ba ldog par mi 'gyur ro/ /thob par gyur pa gang yin dang / /thob par bya ba gang yin pa/ /de dag gnyi ga rdul gyis yog② /rjes su nad pa slob par byed/ /gang zhig tshul khrims dang / babe+eb pa dang /brtul zhugs dang / tshangs par spyod pa dang / dka' thub dang / nye bar gnas pa snying por byed pa de ①ni mtha' gcig go/ /gang zhig de ltar lta rjozhing 'di skad ces 'dod pa ni gtsang ba'o/ /'dod pa ni bsod nyams ducan no/ /'dod pa ni longs spyod pepar bya ba'o/ /'dod pa ni skyon med pa yin no zhes smra zhing de dag lhag par 'dod pa rnams su lhung ⑦bar byed pa'i brtul zhugs len pa 'di yang mtha' gcig go/ /mtha' gnyis po 'di dag ni dur khrod 'phel bar byed pa ste/ 'di dag gis dur khrod 'phel bar byas so/ /mtha' gnyis po 'di dag ma mthong ba kha cig zhen par byed cing ⑧/ kha cig mngon par rgyug par byed la⑨/ de dag lhag par zhen par byed cing ⑩lhag par rgyug par byed pa dag mig dang ldan pas mthong ngo / /mtha' gnyis po 'di ⑪dag mthong ba na zhen par mi byed rgyug par mi byed la/ de dag lhag par zhen par ⑩mi byed cing lhag par rgyug par mi byed pa yang mig dang ldan pas mthong ngo / /de dag de ltar mi byed cing de dag de ltar mi sems na/ de dag gi lam du mi gdags pa 'di lta ste ⑫'di ni sdug bsngal gyi mtha' yin no/ /ji ltar chu bur mthong ba dang / /ji ltar smig rgyu mthong ba ltar/ /de bzhin 'jig rten lta byed pa/ /'chi bdag rgyal pos mthong mi 'gyur/ /ji ltar chu bur mthong ba dang / /ji ltar smig rgyu mthong ba ltar/ /de bzhin lus la lta byed pa/ /'chi 83—64

bdag rgyal pos mthong mi 'gyur/ /gang la byis pa mngon chags pa/ /de la mkhas pa chags mi 'gyur/ /rgyal po'i shing rta bkra ba ltar/ /lus 'di ①rtag tu blta bar gyis/ /gang la byis pa rmongs 'gyur ba/ /de la mkhas pa rmongs mi 'gyur/ /rgyal po'i shing rta bkra ba ltar/ /lus 'di rtag tu blta bar kyis/ /gang du byis pa nyams gyur pa/ /glang rgan rdzab tu chud pa bzhin/ /rgyal po'i shing rta bkra ④ba ltar/ /lus 'di rtag tu blta bar gyis/ /nad pa lta bur 'jig ①chos can/ /rma byung ba dang 'dra ba ste/ /gang yang brtan par mi gnas pa④/ /lus 'di rtag tu blta bar gyis/ /nad pa 'jig pa'i chos can ltar—/ /gang yang brtan par mi gnas par/ /nor bu'i rna cha gdub 'khor kyis—/ /brgyan pa'i lus la blta bar gyis/ /skra ni lan bu brgyad ⑤byas shing //mig sman gyis ni bskus pa'i mig /byes pa lhag par rmongs byed kyang / /pha rol tshol bar mi byed do/ /mig sman gyis ni gsar bris shing / /rnag can lus ni brgyan pa yis/ /byis pa lhag par rmongs byed kyang / /pha rol tshol bar mi byed do/ /lus ni dri zhim byis bskus nas/ /rkang pa btsag dugis byugs pa dag /byis pa lhag par rmongs byed kyang / /pha rol tshol bar mi byed do/ /gang zhig 'dod par kun sbyor 'byel chags shing / /kun du sbyor ba'i skyon rnams ma mthong ba/ /'dod par 'byel la chags pa'i mi de yis/ /chu bo mtha' yas yangs pa ④rgal mi 'gyur/ /chags bral mchog dang tha ma thams cad dag /'di la bdag dang bdag gir mi lta zhing / /de ltar ⑧rnam grol sngon chad ma rgal ba'i/ /chu bo rab rgal ⑨yang srid med par 'gyur/ /gang zhig tshal spangs tshal med pa/ /nags tshal spangs nas nags su rgyug /83—65

grol ba 'ching bar gcen pa yin①/ /gang zag 'di la ltos shig tshur/ /shing rta mthun pa'i rtsibs ldan pa/ /yan lag yid 'ong gos dkar g.yogs/ /sdig med 'gro ba la ltos la/ /ching ④ma'i rgyun rnams bcad par gyis/ /'jigs pas skrag pa'i mi dag ni/ /phal cher ri dang nags tshal dang / /skyed mos tshal dang mchod ①gnas dang / /ljon shing rnams la skyabs su 'gro/ /skyabs de gtso bo ma yin zhing / /skyabs de mchog tu gyur pa min/ /de la skyabs su song ba yis/ /sdug bsngal kun las grol mi 'gyur/ /gang zhig sangs rgyas chos dang ni/ /dge 'dun la ni skyabs song zhing / /sdug bsngal sdug bsngal kun 'byung dang / /sdug bsngal yang dag 'das pa dang / /bde ba mya ngan 'das 'gro ba'i/ /'phags lam yan lag brgyad pa ste/ /'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po dag /gang tshe shes rab kyis mthong ba/ /de ni skyabs kyi mchog yin zhing / /de ni skyabs kyi dam pa yin/ /de la skyabs su song ba yis—/ /sdug bsngal kun las grol bar 'gyur/ /mthong bas mthong zhing mthong bas ma ④mthong mthong / /ma mthong mi mthong mthong bya mthong mi 'gyur/ /'dra mthong lhag mthong tha dad dngos por brjod/ /nyin mtshan nam yang lhan cig mi gnas bzhin/ /'dra ba mthong bas mthong mi 'gyur/ /gal te mthong na 'dra mi mthong / /mthong 'dis 'dra ba mi mthong ste/ /'dra mthong mi yis mthong ba med/ /mi yis ci ma mthong na 'dra ba mthong / /ci zhig mthong na 'dra ba mthong mi 'gyur/ /ji ltar 'di na 'dra ba mthong ba dag /gang zhig med na 'dra bar mthong dang bral/ /gang tshe 'di yis sdug bsngal ma mthong ba/ /de yi tshe na bdag tu mthong bar 'gyur/ /ji lta ji ltar sdug bsngal rtogs gyur pa//83—66

des ni bdag 'di ①'dra ba mthong mi 'gyur/ /gang gis ②so so'i skye bsgribs na①—/ /'du byed sdug bsngal ma mthong ba/ /de phyir 'di na 'dra mthong ste/ /de med 'dra ba mi mthong ngo / /mthong ba'i tshoms te nyi shu rtsa rjobadun pa'o// //sdig pa thams cad mi bya ste/ /dge ba phun sum tshogs par bya⑤/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /sbyin pas bsod nams rab tu 'phel/ /legs bsdams dgra sogs mi 'gyur ro/ /dge dang ldan pas sdig pa spong / /nyon mongs zad pas mya ngan 'da'arjo/ /mkhas dang 'dre dang byis pa'i skye bo dang / /lhan cig spyod dang gcig pu gnas kyang rung / /ngang pas chu la ⑦'o ma 'thung ba ltar/ /mkhas pas sdig pa can rnams rab tu spang ④/ /'jig rten nyes dmigs mthong ba dang / /'gog par 'gyur ba'i chos mthong bas/ /'phags pa sdig la dga' mi byed/ /sdig can dge la dga' mi 'gyur/ /legs par nyer ⑨zhi'i ro dang ni/ /rab tu dben pa'i ro shes pa/ /rims nad med byung sdig med la/ /chos la dga' ba'i ro dag 'thung / /sems kyi zag pa med pa dang / /sems ni 'ching bas ma bcom ⑩la/ /dge dang sdig pa rab spangs pa/ /ngan 'gro rnams kyis ⑪'jigs pa med/ /gnas min zlog dang legs smra dang / /nyes dmigs ston par byed pa dang / /mkhas pas ⑫tshar gcod smra byed pa/ /de lta'i skye dgu bsten par bya/ /de lta bu dag bsten byas na/ /sdig par mi 'gyur legs par 'gyur/ /nye bar zhi zhing rab zhi la/ /dal bus smra zhing khengs med pa/ /sdig pa'i chos rnams sprug byed de/ /rlung gis ljon shing lo ma bzhin/ /gang 83—67

zhig skyes bu ①dag cing nyon mongs med/ /rab tu sdang rnged mi la khro byed pa'i/ /byis pa de la sdig pa phyir 'gog khruste/ /rdzi phyogs su ni rdul rnams gtong ba bzhin / /dge ba byed pas dge ba dang / /sdig pa byed pas sdig pa ste/ /mi yis gang dang gang byas pa/ /de de rang gis ④mthong bar 'gyur/ /bdag gis sdig pa byas na ni/ /de bdag kho na kun nyon mongs/ /bdag gis sdig pa ma byas na/ /bdag nyid kho na rnam par dag /gzhan gyis gzhan spyod dumi byed kyi/ /dag dang ma dag rang rang byed/ /bdag nyid kyis ni sdig pa dag /byas shing nye bar bsags pa yisadu/ /bsam brlag mngon du 'joms par byed//rdo rjes nor bu 'bigs pa bzhin/ /mig ldan 'gro bar byed pa yis/ /nyam nga'i lam dag ji lta bar/ /mkhas pas 'tsho ba'i 'jig rten 'dir/ /sdig pa dag ni yongs su spang du/ /nor chen gyis ni grogs nyung dang / /tshong pas 'jigs bcas lam dang ni/ /gson par 'dod pas dug lta bur/ /mkhas pas sdig can ⑦yongs su spang / /gal te lag mthil rma med na/ /lag pas dug ni bzung ⑤byas kyang / /rma med dug ni mi 'dzin ltar/ /ma byas pa la sdig pa med/ /bdag la mi phan bya ba dang / /legs pa ma yin bya bar sba/ /gang dag phan zhing bder ⑨'gyur ba/ /de ni mchog tu bya bar dka'/ /dam pas legs pa ⑩bya sla yi/ /dam pas sdig pa bya bar dka'/ /ngan pas sdig pa bya be+e yi/ /'phags pas sdig pa bya bar dka'/ /ji srid snyig pa ma smin pa/ /de srid byis pa mngar bar sems/ /gang tshe sdig pa smin gyur pa/ /de tshe de ni tsha bar sems/ /ji srid sdig pa ma smin pa/ /de srid sdig ⑪pa rung bar lta⑫/ /gang tshe sdig pa smin gyur pa/ /de tshe sdig pa ⑫mthong bar 'gyur/ /ji srid 83—68

bzang po ma smin pa①/ /de srid bzang po sdig ④par mthong / /gang tshe bzang po dze+esmin gyur pa/ /de rjotshe bzang por mthong bar 'gyur/ /sdig pa sdug bsngal sogs pas na/ /de la dga' bar mi bya'o/ /brgya la sdig pa byas na yang / /yang dang yang du de mi bya/ /bsod nams bde ba sogs pas na/ /de nyid la ni dga' bar bya/ /gal te bsod nams byas na yang / /de ni yang dang yang du bya/ /sdig la yid ni mngon dga' ba/ /bsod nams dal bus byed 'gyur bas/ /sdig pa las ⑤ni sems bzlog ducing / /bsod nams mngon par sgyur ⑦te bya/ /sdig pa chung ngu byas pas kyang / /'jig rten pha rol 'jig ⑧chen dang / /phung khrol chen po byed 'gyur te/ /khong par song ba'i dug bzhin no/ /bsod nams chung ngu byas pas kyang / /'jig rten pha rol bde bar ⑨'dren/ /don chen dag kyang byed 'gyur te/ /'bru rnams phun sum 'byor pa bzhin/ /gang zhig nyes med chad pas gcod/ /sdar ⑩ba min la rab sdang ba/ /gnas gzhan gang yang rung ba bcu/ /myur du thob pa kho nar 'gyur/ /tshor ba mi bzad ⑪pa dag gam/ /yang na lus ni 'dral ba'am—/ /gnod pa'i tshor ba tsha ba'ang rung / /yang na sems 'khrugs ⑫thob par 'gyur/ /gnyen 'dun rnams dang bral ba'am/ /longs spyod zad par 'gyur ba'am/ /rgyal po'i gnod pa 'byung ba'am/ /mi snyan shin tu mi bzad dam / /yang na khyer ni ⑫me chen pos/ /nges par sreg ④par byed par 'gyur//shes rab 'chal ba lus zhig nas/ /bcu pa ngan 'gror 'gro bar 'gyur/ /sdig pa byas pas bag dbab mi bya ste/ /ring byas rgyang mar byas kyang bag mi dbab / /dben par byas kyang bag ⑫dbab mi bya ste/ /de yi rnam smin yod 83—69

pas bag mi dbab/ /bsod nams byas pas bag ni dbab bya ste/ /ring byas rgyang ring byas kyang bag dbab cing / /dben par byas kyang bag ni dbab par bya—/ /de yi rnam byun yod pas bag dbab bo/ /bdag gis sdig pa byas pas mya ngan byed/ /ring dang rgyang ring byas pas mya ngan byed/ /bdag gis dbe+en par byas pas mya ngan byed/ /de yi rnam m+bin yod pas mya ngan byed/ /bdag nyid nag po'i las dang ldan mthong nas/ /'dir yang mya ngan gzhan du'ang mya ngan byed/ /spyig pa ①byas pas gnyi gar mya ngan byed/ /de ni mya ngan de rab mya ngan byed/ /bdag gis bsod nams byas pas dga' bar 'gyur/ /ring dang rgyang ring byas pas dga' ①bar 'gyur/ /bdag gis dben par byas pas dga' bar 'gyur/ /de yi rnam smin yod pas dga' bar 'gyur/ /bdag nyid rnam dag las dang ldan mthong nas/ / 'di na dga' ④'gyur gzhan du'ang dga' bar 'gyur/ /bsod nams byas pas gnyi gar dga' 0'gyur zhing / /de ni dga' rjo'agyur de rab dga' bar 'gyur/ /bdag gis sdig pa byas pas gdung 'gyur zhing / /ring byas rgyang ring byas pas gdung bar 'gyur//bdag gis dben par byas pas gdung 'gyur zhing / /de yi rnam smin yod pas gdung bar 'gyur/ /bdag nyid nag po'i las dang ldan mthong nas/ /'di na gdung 'gyur pha rol gdung bar 'gyur/ /sdig pa byas pas gnyi gar gdung 'gyur zhing / /de ni gdung 'gyur de rab gdung bar 'gyur/ /bdag gis bsod nams byas pas dga' 'gyur zhing / /ring byas rgyang ring byas pas dga' bar 'gyur/ /bdag gis dbe+en par byas pas dga' 'gyur zhing / /de yi rnam smin yod pas dga' bar 'gyur/ /bdag nyid dkar po'i las dang 83—70

ldan mthong nas/ /'di na dga' ①'gyur pha rol dga' bar 'gyur/ /bsod nams byas pas gnyi gar 'ga' sde'agyur zhing / /de ni dga' sne'agyur de rab dga' bar 'gyur/ /sdig pa byas shing bsod nams ma byas la/ /chos dang gol zhing chos min thob pa'i 0mi/ /sdig pa'i las can 'chi bas 'jigs 'gyur te/ /chu chen nang du gru ngan zhig pa bzhin/ /bsod nams byas shing sdig pa ma byas la/ /dam pa rnams kyi sngon kyi chos spyod pas⑤/ /nga ni nams kyang rjo'achi bas 'jigs med de/ /brtan pa'i gru yis pha rol 'gro ba bzhin/ /sdig pa'i tshoms te nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa'o// //ji srid nyi ma ma shar ba/ /de srid srin bu me khyer snang / /nyi ma shar bar gyur pa na/ /snang ba med cing sngon por 'gyur/ /ji srid de bzhin gshegs ma shar/ /de srid rtog ge pa rnams snang / /'jig rten rdzogs sangs rgyas shar ba/ /rtog ⑦can nyan thos bcas mi snang / /gces min gces par blos 'dzin cing / /gces la gces pa min ⑧rtog pa/ /log par kun rtog spyod yul can/ /des ni gces pa thob mi 'gyur/ /gces pa min la gces min dang / /gces la gces par 'du shes pa/ /legs par ⑨kun rtog spyod yul can/ /des ni gces pa 'thob ⑩par 'gyur/ /'di na lta dang nyan ⑪la mngon zhen pa'i/ /chings ⑫ma gsar dang gsar du 'phel ba dag /'khor bar rgyug cing 'gro dang sdod 'gyur te/ /me nang lhung ba'i phye ma leb dang 'dra/ /'di la myong 'gyur gzhan la myong ⑫'gyur ba'am/ /'di na the tshom tha dad ji snyed pa/ /de dag tshangs par spyad spyod 'bad pa dang / /sems par byed 83—71

pas rab tu rnam par spong / /gang zhig snyigs ma yod bzhin du/ /ngur sprig gos ni gyon byed pa/ /dul dang des pa med pa de①/ /ngur sprig gyon pa'i 'os ma yin/ /gang zhig snyigs ma rnams spangs nas/ /tshul khrims legs par mnyam bzhag ④pa/ /dul dang des par ldan pa de/ /ngur smrig gyon pa'i 'os yin no/ /g.yo sgyu 'jungs dang ldan pa'i mi/ /kha dog dang ni gzugs ldan pa'am/ /yang na smra bar byed tsam gyis/ /pho mchog yin par mi chud do/ /gang zhig chos gsum de dag rnams/ /ta la'i mgo bo bzhin bcad nas/ /blo ldan skyon ni bsal ba de④/ /pho mchog yin par brjod par bya/ /'jig rten 'di na legs par ma bsdams pa/ /phal cher legs bsdams rtags kyis sgyu dubyed pasarjo/ /legs par ma brtags bar du mi dag gi/ /mdog gzugs lan 'ga' mthong bas yid ma rton/ /ra gan kha bsgyur lta bur mi 'tsham rjozhing / /lcags phyed gser kyis g.yogs pa ji lta buradze+e/ /khong pa rab gdug phyi rol 'phags tshul gyis/ /'jig rten 'di na 'khor dang bcas par rgyu/ /gang zhig rde 'gengs gnyid ni log pa dang / /nyin dang mtshan du 'gre ldog nyal byed pa—/ /rdzab nang phag chen lus rgyas ji lta bar/ /yang dang yang du smad pa'i mngal du 'jug /mi ni rtag tu dran pa ⑧ldan pa dang / /rtag tu kha zas kyi ni tshod shes pa/ /de yi sdug bsngal chung bar 'gyur ba dang / /dal bus 'ju bas tshe yang ring bar byed/ /gang zhig dbang po ma bsdams shing / /zas kyi tshod ni mi shes la/ /dran pa nyams dang le lo can/ /gtsang bar stilta zhing gnas byed pa/ /de ni 'dod chags rnams kyis bcom/ /rlung gis mi brtan ljon shing bzhin/ /gang zhig dbang po legs bsdams shing / /zas kyi tshod ni 83—72

shes pa dang / /so sor dran zhing brtson 'grus ldan/ /mi gtsang lta bas gnas byed pa/ /de ni 'dod chags kyis mi choms/ /rlung gis ri bo mi g.yos ①bzhin/ /dgon pa dga' bar ②bya 'os pa/ /de la skye bo mi dga' yang / /de la 'dod chags bral ba dga'/ /'dod pa tshol bar byed rnams min—/ /dgon pa'am yang na grong dag gam/ /gshang ①ngam thang bu dudag kyang rung / /gang na 'phags pa bzhugs pa yi/ /sa de yid du 'ong ba yin/ /dam pa ring nas snang gyur ⑤te/ /gangs can gyi ni ri bo bzhin/ /ngan pa nye yang mi snang ste/ /mun khrod mda' ni 'phangs pa bzhin/ /mkhas pa don sems byed pa yi/ /dam pa nyid dang 'grogs na ni/ /don chen 'gyur zhing zab mo yi/ /shes rab so sor rtogs rjopar 'gyur/ /gzhu yis mda' 'phangs bsnun pa yi⑦/ /g.yul ngo'i glang chen ji bzhin du/ /tshul 'chal skye bo mang po yi⑧/ /mi snyan smras pa bzod par bya/ /⑨mi gang khyam 'bigs byed pa dang / /dad pa med cing byas mi gzo⑩/ /go skabs bcom dang skyugs pa za/ /de ni skyes bu dam pa yin/ /pha ma dag ⑪ni bsad byas shing / /rgyal po gtsang sbra can gnyis dang / /yul 'khor 'khor dang bcas bcom na/ /mi ni dag par 'gyur zhes bya/ /gang dag kun du sogs med cing / /gang dag kha zas yongs shes pa/ /stong dang mtshan ma med pa dang / /dbe+en pa nyid kyi spyod yul can/ /de dag 'gro ba rtogs dka' ste/ /nam mkha' la ni bya rjes bzhin//gang dag kun du sogs med cing / /gang dag kha zas yongs shes pa/ /stong dang mtshan ma med pa dang / /dben pa nyid kyi spyod yul can/ /de dag rjes ni rtogs dka' ste/ /nam mkha' la ni bya rjes bzhin/ /gang dag kun du 83—73

sogs med cing / /gang dag kha zas yongs shes pa/ /stong dang mtshan ma med pa dang / /rtag tu bsam gtan spyod yul can/ /de dag 'gro ba rtogs dka' ste/ /nam mkha' la ni bya rjes bzhin/ /gang dag kun du sogs med cing / /gang dag kha zas yongs shes pa/ /stong dang mtshan ma med pa dang / /rtag tu bsam gtan spyod yul can/ /de dag rjes ni rtogs dka' ste/ /nam mkha' la ni bya rjes bzhin/ /gang dag kun du sogs med cing / /gang dag kha zas yongs shes pa/ /stong dang mtshan ma med pa dang / /dben pa nyid kyi spyod yul can/ /de dag 'gro ba rtogs dka' ste/ /nam mkha' la ni bya rjes bzhin—/ /gang dag kun du sogs med cing / /gang dag kha zas yongs shes pa—/ /stong dang mtshan ma med pa dang / /dben pa nyid kyi spyod yul can/ /de dag ①rjes ni rtogs dka' ste/ /nam mkha' la ni bya rjes bzhin/ /gang dag pha mthar rten med cing / /gang gis ④zag zad yongs shes pa/ /stong dang mtshan ma med pa dang / /dben pa nyid kyi ①spyod yul can/ /de dag 'gro ba rtogs dka' ste/ /nam mkha' la ni bya rjes bzhin/ /gang dag rjopha mthar rten med cing / /gang gis zag zad yongs shes pa/ /stong dang mtshan ma med pa dang / /dbe+en pa nyid kyi spyod yul can/ /de dag rjes ni rtogs dka' ste/ /nam mkha' la ni bya rjes bzhin/ /gang dag pha mthar rten med cing / /gang gis zag zad yongs shes pa/ /spong ⑤dang mtshan ma med pa dang / /rtag tu bsam gtan spyod yul can/ /de dag 'gro ba rtogs dka' ste/ /nam mkha' la ni bya rjes bzhin/ /gang dag pha mthar rten med cing / /gang gis zag zad yongs shes pa/ /stong dang mtshan ma med pa dang / /rtag tu bsam 83—74

gtan spyod yul can/ /de dag rjes ni rtogs dka' ste/ /nam mkha' la ni bya rjes bzhin/ /gang dag pha mthar rten med cing / /gang gis ①zag zad yongs shes pa/ /stong dang mtshan ma med pa dang / /rtag tu bsam gtan spyod yul can/ /de dag 'gro ba rtogs dka' ste/ /nam mkha' la ni bya rjes bzhin—/ /gang dag pha mthar rten med cing / /gang gis zag zad yongs shes pa/ /stong dang mtshan ma med pa dang / /rtag tu bsam gtan spyod yul can—/ /de dag rjes ni rtogs dka' ste/ /nam mkha' la ni bya rjes bzhin/ /skye dgu phal pa 'di dag ni/ /pha mtha' nyid du rgyug byed pas②/ /gang dag pha rol 'gro byed pa'i/ /mi yi skye bo de dag nyung / /gang dag legs par gsungs pa yi/ /chos la chos kyi rjes lta bas/ /skye bo de dag skye shi yi/ /mtsho chen rgal dka'i pha rol 'gro/ /skyob ①pa rab tu rnam grol zhing / /dus 'das mya ngan bral ba dang / /mdud pa thams cad spangs pa la/ /yongs su gdung ba yod mi 'gyur/ /'jigs dang bcas pa'i lam rgal rjocing / /g.yang sa yongs su spongs ༷pa dang / /sbyor dang mdud pa las grol bas/ /'dod chags kyi ni dug kun bcom/ /'dod pa lta bu'i 'dam rdzab med/ /zhe sdang lta bu'i gnod rjomed do/ /gti mug lta bu'i rgya med de⑦/ /sred pa lta bu'i chu klung ⑧med/ /nam mkha' la ni rjes lta bur⑨/ /phyi rol pa la dge spyong med//byis pa spros la mngon par dga'/ /de bzhin gshegs la ⑩spros mi mnga'/ /sbyor bas byis pa khrid pa'i phyir/ /mkhas pa ⑪sbyor ba 'joms par byed/ /mkhas pa ⑫lha dang mi dag gi/ /sbyor ba gang yin 'joms byed pa/ /sbyor ba kun dang bral ba'i phyir/ /sdug bsngal kun las grol bar 'gyur/ /sbyor ba 83—75

las ni srid ①pa 'byung / /sbyor ba med pas srid ②pa zad/ /srid ④pa dang ni srid bumed pa'i/ /lam 'di gnyis ni ⑤shes byis la/ /sbyor las rab tu 'da' bya'i phyir/ /mkhas pas de la bslab par rmis/ /nyes par spyad pa byas pas gdung 'gyur zhing / /ngan 'gror song ba'i 'og tu'ang gdung bar 'gyur/ /legs par spyad pa byas pas dga' 'gyur zhing / /bde 'gror song ba'i 'og tu'ang dga' bar 'gyur/ /phyi nas gdung 'gyur de byed pas/ /gnyis dun nyes spyad ma byas bla/ /gdung bar mi 'gyur de bya ste/ /legs par spyad pa byas na ⑦rung / /mkhas dang ④byis pa 'dres pa las/ /ma smras shes par mi 'gyur bas/ /zhi ba'i go 'phang sgos shig dang / /smras pa yis ni shes par 'gyur—/ /legs bshad drang srong rgyal mtshan te/ /drang srong rgyal mtshan chos yin pas/ /chos ni bshad pas gsal ⑨bya zhing / /drang srong rgyal mtshan bgreng bar gyis/ /ma smras na yang smod byed cing / /mang du smras na ⑩smod par byed/ /dal bus smras kyang ⑪smod byed de/ /'jig rten na ni mi smad med//gcig tu ⑫smad par bya ba dang / /gcig tu bstod ⑫par bya ba'i mi/ /da ltar yod pa ma yin te/ /byung bar ma gyur 'byung mi 'gyur/ /gang dag la ni gnas pa'i spros med cing / /gang dag kun sbyor gdung las rab log pa/ /thub pa sred bral de dag rgyu mdzad kyang / /lhar bcas 'jig rten rnams kyis mi shes so/ /gang gis dad dang tshul khrims dang / /blo la phan ④ni ma byung bar⑫//ji lta ji ltar rtogs gyur pa'i/ /shes pa can dag stod ⑩byed de/ /de dag sus kyang smad 'os min/ / 'dzam bu'i ⑩gling gi gser rgyan bzhin/ /ji ltar ri dang brag dag ⑫ni/ /rlung gis g.yos par mi 'gyur ltar/ /de bzhin 83—76

bstod dang smad pa yis/ /mkhas pa rab tu g.yo ba med/ /sa la gang gi rtswa med pa/ /lo med lcug phran ga la yod/ /'ching ①ba las grol brtan pa de'i④//ji ga sus kyang smad 'os min/ /gang zhig rgyal las mi nyams shing / /'jig rten ma rgyal chung zad med/ /sangs rgyas spyod yul mtha' yas de/ /'gro med gom pa ①gang gis bkri/ /gang zhig rgyal las mi nyams shing / /'jig rten ma rgyal chung zad med/ /sangs rgyas mthu rtsal mtha' yas de/ /'gro med gom pa rjogang gis bkri/ /gang la 'khrid ⑤byed srid pa ni/ /yul sred 'dra dub 'ga' sdemed pa/ /sangs rgyas spyod yul mtha' yas de/ /'gro med gom pa ⑧gang gis bkri//gang la 'khrid byed srid ⑨pa ni/ /yul sred 'dra ba 'ga' med ⑩pa/ /sangs rgyas mthu rtsal mtha' yas de/ /'gro med gom pa ⑪gang gis bkri/ /gang zhig rnam par rtog pa rnam bsal cing ⑫/ /nang gi kun la rnam par rtog ⑫med pa/ /kun du sbyor dang gzugs dang 'du shes 'das/ /rnal 'byor bzhi dang bral la skye ba med—/ /sngon bral phyi ma dang bral zhing / /dbus bral srid ④pa'i pha rol phyin/ /rnam pa kun las ⑫sems grol ba/ /skye rga phyi ma 'dren mi 'gyur/ / phrugs kyi tshoms ⑩te nyi shu ⑩dgu pa'o // //⑫rgyal ba las ni 'khon ⑪'byung zhing / /pha rol pham ⑦pa sdug bsngal 'thob/ /rgyal dang pha rol pham spangs na⑥/ /nye bar zhi ba'i bde ba 'thob/ /gzhan la sdug bsngal bskyed pa yis/ /gang zhig bdag ni ⑫bde 'dod pa/ /dgra dang mi 'bral ⑫'grogs pa dang ④/ /de ni sdug bsngal las mi 'grol/ /bde ba 'dod phyir 'byung po la/ /gang zhig 'tshe zhing chad pas gcod/ /bdag gi 83—77

bde ba 'dod pa de/ /pha rol du ni bde mi 'gyur/ /gang zhig bde ba ①'dod pa dag /'byung po la ni mi 'tshe zhing / /chad pas mi gcod bde 'dod pa/ /de dag pha rol bde ba 'thob/ /chos spyod legs par spyad bya zhing / /nyes par spyad ②pa de mi spyad/ /'jig rten 'di dang pha rol du/ /chos spyad pas ni bde ba 'thob/ /chos la legs spyad bde skyed ①pas/ /chos spyod chos kyis bsrung bar bya/ /chos spyod ngan 'gror mi 'gro ba/ /chos la legs spyod phan yon de'orjo/ /yangs pa'i gdugs kyis ⑤dbyar ka ltar/ /chos spyod chos kyis bsrung bar bya/ /chos spyod ngan 'gror mi 'gro ba/ /chos la legs spyod phan yon de'o/ /bag med mi yis chos min spyad na ni/ /'gro ba gang yang rung ba 0ngan 'gror 'gro/ /'di na sbrul nag rked dze+enas bzung ba ltar—/ /chos min spyod ⑧pa de dag rlag ⑨par 'gyur/ /chos dang chos min gnyi ga yi/ /rnam smin 'dra bar mi 'gyur te/ /chos ma yin pas dmyal bar 'gro—/ /chos kyis ⑩bde 'gro thob par byed/ /sbyin pa byed pa'i dus dang g.yul 'gyed dus/ /rgyu yis yongs su bzung bar 'dra bas ⑪na/ /sbyin pa byed dang g.yul 'gyed 'dra zhes gsungs/ /yon tan de gnyis mi ngan rten ⑫mi byed/ /shin tu legs par chas pa gcig pus kyang / /legs par ma chas 'phyis ⑫las rgyal byed ltar/ / gal te dad bskyed ④chung ngu byin pas kyang / /des ni ⑫de dag gzhan du bde bar ⑩'gyur/ /'di na lan brgyar g.yul zlog ⑩dpa' bo bas/ /ser sna dgrar gyur zil kyis mnan nas su/ /gang zhig chags med sems kyis sbyin byed pa/ /de dag ches dpa' yin par ngas gsungs so/ /bsod nams rnam smin bde ba ste/ /mngon par bsams pa 83—78

'byor bar byed/ /myur du zhi ba dam pa yi/ /mya ngan 'das pa thob par 'gyuraske/ /bsod nams byed pa rnams la ni/ /gzhan las byung ba'i gnod pa dang / /lha dang bdud kyi ris ①rnams kyis/ /bar chad bya bar mi nus so/ /gal te sdug bsngal zad bya'i phyir/ /'phags dang shes rab gtong ldan la⑧/ /de yis 'bad rtsol byas na ni/ /lhag mthong gis ni reg par 'gyur/ /sems ni rab tu rnam dang bas/ /chos la dga' byed bde ba 'thob/ /'phags pas gsungs pa'i chos dag la/ /mkhas pa ④rtag tu dga' bar byed/ /gang dag sems ni bsam gtan dga'/ /gang zhig skye med dga' ba dang / /dran pa nye bar gzhag bzhi dang / /byang chub yan lag bdun dag dang / /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa bzhi rnams dang / /yan lag brgyad lam gang dga' ba/ /de dag chos gos 'chang ba dang / /bsod snyoms bde bar za bar byed/ /de dag ri dang nags tshal na/ /bde bar 'chag par byed pa dang / /de dag bde 'thob bde bar ni/ /mthong ba'i chos la mya ngan 'da'/ /'khon dang 'jigs pa kun 'das shing / /'jig rten yul gyi sred las rgal/ /chos thos pa dang mthong ba dang / /dbe+en par dga' ba bde ba ste/ /'jig rten srog chags 'byung po la/ /'tshe med yang dag sdom pa bde④/ /'dod pa rnams las rab 'das shing / /'jig rten 'dod chags bral ba bde/ /nga'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal dag /btul ba de dag mchog tu bde/ /rgas khar tshul khrims ldan pa bde/ /dad la rab tu gnas pa bde/ /don ldan tshig la dga' brjobade—/ /sdig pa mi byed pa dag bde/ /'jig rten na ni phar 'dzin bde/ /de bzhin mar yang 'dzin pa bde/ /'jig rten dge sbyong 'dzin pa bde/ /de 83—79

bzhin bram zer 'dzin pa bde/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni 'byung ba bde/ /de bzhin chos rnams bstan pa bde/ /dge 'dun rnams ni mthun pa bde/ /mthun pa rnams kyi dka' thub bde/ /tshul khrims ldan pa mthong ba bde/ /mang du thos pa mthong ba bde/ /yang srid rnam par grol ba yi/ /dgra bcom pa dag mthong ba bde/ /'jug ngogs bde ba'i chu klung bde/ /chos kyis rgyal ba'i skye bo bde/ /shes rab thob par gyur pa bde/ /nga'o nga rgyal zad pa bde//'phags pa rnams ni mthong ba bde/ /dam pa dag dang 'grogs pa bde/ /byis pa rnams ni ma mthong na/ /rtag tu bde ba nyid du 'gyur/ /rnam pa kun du dgra 'dra ba'i/ /byis dang 'grogs pa sdug bsngal zhing / /byis pa dag dang 'grogs byed pa/ /yun ring rjes su 'gyod par 'gyur/ /skyes bu cang shes dkon pa ste/ /de dag kun du 'byung ma ①yin/ /brtan pa rnams dang 'grogs pa dag /gnyen dang phrad pa lta bur bde/ /gang du brtan pa de skyes pa—/ /de yi rigs kyis bde ba 'thob/ /bram ze mya ngan 'das pa dag /rnam pa kun du bde bar 'jug /gang zhig 'dod pas ②ma gos shing / /zag med rab tu rnam grol ba/ /sred pa thams cad gtubs pa dag /snying las rims nad rnam par bsal/ /sems kyis ①zhi ba thob pa rnams/ /nye bar zhi zhing bde bar 'jugarjo /gang zhig bde ba yangs 'dod cing / /bde ba chung ngu gtong 'dod pa'i/ /brtan pas bde chung spang byas na/ /bde ba yangs pa legs par mthong / /'jig rten 'dod bde gang yin dang / /lha yul bde ba gang yin pas/ /sred pa zad pa'i bde ba de'i/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /khur gyis sdug bsngal blangs pas na/ /khur bor na ni bde bar 83—80

'gyur—/ /lci ba'i khur dag nges bor na/ /phyi nas gzhan dag len mi ①'gyur/ /kun sbyor thams cad zad bya'i phyir/ /sred pa thams cad rab tu spongs/ /phung po thams cad yongs shes na/ /srid pa phyi mar 'gro ba med/ /don rnams bkrun pa la ni grogs ldan bde/ /srog dag rab tu gtugs la bsod nams bde/ /ngan ngon tsam gyis legs ②par chog shes bde/ /sdug bsngal thams cad nges par nub pa ④bde/ /'di na me ni 'bar ba la/ /lcags kyi tho bas brgyab pa yisarjo/ /rim gyis nye bar zhi 'gyur te/ /ji ltar song ba mi shes ⑤ltar/ /'dod pa'i 'dam rdzab chu rgal bucing / /go 'phang mi g.yo thob pa dang / /legs par rnam par grol rnams kyi⑦/ /'gro ba gdags su med pa yin—/ /gang zhig khong na 'khrug pa med pa dang / /gang zhig sred dang sred ④min las log pa/ /de dag ⑨'jigs bral bde zhing mya ngan med/ /lhas kyang blta ⑩zhing bsam du med par 'gyur/ /'di na gang dag chos mang thos pa dang / /rtogs shing ci yang med pa kye re bde/ /skye bo skye bo'i lus ⑪la rab chags shing //chung zad yod pa ⑫brlag par gyur ⑫la ltos/ /'di na gang dag chos mang thos pa dang / /rtogs shing ci yang med pa kye re bde/ /skye bo skye bo'i lus la rab chags shing / /chung zad yod pa brlag par gyur spyol ltos/ /skye bo ci med yon tan rtogs pa dang / /skye bo ci yang med par gyur pa ⑫bde/ /skye bo skye bo'i sems la rab chags shing / /chung zad yod pa brlag par gyur ⑩la ltos/ /skye bo ci med yon tan rtogs pa dang / /skye bo ci yang med par gyur pa ⑩bde/ /skye bo skye bo'i lus la ⑫rab chags shing / /chung zad yod pa brlag par gyur ⑪la ltos/ /gzhan gyi dbang gyur kun sdug ste/ /rang dbang yod pa thams cad 83—81

bde—/ /sbyor ba shin tu spang ①dka' ba/ /thun mong gyur pas brlag par zad/ /zhen par gyur pa'i mi nang na/ /zhen pa med par gnas pa dang / /zhen pa'i nang na ma zhen pa/ /kye ma'o shin tu bde bar 'tsho/ /nad kyis thebs pa'i mi nang na/ /nad med par ni gnas pa dang / /nad pa'i nang na nad med pa/ /kye ma'o shin tu bde bar 'tsho/ /'tshe ba can kyi mi nang na/ /'tshe ba med par gnas pa dang / /'tshe ②ba'i nang na 'tshe med pa①/ /kye ma'o shin tu bde bar 'tsho—/ /gnod sems can gyi mi nang na/ /gnod sems med par gnas pa dang / /gnod sems can nang gnod med pa/ /kye ma'o shin tu bde bar 'tshodu/ /sha khon can gyi mi nang na⑤/ /sha khon med par gnas pa dang / /sha khon can nang 'khon med pa/ /kye ma'o shin tu bde bar 'tsho/ /mi thi la dag rab bsregs kyang / /nga la ci yang tshig pa med/ /nga la gang dag ci med pas/ /kye ma'o shin tu bde bar 'tsho/ /nga la ci yang med mod kyi/ /dga' ba za bar bubyed pas na/ /'od gsal gyi ni lha bzhin du/ /kye ma'o shin tu bde bar 'tsho//'jig tshogs la ni mi rten pas/ /nga la ci yang med mod kyi/ /dga' ba za bar ⑦byed pas na/ /kye ma'o shin tu bde bar 'tsho/ /len pa'i rkyen gyis phrad cing reg 'gyur gyi/ /len med ci ⑧dang phrad cing reg med pas/ /bdag dang gzhan gyis bskyed pa'i bde sdug gis/ /dgon pa'am grong du reg par mi 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten 'di na bde dang sdug bsngal kyis/ /skyes bu dam pa mtho dman mi 'gyur ⑨zhing / /brtan rnams 'dod pa'i rgyu yis mi 'khyal bar/ /skyes bu dam pa kun du 'gro bar byed/ /bde ba'i tshoms te sum cu pa'o// //83—82

ched du brjod pa'i tshoms/ bam po bzhi pa ste tha ma/ gzung bar dka' zhing yang ba dang / /gang du dga' bar 'gro ba yi/ /sems dul ba ni legs pa ste/ /sems dul ba yis bde ba 'dren/ /bdud kyi gzhi dag spong ba na/ /chu bo'i gnas nas rab bton ①te/ /thang la bor ④ba'i nya lta bur/ /bdag gi snesems ni yongs su g.yo/ /nyi ma las ni 'od zer ltar/ /bdag gi sems ni so sor rgyug /de dag mkhas pas nges bzlog ste/ /lcags kyu yis ni glang chen bzhin/ / nga la rjodon med spyod pa dang / /bltar med snying po med pa de/ /rtag tu gdul bar bya ba'i phyir/ /sems de la ni nga smra'o/ /sems 'di sngon chad ji ltar 'dod pa dang / /dga' dgur ④spyod cing rgyu bar byed pa dgadu /glang chen myos la mi yis ⑦lcags kyu ltar/ /de ⑧ni tshul bzhin bya bas de bzung ⑨ngo / /khang khyim byed pa 'di ⑩yis ni/ /yang yang skye ba'i sdug bsngal can/ /skye ba'i 'khor ba du ma zhig /da ltar phan cad khyod kyis phyung / /khang khyim byed pa khyod mthong bas/ /khyim gyi gdung chen rnam bcom la⑩ /phyam rnams thams cad bcag nas su/ /phyin cad khyim byed ⑫mi gzhug go/ /sems ni 'du byed dang phral ⑫nas/ /'di nyid la ni zad par 'dod/ /sems ni g.yo zhing brdzun pa ste/ /ring du 'gro zhing bzlog dka' ba/ /mda' mkhan me yis srong ba ltar/ /yid gzhungs pa yis bsrang bar bya/ /gang zhig lus med phug na gnas/ /gcig pu rgyu zhing ring 'gro ba'i/ /sems de 'dul ④bar byed pa ni/ /'jigs pa che las thar bar 'gyur/ /log pa'i smon ldan sems gang gis/ /bdag nyid sdug bsngal byed 'gyur ba'iske/ /de ltar 'khon gyis 'khon can dang / /dgra bos dgra la'ang ⑩byed mi 'gyur/ / yang dag 83—83

smon ldan sems gang gis/ /①bdag nyid bde bar byed 'gyur ba/ /de ltar pha dang ma dag dang / /gnyen gzhan gyis kyang byed mi 'gyur/ /ji ltar khong steng g.yogs sdenyes na/ /char pa yongs su 'dzag pa ltar/ /de bzhin sems ni ma bsgoms pa/ /'dod chags rnams kyis yongs su bcom①/ /ji ltar khang steng g.yogs ④legs na/ /char pa rnam par mi 'dzag pa/ /de bzhin legs par bsgoms pa'i sems/ /'dod chags rnams kyis yong ⑤mi choms/ /ji ltar khang steng g.yogs ④nyes na/ /char pa yongs su 'dzag pa ltar/ /de bzhin sems ni ma bsgoms pa/ /zhe sdang rnams kyis yongs su bcom/ /ji ltar khang steng g.yogs ⑦legs na/ /char pa rnam par mi 'dzag pa/ /de bzhin legs par bsgoms pa'i sems/ /zhe sdang rnams kyis yong ⑧mi choms/ /ji ltar khang steng g.yogs ⑨nyes na/ /char pa yongs su 'dzag pa ltar/ /de bzhin sems ni ma bsgoms pa/ /gti mug rnams kyis yongs su bcom/ /ji ltar khang steng g.yogs ⑩legs na/ /char pa rnam par mi 'dzag pa/ /de bzhin legs par bsgoms pa'i sems/ /gti mug rnams kyis yong ⑪mi choms ji ltar khang steng g.yogs ⑫nyes na/ /char pa yongs su 'dzag pa ltar/ /de bzhin sems ni ma bsgoms pa/ /nga rgyal rnams kyis yongs su bcom/ /ji ltar khang steng g.yogs ⑫legs na/ /char pa rnam par mi 'dzag pa/ /de bzhin legs par bsgoms pa'i sems/ /nga rgyal rnams kyis yong ⑫mi choms/ /ji ltar khang steng g.yogs ⑫nyes na/ /char pa yongs su 'dzag pa ltar/ /de bzhin sems ni ma bsgoms pa/ /chags pa rnams kyis yongs su bcom/ /ji ltar khang steng g.yogs ⑩legs na/ /char pa rnam par mi 'dzag pa/ /de 83—84

bzhin legs par bsgoms pa'i sems/ /chags pa rnams kyis yong ①mi choms//ji ltar khang steng g.yogs ④nyes na/ /char pa yongs su 'dzag pa ltar/ /de bzhin sems ni ma bsgoms pa/ /sred pa rnams kyis yongs su bcom/ /ji ltar khang steng g.yogs ①legs na/ /char pa rnam par mi 'dzag pa/ /de bzhin legs par bsgoms pa'i sems/ /sred pa rnams kyis yong ④mi choms/ /chos kyi sngon du yid 'gro ste/ /yid mgyogs yid ni gtso bo yin/ /gal te yid rab gdug pa yis/ /smras sam yang na byas kyang rung / /de yis de ni sdug bsngal 'thob/ /'khor los mgo bo bcad pa bzhin/ /chos kyi sngon du yid 'gro ste/ /yid mgyogs yid ni gtso bo yin/ /gal te yid rab dang ba yis—/ /smras sam yang na byas kyang rung / /de yis de ni bde ba ⑪'thob /grib ma rjes su 'brang ba bzhin/ /brtsad dupa ched cher 'dzin pa dang / /sems ni nyon mongs gyur pa yis/ /glags skabs tshol bar byed pa yis/ /legs bshad legs par mi shes so/ /sdang ba'am yang na 'khrug pa'am/ /dad pa med pa'i sems dag gis/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis bstan pa yi/ /dam chos kun shes mi nus so/ /gang gis bag med sems dang ni/ /khro ba rnam par btul ba dang / /'di na gnod sems rab spangs pa/ /des ni legs par bshad pa shes/ /sems kyi brtan pa med pa yis/ /dam chos rnam par shes mi 'gyur/ /dad pa 'gyur ldog byed pa yi⑦/ /shes rab yongs su rdzogs mi 'gyur/ /kun rtog la chums rten pa yi⑧/ /lta ngan sum cu rtsa drug gi / /chu bo'i ⑨rgyun ni gang yin pa/ /yid kyi rgyun las rab tu 'bab/ /dga' sems dbang po phal pa dang / /sems kyi rjes 'brang zhan pa yi/ /mi 83—85

de'i grags 'grib 'bras lhags sdepa'i/ /ljon shing la ni bya bzhin no/ /sems khyod phung khrol 'dod la dga' ma ①byed/ /brtson sems bag yod pa la gnas par gyis/ /bag med byas pas dmyal bar btsos pa dang ①/ /be+egs gong mid pas khyod ni ma ngu shig /ldang ba'i dus tshe 'dug par byed pa dang / /lang tsho stobs ldan mi 'bad rjokhyim 'dug dang / /bsam pa rdzogs tshe le lo byed pa yi/ /mi yis shes rab lam rtogs mi 'gyur ro/ /phran tshegs rnam rtogs ⑤zhib mor rnam rtog pas/ /nang na gnas pa'i yid ni g.yen yang rjospyo/ /yid kyi rnam rtog de dag ma shes na/ /'khrul sems yang dang yang du rgyug par byed/ /gang zhig dran ldan rnam 'byed brtson pa dang / /rnam par rtog la mkhas pas de shes na/ /nang na gnas pa'i yid ni g.yen spyo ba/ /thams cad ma lus blo yis rab tu spong / /lus 'di ⑦bum pa 'dra bar rtogs byas shing / /grong khyer 'dra ba'i sems kyis sran btsugs nas/ /shes rab mtshon gyis bdud dang g.yul sprad de/ /btul nas gnas med par ni bsrung bar bya/ /'jig rten 'di dag bum pa 'drar rtogs shing / /de bzhin chos rnams smig rgyu 'drar shes nas—/ /shes rab mtshon gyis ⑤bdud dang g.yul sprad de/ /btul nas gnas med par ni bsrung bar bya/ /lus 'di dbu ba 'dra bar rtogs byas shing //grong khyer 'dra ba'i sems kyis sran btsugs nas/ /shes rab mtshon gyis bdud dang g.yul sprad de/ /btul nas gnas med par ni bsrung bar bya/ /'jig rten 'di dag dbu ba 'drar rtogs shing / /grong khyer 'dra ba'i sems kyis sran btsugs nas/ /shes rab mtshon gyis bdud dang g.yul sprad de/ /btul nas gnas med par ni bsrung bar bya/ /gang gis byang chub yan lag bdun/ /83—86

sems kyis legs par bsgoms pa dang / /gang zhig len la mi dga' zhing / /len pa rab tu spangs pa dang / /zag zad skyon rnams bsal ba de①/ /'jig rten dag na mya ngan 'das/ /gang zhig g.yag rnga'i rtse mo ltar/ /rang gi sems ni rjes srung ②zhing / /'byung po rnams la brtser ldan pa/ /de yi bde ba yong mi nyams/ /gang phyir glang po'i glang po che/ /mche ba bzang po'i glang chen dang / /sems dang sems ni mnyam pas na/ /de phyir gcig pu nags ④su dgyes/ /gang gi yid la gnod med ④cing / /'byung po kun la brtse ba dang / /'byung po rnams la byams byed pa/ /de la ⑤nams kyang 'khon dumi 'byung / /gang la gnod pa'i sems med cing / /'byung po kun la brtse ba dang / srog chags kun la byams byed pa/ /de la nams dze+ekyang 'khon mi 'byung / /gang la gnod pa'i sems med cing / /'byung po rnams la brtse ba dang / /sems can kun la byams byed pa/ /de la nams kyang 'khon mi 'gyuradze+e/ /mdza' bshes kun dang grogs kun dang / /'byung po kun la brtse ba dang / /byams pa'i sems ni bsgoms byas na/ /bde ba shin tu 'phel bar 'gyur/ /gal te gang zhig srog chags 'ga' la'ang sdang med sems/ /byams par byed na de yis de ni dge ba yin/ /sems can thams cad la ni yid kyis brtse byas na—/ /bsod nams phal chen ⑨'phags pas rab tu bsgrub ⑩par 'gyur/ /mi gang dga' ba'i sems dang ni/ /zhum pa med pa'i yid kyis su/ /dge ba'i chos la sgom byed pa/ /grub pa dang ni bde ba 'thob/ /yang dag shes pas rnam grol zhing / / skyo ba nye bar zhi gyur pa/ /de yis yid ni zhi gyur cing / /⑪lus dang ngag gi las kyang zhi/ /ji ltar rtse gcig sems kyis ni/ /chos 83—87

rnams legs par mthong ba ltar/ /sel snyan yan lag lnga pas kyang / /de ltar dga' bar byed mi 'gyur/ /gang yid ting 'dzin la dga' ba/ /de dag 'dod pas rtse mi byed/ /gang zhig cung zad gdung med pa'i/ /skyob pa bde bar nyal bar 'gyur/ /gang yid ting 'dzin la dga' ba/ /de dag 'dod pas rtsen ①mi byed/ /gang zhig cung zad gdung med pa'i/ /thub pa kye ma'o dga' bar 'gyur/ /gang gi ②sems ni brag lta bur/ /rab tu g.yo ba med 'dug pa/ /chags pa'i gnas la mi chags te/ /khro ba'i gnas la 'khrug ①med par/ /gang yid de ltar gyur pa de/ /sdug bsngal thob par ga la 'gyur/ /skur pa mi gdab gnod mi bya/ /so sor thar pas bsdam par bya/ /zas kyi tshod kyang shes par bya/ /bas mtha' dgon par gnas bya zhing / /lhag pa'i sems la rnal 'byor bya/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /sems kyi rtags la mkhas pa dang / /rab tu dben pa'i ro rnyed dang / /rab drang sems pa'i ④'grus skyong can/ /zang zing med pa'i dga' ba stsong / /gang zhig yid gzhungs dbe+en dga' dbe+en duganas pas/ /rtag tu rang gi lus kyis duspyod lam dang / /smra dang yid ni srung bar byed pa de/ /mya ngan spong zhing sdug bsngal 'thob ④mi 'gyur/ /ma bsrungs pa yi sems dag dze+eni/ /log par lta bas bcom pa dang / /gnyid dang rmugs pas zil non pa/ /bdud kyi dbang du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /de bas sems ni bsrung byas te/ /yang dag lta bas mdun bdar cing / /yang dag kun rtog spyod yul can/ /yang dag skye dang 'jig ⑨pa shes/ /gnyid dang rmugs pa zil gnon ⑩pa'i/ /dge slong sdug bsngal zad pa 'thob/ /bag yod sems ni bsrung ba dang / /sems dul yang 83—88

dag sdom pa bde/ /skye dgu sems kyis bslus pa dag /gcig tu sems can dmyal bar 'tshed/ /bag yod sems ni bsrung ba dang / /sems dul yang dag sdom pa bde/ /skye dgu sems kyis bslus pa dag /gcig tu dud 'gro rnams su 'tshed/ /bag yod sems ni bsrung ba dang / /sems dul yang dag sdom ①pa bde/ /skye dgu sems kyis bslus pa dag /gcig tu yi dwags rnams su 'tshed/ /bag yod sems ni bsrung ba dang / /sems dul yang dag sdom pa bde/ /skye dgu sems ni bsrung dze+eb dag /gcig tu mi yi nang du dga'—/ /bag yod sems ni bsrung ba dang / /sems dul yang dag sdom pa bde| /skye dgu sems ni bsrung 1ba dag /gcig tu mtho ris rnams su dga' / /bag yod sems ni bsrung ba dang / /sems dul yang dag sdom pa bde—/ /skye dgu sems ni bsrung rjob dag /gcig tu mya ngan 'das pa 'thob /sems kyi tshoms te sum cu rtsa dugacig pa'o// //dge slong bsod snyoms byed pa bdag rang tsam/ / 'grangs par ④byed kyi gzhan dag mi gso ba/ /rtag tu nyer zhi dran dang ldan pa yi/ /skyob pa de la lha rnams dga' bar byed⑦/ /dge slong bsod snyoms byed pa bdag rang tsam//'grangs ⑧par byed kyi gzhan dag mi gso ba/ /skyob pa de la lha rnams dga' byed kyi/ /bkur ste nor dang grags 'dod rnams la ⑨min/ /dge slong 'dod pa kun spangs shing / /mdun na gnas pa'i ⑩rdul bsal ba/ /bdag med thub pa brten ⑪pa yis/ /gzhan la smra bar bya mi dgos/ /skye bo ma bsdams tshig gis gnod byed pa/ /mi bzad rjod pa'i ⑫tshig de thos gyur kyang //83—89

dge slong sdang sems bral la ci ①mi snyam/ /g.yul ngor glang chen mda' yis bsnun pa bzhin/ /skye bo ma bsdams tshig gis gnod byed pa/ /mi bzad rjod ④pa'i tshig de thos gyur kyang / /dge slong yid legs bzhag ④la ji mi snyam/ /g.yul ngor glang chen mda' yis bsnun pa bzhin/ /bzo yis mi 'tsho yang zhing bdag la dga'/ /dbang po dul zhing rjokun las rnam grol zhing ⑤/ /khyim la ma chags bag dumed 'dod sred spangs/ /gcig pu spyod byed de ni dge slong yin—/ /'tsho gtsang snyom las med pa yi/ /grogs po mthun pa bsten bya zhing / /so sor ⑦bgo bsha' bya ba dang / /spyod yul cho ga mkhas par bya/ /dze+elag pa legs bsdams rkang pa legs bsdams dang / /tshig rnams legs bsdams dbang po legs bsdams shing / /gcig pu nang du mnyam par 'jog la dga'/ /chog shes de ni dge slong yin zhes gsung ⑨/ /dge slong chos la kun dga' zhing //chos dga' chos la sems pa dang / /chos la rjes su dran pa dag /chos las yongs su nyams mi 'gyur/ /dge slong khang stong zhugs nas su/ /nang la lta bar byed pa dang / /chos rnams legs par mthong ba dag /lha yi dga' dang ldan par 'gyur/ /ji lta ji ltar phung po la/ /skye dang 'jig par legs rtogs pa⑫/ /de lta de ltar de yis ni/ /dga' dang mgu ba nyid kyang 'thob/ /dge slong dga' ba mang po yis/ /sdug bsngal zad pa thob par 'gyur/ /ji ltar brag gi ri bo dag /rlung gis rab tu mi g.yos ⑪ltar/ /de bzhin dge slong 'dod chags dag /zad pa kun du rab mi g.yo⑩/ /ji ltar brag gi ri bo dag /rlung gis ⑫rab tu mi g.yos ⑫ltar/ /de bzhin dge slong zhe sdang dag /zad pa kun du rab mi g.yo⑫/ /ji ltar brag gi ri bo dag⑩ /rlung gis rab tu 83—90

mi g.yos ①ltar/ /de bzhin dge slong gti mug dag /zad pa kun du rab mi g.yo—/ /ji ltar brag gi ri bo dag /rlung gis rab tu mi g.yos sdeltar/ /de bzhin dge slong nga rgyal dag /zad pa kun du rab mi g.yo/ /ji ltar brag gi ri bo dag /rlung gis rab tu mi g.yos ltar/ /de bzhin dge slong chags pa dag /zad pa kun du rab mi g.yo/ /ji ltar brag gi ri bo dag /rlung gis ①rab tu mi g.yos ltar/ /de bzhin dge slong sred pa dag /zad pa kun du rab mi g.yo/ /gang la kun du sogs med cing / /gang la bdag gir byed med pa/ /gang dag med na'ang mi gdung ba/ /de ni dge slong zhes brjod do/ /re zhig gzhan la slong ba tsam/ /ji rjog dge slong min pa snyam/ /grong ba'i chos ni 'dzin byed pa/ /ji ⑤ga dge slong min pa snyam/ /gang zhig dge dang sdig pa dag /rab spangs tshangs par spyod ldan zhing / /sde tshogs spangs nas spyod byed parjo/ /de ni dge slong zhes brjod do/ /dge slong gang zhig byams gnas shing / /sangs rgyas bstan la rang medang ba/ / des ni blta ⑧bas mi ngoms pa'i/ /zhi ba'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur/ /dge slong gang zhig byams gnas shing / /sangs rgyas bstan la rab dang ⑨des/ /'du byed nyer zhi zhi ba yi—/ /zhi ba'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur/ /dge slong gang zhig byams gnas shing / /sangs rgyas bstan la rab dang ba⑩/ /des ni kun sbyor kun zad pa/ /rim byis mngon sum byed par 'gyur/ /dge slong gang zhig byams gnas shing / /sangs rgyas bstan la rab dang bas⑪/ /bdag nyid ngan 'gro las 'dren te/ /'dam rdzab las ni glang chen bzhin/ /dge slong gang zhig byams gnas shing / /sangs rgyas bstan la rab dang bas⑫/ /sdeg pa'i chos rnams sprug ⑫byed de/ /83—91

rlung gis ①ljon shing lo ma bzhin/ /dge slong gang zhig byams gnas shing / /sangs rgyas bstan la rab dang bas②/ /mya ngan 'das dang nye ba'i phyir/ /yongs su nyams 'gyur mi srid do/ /sems dga' yid ni bzang ba dang / /dga' dang mi dga' zil gnon pa'i/ /dge slong dga' ba mang po ①yis /sdug bsngal zad pa thob par 'gyur/ /lus zhi ngag ni zhi ba dang / /sems zhi legs par 0mnyam bzhag cing / /'jig rten zang zing spangs pa yi/ /dge slong nyer zhi yin zhes brjod/ /ting 'dzin med la shes rab med/ /shes rab med la ting 'dzin med/ /shes rab ting ⑤'dzin ldan pa de/ /dge slong yin zhes brjod par bya/ /0de bas ting 'dzin shes rab la/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis 'jug bya ste/ /de bzhin shes rab dge slong de'i/ /dang por bya ba 'di yin no/ /⑦chog shes dbang po bsdam bya zhing ⑧/ /so sor thar pas bsdam ⑨par bya/ /zas kyi tshod kyang shes par bya/ /bas mtha' ⑩dgon par gnas bya zhing ⑪/ /lhag pa'i sems la rnal 'byor bya/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin—/ /gang gi lus dang ngag dang ni/ /yid la nyes byas med gyur pa/ /de ni dge ba'i tshul khrims can/ /ngo tsha'i yid ldan dge slong yin/ /gang gis rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi/ /phyogs kyi chos bdun legs bsgoms pa/ /de ni dge ba'i chos can de/ /mnyam bzhag ⑫dge slong yin zhes gsung ⑫/ /'di na gang zhig bdag nyid kyi/ /sdug bsngal zad pa ④rab shes la/ /dge zhing shes rab ldan pa de/ /zag med dge slong yin zhes gsung ⑫/ /zag pa zad pa ma thob na/ /tshul khrims brtul zhugs tsam dag gam/ /yang na thos pa mang po 'am/ /dben pa dag tu gnas kyang rung / /ting 'dzin thob par 83—92

gyur kyang ngal/ /rdeng drod chod pa'i dge slong min/ /phung po la ni bdag zer ba'i/ /'jig rten 'di dag gdung ba byung/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub bde ba ni/ /'phags pas bstan snepa mngon du bya/ /ji lta ji ltar bsam byas pa①//de lta de ltar gzhan dudu 'gyur/ /gzhan du 'gyur ba'i ⑤'jig rten 'di/ /srid pa la chags srid la dga'/ /srid la dumangon chags srid la dga'⑦/ /srid pa nyid la mngon par dga'/ /dga' bya gang yin de sdug bsngal/ /skyi ⑧g.ya' gang yin de bde bas/ /srid pa rab tu spang ba'i phyir/ /'di na tshangs par spyod pa ste⑨/ /dge sbyong bram ze ji snyed pa/ /srid pas srid las nges 'byung zer/ /de dag thams cad srid pa las/ /nges 'byung min zhes ⑩brjod par bya/ /dge sbyong bram ze ji snyed pa/ /srid pas srid las ⑪nges 'byung zer/ /de dag thams cad srid pa las/ /rnam grol min zhes brjod par bya/ /len pa'i rgyan las ⑫sdug bsngal byung / /sdug bsngal las ni len pa byung / /len pa thams cad yongs zad na/ /sdug bsngal rab tu 'byung ⑫ba med—/ / len pa ④thams cad na srid pa'i rnam pa ji snyed yod pa de dag thams cad ni mi rtag pa/ sdug bsngal ba/ yongs su 'gyur ba'i chos can yin no zhes de ltar de dag la yang dge ba'i ⑫shes rab kyis ji lta ba bzhin du mthong na/srid pa'i sred pa rab tu spong bar 'gyur zhing / srid pa med pas mngon par mi ⑩dga' bar 'gyur ro⑩/ /de ltar mya ngan las 'das pa'i dge slong skyob pa ni gzhan du len pa med cing yang srid spyomed par 'gyur te/ bdud zil byis non ⑪pa dang / g.yul las rgyal ba dang / srid pa thams cad las rab tu 'das pa 'di lta bu 'di ni sdug bsngal gyi mtha' yin no/ /dge slong dngos po 83—93

bcad pa dang / /nye bar zhi zhing sems zhi ba/ /de ni yang srid med par 'gyur—/ /skye ba'i 'khor ba rnam par spangs/ /dge slong dngos po bcad pa dang / /nye bar zhi zhing sems zhi ba/ /de ni bdud kyi 'ching las ①grol/ /skye ba'i 'khor ba rnam par spangs/ /dge slong dngos po bcad pa dang / /sems ni zag pa med gyur pa/ /de ni yang srid med pa ste/ /skye ba'i 'khor ba rnam par spangs/ /dge slong dngos po bcad pa dang / /sems ni zag pa med gyur pa/ /de ni bdud kyi 'ching las grol/ /skye ba'i 'khor ba rnam par spangs—/ /dge slong dngos po bcad pa dag② /srid pa'i sred pa btubs ①gyur pa/ /de ni yang srid med par 'gyur/ /skye ba'i 'khor ba rnam par spangs//dge slong dngos po bcad pa dang / /srid pa'i rjosred pa bcad gyur pa/ /de ni bdud kyi 'ching las grol/ /skye ba'i 'khor ba rnam par spangs⑤/ /gang zhig 'dam rdzab legs rgal bucing / /grong gi tsher ma dkrugs pa dang / /'dod chags zad pa rjes thob pa/ /de ni dge slong yin zhes brjod/ /gang zhig 'dam rdzab legs rgal cing / /grong gi tsher ma dkrugs pa dang / /zhe sdang zad pa rjes thob pa/ /de ni dge slong yin zhes brjod/ /gang zhig 'dam rdzab legs rgal cing / /grong gi tsher ma dkrugs pa dang / /gti mug zad pa rjes thob pa/ /de ni dge slong yin zhes brjod/ /gang zhig 'dam rdzab legs rgal cing / /grong gi tsher ma dkrugs pa dang / /nga rgyal zad pa rjes thob pa/ /de ni dge slong yin zhes brjod/ /gang zhig 'dam rdzab legs rgal cing / /grong gi tsher ma dkrugs pa dang / /chags pa zad pa rjes thob pa/ /de ni dge slong yin zhes brjod/ /gang zhig 'dam rdzab legs rgal cing / /83—94

grong gi tsher ma dkrugs pa dang / /sred pa zad pa rjes thob pa/ /de ni dge slong yin zhes brjod/ /gang zhig gshe ba dang ni gsod pa dang / /'ching dang grong gi tsher ma thul ba ①dang / /gang zhig ri bo bzhin gnas mi bkri zhing //sdug bdes mi g.yo de ⑤ni dge slong yin/ /skur pa mi 'debs sgo 'dogs mi byed cing / /'jig rten 'di kun brdzun rtogs dge slong gang / /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol posne/ /spong ste sgrul rgas lpags rnying rje ba bzhin/ /sbrul gyis dug btang ba la sman bzhin du/ /'dod chags langs pa 'dul ba'i dge slong gang / /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol po/ /spong ste sbrul rgas lpags rnying rje ba bzhin/ /sbrul gyis dug btang ba la sman bzhin du/ /zhe sdang langs pa 'dul ba'i dge slong gang / /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol po/ /spong ste sbrul rgas lpags rnying rje ba bzhin/ /sbrul gyis dug btang ba la sman bzhin du/ /gti mug langs pa 'dul ba'i dge slong gang / /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol po—/ /spong ste sbrul rgas lpags rnying rje ba bzhin/ /sbrul gyis dug btang ba la sman bzhin du/ /nga rgyal langs pa 'dul ba'i dge slong gang / /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol po/ /spong ste sbrul rgas lpags rnying rje ba bzhin/ /sbrul gyis dug btang ba la sman bzhin du/ /chags pa langs pa 'dul ba'i dge slong gang //de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol po/ /spong ste sbrul rgas lpags rnying rje ba bzhin/ /sbrul gyis dug btang ba la sman bzhin du/ /khro ba langs pa 'dul ba'i dge slong gang / /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol po/ /spong ste sbrul rgas lpags rnying rje ba bzhin/ /sbrul gyis dug btang ba la sman bzhin du/ /sred pa langs pa 'dul ba'i dge slong gang / /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol po/ /spong ste sbrul 83—95

rgas lpags rnying rje ba bzhin/ /mthu chung 'dam bu'i rags la klung chen ltar/ /'dod chags ma lus drungs 'byen dge slong gang / /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol po/ /spong ste sgrul rgas lpags rnying rje ba bzhin/ /mthu chung 'dam bu'i rags la ①klung chen ltar/ /zhe sdang ma lus drungs 'byin dge slong gang / /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol po/ /spong ste sbrul rgas lpags rnying rje ba bzhin/ /mthu chung 'dam bu'i rags la klung chen ltar/ /gti mug ma lus drungs 'byin dge slong gang / /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol po/ /spong ste sbrul rgas lpags rnying rje ba bzhin/ /mthu chung 'dam bu'i rags la klung chen ltar/ /nga rgyal ma lus drungs 'byen dge slong gang / /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol po/ /spong ste sbrul rgas lpags rnying rje ba bzhin/ /mthu chung 'dam bu'i rags la klung chen ltar/ /chags pa ma lus drungs 'byen dge slong gang / /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol po/ / spong ste ②sbrul rgas lpags rnying rje ba bzhin/ /mthu chung 'dam bu'i rags la klung chen ltar/ /sred pa ma lus drungs 'byin dge slong gang / /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol po/ /spong ste sbrul rgas lpags rnying rje ba bzhin/ /'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad spong byed cing / /'dod sbyor 'ching ba rnam bsal ①dge slong gang / /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol po/ /spong ste sbrul rgas lpags rnying rje ba bzhin/ /sgrib pa thams cad spangs shing sdig med pa④/ /yid gnyis zug rngu bcad pa'i dge slong gang / /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol bo/ /spong ste sbrul rgas lpags rnying rje ba bzhin/ /rtog pa rnam bsal nang gi ma lus larjo/ /rnam par rtog pa med pa'i dge slong gang / /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol po/ /spong ste sbrul rgas lpags rnying rje ba bzhin/ /83—96

①nags sbyor byed pa 'ga' med mi dge ba'i/ /rtsa ba legs par drungs phyung dge slong gang / /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol po/ /spong ste sbrul rgas lpags rnying rje ba bzhin/ /rims nad bcas pa 'ga' med mi dge ba'i/ /rtsa ba legs par ②drungs phyung dge slong gang / /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol po/ /sgong ste sbrul rgas lpags rnying rje ba bzhin/ /bag la nyal ba 'ga' med mi dge ba'i—/ /rtsa ba legs par drungs phyung dge slong gang / /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol spong ske/ /spong ste sbrul rgas lpags rnying rje ba bzhin/ /khrims ldan gang yin dge slong de/ /stong nyid gang ldan ④bsam gtan de/ /rtag tu byed gang rnal 'byor de/ /mya ngan 'das gang bde ba dedhi/ /dge slong dga' dang mi dgas mi brjod rjocing / /bas mtha'i gnas mal dag ⑦tu sten pa dang ⑧/ /de ni bag yod gnas shing sred ⑨pa yi/ /'dod chags phra rgyas legs par 'byin par byed/ /dge slong gi tshoms te sum cu rtsa ⑫gnyis pa'o// //gang zhig brgyan kyang chos spyod dul ba dang / /zhi zhing yang dag sdom la ⑪tshangs par spyod/ /'byung po kun la chad pas mi gcod de/ /bram ze dge sbyong de yin dge slong de/ /gcer bur spyod pas ma yin ral pas ma yin rdzab kyis min/ /kha zas mi za ba yis ma yin thang la nyal ba'am/ /rdul dang dri mas ma yin tsog pur 'dug la 'bad pa yis/ /mi rnams dag par mi 'gyur som nyi rnams las rgal ⑫mi 'gyur/ /dge sbyong bram ze gang yang rung / /de dag nyid la chags byed pa⑫/ /zag pa zad pa ma thob par/ /bar ma dor ni rnam par nyams/ /dge sbyong bram ze gang yang rung / /de dag ⑫nyid la chags 83—97

byed pa/ /tshor ba zad pa ma thob par/ /bar ma dor ni rnam par nyams/ /dge sbyong bram ze gang yang rung / /de dag nyid la chags byed cing / /byis pa mtha' gcig la lta ba/ /bar ma dor ni rnam par nyams/ /dge sbyong bram ze gang yang rung / /de dag nyid la chags byed pa/ /byis pa'i skye bo blo ngan rnams—/ /bar ma dor ni rnam par nyams/ /dge sbyong bram ze gang yang rung / /de dag nyid la chags byed pa/ /go 'phang dam pa ma thob par/ /bar ma dor ni rnam par nyams/ /blo ngan khyod kyi ral pa ci/ /khyod kyi g.yang gzhi gyon pa ciske/ /khyod ①nang thibs por 'dug bzhin du/ /phyi rol legs par byi dor byed—/ /blo ngan khyod kyi ral pa ci/ /khyod kyi g.yang gzhi gyon pa ci/ /khyod nang dri ma ldan bzhin du/ /phyi rol legs par byi dor byed/ /rigs kyis ②bram zer 'gyur ma yinadze+e/ /ral pas ma yin rus kyis min/ /gang zhig bden pa'i chos duldan pa/ /gtsang ma de yin bram ze yinadu/ /rigs kyis dubram zer 'gyur ma ⑦yin/ /ral pas ma yin rus kyis min/ /gang zhig sdig pa che chung rnams/ /thams cad spong bar byed pa dag /sdig pa rnams ni spangs phyir de/ /bram ze yin zhes nges par brjod/ /mgo bo byegs tsam dge sbyong min/ /oṃ zhes zer ba bram ze min/ /gang zhig dge ba'i chos ldan pa/ /gtsang ma de yin bram ze de/ /mgo bo byegs tsam dge sbyong min/ /oṃ zhes zer ba bram ze min/ /⑧gang zhig sdig pa che chung rnams/ /thams cad spong bar byed pa dag /sdig pa rnams ni spangs phyir de/ /dge sbyong bram ze de yin no/ /skye bo phal cher 'dir 'khru ⑨ba/ /chu yis dag par mi 'gyur te/ /gang zhig sdig pa che chung rnams/ /thams cad spong bar byed pa dag /sdig pa 83—98

rnams ni spangs phyir de①/ /dge sbyong bram ze de yin no/ /gang zhig sdig chos rab spangs shing / /rtag tu dran ldan spyod byed ②pa/ /kun sbyor zad pa'i sangs rgyas de/ /'jig rten dag na bram ze yin/ /bram ze gang zhig sdig pa'i chos spangs shing / /bdag nyid ④tshul 'chos med cing rnyog med gnas/ / rig byed mthar phyin dutshangs par spyod pa spyad⑤/ /dus su smra byed de ni tshangs pa rjosmra/ /gang zhig sgyu la mi gnas nga rgyal med/ /gang zhig chags rnged bdag med re ba med/ /'khrug bcom bdag nyid mya ngan 'das phyogs de/ /bram ze dge sbyong de yin dge slong de/ /gang zhig ma yi dze+emangal skyes nas/ /gal te 'dzin pa dang bcas na/ /de ming bu ⑧zhes smra bar bstan/ /bram ze yin par nga mi smra/ /yongs su 'dzin med len med de⑨/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig lus dang ngag dang ni/ /yid kyis nyes byas mi byed cing / /gang zhig gnas gsum legs bsdams te⑩/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang gi tshig ngag ⑪mi rtsub cing / /go byed yid 'ong smra ba dang //gang gis ⑫nyon mongs mi skyed ⑫de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig gsod 'ching ④gshe ba dang / /sdang ba'i mi skel bzod byed de/ /bzod pa'i brtul zhugs stobs tshogs ⑩can/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so—/ /khro ba med cing tshul khrims can/ /brtul zhugs ldan zhing sems khral med—/ /dul zhing lus mthar gnas pa de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so—/ /gang zhig rab byung khyim pa dang / /de bzhin gnyis kar mi 'dre ⑩zhing //'dod chung khyim nas ma byung de⑫/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /ma 'ongs pa la mngon mi dga'/ /'das pa rnams la gdung med pa⑪/ /'khrig 83—99

pa'i sbyor bral g.yul rgyal de①/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /ma 'ongs pa la mngon mi dga'/ /'das la gdung med rdul bral zhing / /zhi ba mya ngan med ②pa de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig 'dod chung gzhan mi gso①/ /dul zhing snying por rab gnas la/ /zag zad skyon rnams bsal ba de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig pha rol tshu rol dang / /pha rol tshu rol gnyis med cing / /chos rnams kun gyi mthar phyin te④/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig pha rol tshu rol dang / /pha rol tshu rol gnyis med cing / /gang zhig gnas gsum ma chags de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig thung dang ring ba dang / /phra sbom dge dang mi dge dang / /'jig rten cung zad mi len de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig 'di nyid rab shes shing / /rang gi sdug bsngal zad pa dang / /'dod chags bral zhing mi ldan de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig dge dang sdig pa dang / /gnyi ga yis kyang mi gos pa/ /gos med rdul bral zhi ba de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig dge dang sdig pa'i lasarjo/ /chags gang yin de rab 'das shing / /chags las rab 'das rnam grol dude/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig sngon dang phyi ma dang / /dbus kyang yod pa ma yin pa/ /rdul bral 'ching ba las grol de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /pad ma'i 'dab ⑦la chu ltar dang / /sgyung ①bu'i rtse la yungs kar ltar/ /gang zhig sdig la mi gnas de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /pad ma'i 'dab ⑨la chu ltar dang / /sgyung ⑩bu'i rtse la yungs kar ltar⑪/ /gang zhig 'dod la mi gnas de//83—100

bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /pad ma'i 'dab 1la chu ltar dang / /sgyung dzubu'i rtse la yungs kar ltar/ /srid la dga' ba yongs spangs de④/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /zla ba dag cing dri med la/ /skyon bral rab tu dang ba ltar/ /gang zhig sdeg pas mi gos de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /zla ba dag cing dri med la/ /skyon bral rab tu dang ba ltar/ /gang zhig 'dod pas mi gos de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /zla ba dag cing dri med la/ /skyon bral rab tu dang ba ltar/ /srid la dga' ba yongs spangs de④/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /'dam rdzab kyis ni mkha' ltar dang / /rdul gyis zla ba ji lta bar/ /gang zhig sdig pas mi ⑤gos de—/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /'dam rdzab kyis ni mkha' ltar dang / /rdul byis zla ba ji lta bar/ /gang zhig 'dod pas mi gos de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /'dam rdzab kyis ni mkha' ltar dang / /rdul gyis zla ba ji lta bar/ /srid la dga' ba yongs spangs de bu/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig 'dug nas rdul bral ba④/ /sems shing zag zad bya ba byas/ /dul zhing lus mthar gnas pa de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /shes rab zab cing yid gzhungs la/ /lam dang lam min rnams la mkhas/ /gang zhig don mchog rjes thob de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /mi ni gang yang rung ba dag /slong ④mo tsam gyis 'tsho ba dang / /bdag med su la 'ang gnod mi byed/ /brtan ldan tshangs par spyod pa can/ /kun shes spyad phyir chos ston de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig 'dod pa legs spangs shing / /khyim med par ni rab byung ste/ /'dod 83—101

pa'i zag pa yongs zad de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /'gro ba dang ni gnas pa yi/ /'byung po chad pas mi gcod cing / /gsod med ①gsod du mi 'jug ②de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig mi mthun mthun ①byed cing / /chad pas gcod dupa dang du len/ /'byung po rnams la brtse phan de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /sgyung 0bu'i rtse la yungs kar ltar/ /gang zhig 'dod chags zhe sdang dang / /nga rgyal 'chab pa 'joms pa de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig sred rjopa'i rdzong 'di dang / /'khor ba'i klung las rab rgal ⑦cing / /brgal ④nas pha rol 'gro bar sems/ /yid nyid ⑨kyis ni mi bkri zhing / /gang zhig len pa las log de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig 'jig rten 'di dang ni/ /pha rol na ⑩yang sred med cing / /srid pa'i sred pa yongs zad de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig 'jig rten 'di dang ni/ /pha rol la yang chags med cing / /chags med rnam par bral ba de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /dga' dang mi dga' spangs pa dang / /bsil bar gyur cing zag pa med/ /'jig rten kun zil gnon brtan de⑪/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /mi yi sbyor ba spangs nas su/ /lha yi sbyor ba rab 'das shing / /sbyor ba kun dang rnam bral de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig lha dang dri za dang / /mi yi 'gro ba mi shes shing / /zhi ba ⑫'gro ba mi shes de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang gis ⑫chos rnams mi shes pa'am/ /ma mthong ba ni med gyur ⑫la/ /shes bya mtha' yas lta ba de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang gis ⑫sngon gyi gnas 83—102

rtogs ①shing / /mtho ris ngan song mthong ba dang ②/ /de nas skye ba zad thob pa'isne—/ /thub pa mngon shes la brtson pa/ /sdug bsngal tha mar rjorab shes de//bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /sems kyi rnam grol shes pa dang / /'dod chags kun las grol ba dang / /rig pa gsum dang ldan pa de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang gis ⑤sems can 'chi 'pho dang / /skye ba thams cad rtogs gyur pa/ / thogs med spyan ldan sangs rgyas rjode/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig kun sbyor kun 'das shing / /yongs su gdung dze+eb med pa dang / /dga' med dran ldan ston pa de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /thub pa rnam rgyal drang srong che/ /khyu mchog rab mchog glang po che⑧/ /bkrir med khrus byas sangs rgyas de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig srid 'das kun zil gnon/ /chu bo las rgal rnam par 'dren/ /rnam grol ⑨pha rol phyin pa despyo/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /sdig can rnam par mi sems shing / /mi sgom ⑪smra bar mi byed par| /'dug nas rdul bral sems pa de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so—/ /gang zhig phyag dar khrod 'chang zhing / /ngo tsha shes shing 'dod mi lta/ /shing drung dag tu gnas pa de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig sdug bsngal kun spangs ⑫phyir/ /zhi ba 'phags lam yan lag brgyad/ /drang po sgom par byed pa de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang la chung zad gnas med cing / /'du ⑫shes yid gnyis zug rngu med/ /'chi med go 'phang thob pa de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig lus med phug na gnas/ /gcig pu rgyu zhing ring du 'gro/ /gdul bar dga' ⑫83—103

ba'i sems 'dul de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig gzugs med bltar ①med mtha' yas la/ /shin tu bltar med phra zhing gzhi ②mngon rtogs/ /rtag dran kun sbyor zad rgyu sangs rgyas pa/ /'jig rten 'di na de ni bram ze yin/ /gang gis sog mig 'ching ①gtubs te/ /chings ma rgyang 0thag bcad nas su/ /yongs su gdung spangs sangs rgyas de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang gis ⑤rnyed 'dod sdig can dang / /sog dumig chings ma gtubs gyur cing ⑦/ /sred pa rtsar bcas ⑧drungs phyung de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /brtson pas chu bo'i rgyun bcad cing / /'dod pa thams cad rab bcom dang / /'du byed rnams kyi zad shes pa/ /sdig med gang yin bram ze yin/ /pha dang ma ni bsad byas shing / /rgyal po gtsang sbra byed ⑨gnyis dang / /yul 'khor 'khor dang bcas bcom pa /sdig med gang yin bram ze yin/ /pha dang ma ni bsad byas shing / /rgyal po gtsang sbra can gnyis dang / /mi bzad pa yi stag bsad pa/ /sdig med gang yin bram ze yin/ /gang zhig bram ze rdeg pa blun/ /sgod par byed pa de ngan pas—/ /bram ze rnams la brdeg ⑫mi bya/ /bram ze bskrad ⑪par mi bya'o/ /gang zhig chos rnams rnam shes na/ /rgan nam yang na gzhon yang rung / /de la bkur zhing ⑫phyag bya ste/ /bram ze gtsang mas me bzhin no/ /gang zhig chos rnams rnam shes na/ /rgan nam yang na gzhon yang rung / /de la bkur zhing bsnyen ⑫bkur te/ /bram ze gtsang mas me bzhin no/ /gang zhig rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /bstan pa'i chos rnams rnam shes na/ /de la bkur zhing ⑫phyag bya ste/ /bram ze gtsang mas me bzhin no/ /gang zhig rdzogs pa'i sangs 83—104
